A set of three rings linked together.  There's something about the way the rings connect to each other that gives you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

A large triangle made out of three thick rectangles that connect to each other in an angle.  No matter how much you turn it around, you can't seem to comprehend how it links together.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

A large trident made entirely out of an indiscernible material.  The prong in the middle seems to fade away into nothingness when looked at from the top, but you can clearly see the shaft connecting the tip of the weapon from the bottom.  It's giving you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

A transparent flask with a neck that connects directly to its bottom without overlapping itself, even though it clearly does.  You can put things in it, but attempting to follow their path through the neck is impossible.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

It's a cube that constantly shrinks and grows in size.  It's two cubes linked by the vertices, with ever-shifting sides folding onto each other, over and over.  It's four cubes in the exact same position.  It's a cube fading to ash then reverting to pristine form repeatedly.  It's all of these at once, and none of them at all.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

A large wire-frame cube.  The interior wires somehow appear to be over the exterior wires, no matter which angle you look at the cube from.  Trying to trace the lines with your finger is probably not a good idea.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

A chunky ring that folds onto itself continuously, preventing its use as an esoteric piece of jewelry.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

data.description: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.
A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.
In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.
Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.
data.//: Basically implanted contact lenses with AR capabilities

data.description: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your arms and hands, protecting them from physical trauma.
Your eye sockets have been surgically sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  When you cry, you must spit out or swallow your tears.
An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your head and jaw region, protecting your skull from physical trauma.
An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your legs and feet, protecting them from physical trauma.
An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your torso, protecting it from physical trauma.

You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
Concealed in your left arm is a single shot 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.
A pair of lenses surgically installed over your eyes that can be tinted to block out incoming light.
Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

A filtration system near your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.
You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.
Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but will protect you against deep cuts.

Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.
This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  While active, the CQB module will improve your hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.

A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.
Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity while powered.  However, you will suffer penalties while unpowered.

You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's digestive organs and cannot be removed.

data.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.
A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.
When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely.

When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear over three times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.

Surgically implanted into your skull near the eardrums are two speakers, as well as a small port behind the left earlobe.  They can pick up local radio waves and play downloaded music in concert hall quality.  It came pre-installed with "Rubik's Mickse".

Hailing from a world choked with neon smog, and appreciated by Exodii artists, the AudioVox implant allows you to change, remodulate, and even autotune your voice.  It also causes vocalizations (such as shouts and singing) to be much louder.  It consists of an electronic voice box, synthetic larynx and multiple speakers implanted throughout your throat.

Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.

A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.
You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.
Slowly generates bionic power out of kerosene or motor oil.
This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.
Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception while powered.  However, you suffer penalties while unpowered.

Much of the material in your inner eye has been surgically removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  They function as integrated binoculars, letting you see much farther than before, and any vision problems you might have had are now gone.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has completely replaced %1$s eyes now.  Removing them would leave %2$s blind.

data.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.

Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.
Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.
You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.

A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.

You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

A complex respiration augmentation system.  Improves respiration ability in air and allows breathing water.  Will automatically activate when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.  Asthmatics may also use it to stop asthma attacks.
Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

descriptions.text: You sense some creature moving underground here.

data.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.
While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing  your strength by 10, with a minimum setting to 20.
Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.
Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence while powered.  However, you suffer penalties if unpowered.
data.cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

data.description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.
One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.
The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.

One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.
Your eyes are equipped with thin membranes that cover your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.
Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.
data.cant_remove_reason: Removing this CBM would cause severe amnesia and neurological issues.

data.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.

Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, repairing damage at 1 HP per minute and stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.
When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.
When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.
You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.
Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.
Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.
Upgrades your bionic power capacity by 100 kJ.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.
Upgrades your bionic power capacity by 250 kJ.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.
Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.
Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.
A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.
A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.  This one has custom software for communicating with your pal Pat.
A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.
You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.

Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.
A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.
Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.
While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.
A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause sleepiness.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.
Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.
Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.
Your muscular system has been surgically enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength while powered.  However, you will suffer penalties if unpowered.

A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.
Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.
You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.
data.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's lungs and cannot be removed.

data.description: Your eyes are surgically equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.
While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.
You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to zap an adjacent enemy.

This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.
Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move, even when turned off.  Whilst this is toggled on, moving will require more effort, but more power will be generated.  This system is actively detrimental to fully mechanical limbs; the additional joint resistance it relies on causes a net loss of bionic power.

Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.
A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.
Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.
You have a Unified Power System wired into your power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now draw directly from your bionic power supply.

You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.
data.//: bird mutants might have an entirely different vocal chord structure rather than just a different tone of voice

data.description: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.

Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.

The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.

A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.
An electrode has been implanted into your brain's ventrolateral preoptic nucleus.  It turns on whenever you're trying to fall asleep, creating an artificial but effective sensation of sleepiness.
A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants' capacity to store charge.
A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.
This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.
Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.
For better or worse, this CBM suppresses stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up until the end of your natural sleep cycle.

A small implantable betavoltaic device.  Utilizing nickel-63 radioisotope decay technology and diamond semiconductors, this CBM achieves a stable conversion of nuclear energy into electrical power.  Its power output is very low, at a mere 1W, but it boasts a stable operational lifespan of up to 50 years, requiring neither charging nor maintenance.  Under the current state of the world, its decommissioning age is longer than the lifespan of most ordinary people.

Taken from a world that embraced cybernetics in their sports, this CBM links the eyes to a series of nerve stimulators along the arms and hands.  The result is a significant increase to throwing distance and accuracy, and it turns out it works great with fragmentation grenades.
Your legs house chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframes.
Your arms and hands houses chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Arm Reinforcement Motionframes.
Your shoulders and back house chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Biomechanical Assisted Carrying Kinetoframes.
Your scalp houses chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with compatible Hub 01 Low-latency ExoNeural Sensory headgear.

data.description: Your body has been wired with advanced technology that locks you into your native dimensionality, protecting you from unwanted teleportation and some other phase altering effects.

data.//: Only found in netherum labyrinth
data.description: Your head is implanted with a low-power reading light and a short-distance laser scanner, allowing you to upload digital images of books straight into your brain's optic lobe and language centers.  When active, you read slightly faster, and can read in the dark.

data.//: Only found in netherum labyrinth
data.description: Your skull is coated in a microscopically thin layer of some non-newtonian fluid.  It can protect you from some types of electromagnetic fields.  Is it useful?  Maybe.  It slightly encumbers the head.

data.//: Only found in netherum labyrinth
data.description: Your hair follicles have been replaced with mechanical sphincters that control the extrusion and retraction of advanced nanotube hair technology.  Activate this to change the style or color of your artificial hair.

data.//: Only found in netherum labyrinth
data.description: Your bone marrow is now home to several specialized nanorobots.  Activating them will increase blood cell production at the cost of stored calories and bionic energy.
Your legs have been implanted with an antigravity device.  While it doesn't allow you to float or fly, it does allow you to make superhuman long jumps.

Your body is integrated into a bulky Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, are encased in a solid metal core.  While there is clearly a head and torso, it is difficult to tell where one starts and the other ends.  It will be difficult or impossible to squeeze through tight spaces, or to wear normal-sized clothing and armor.  The frame greatly increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is highly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso are still affected by temperature, you can still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.
data.cant_remove_reason: Cyberframes cannot be removed, only swapped via specialized surgery.  Removing it would kill you.

data.description: You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

In place of legs and feet you have sturdy treads.  They are in fact two side-by-size triangular mechanisms, split in the middle, and independently operated.  Your former ankles and associated anatomy are now a part of the internal servomotors, and your knees are capable of minor telescoping and bending, to facilitate lifting one tread at a time for carefully passing over obstacles, or climbing stairs or ladders.  Unlike bipedal human legs, these move faster over most terrain, but will severely hinder travel over obstacles and through water.  They are immune to temperature and pain and don't bleed.  While they are highly resistant to damage, their external moving parts are less well protected than a standard bionic leg with similar plate thickness.  Due to their size and heft, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

Your body is integrated into a very human-like Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, are encased in a frame that resembles a robotic human.  The frame increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is modestly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso are still affected by temperature, you can still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.

Your dreams give you a strange scaly feeling.
You have a strange dream about being a patient in a frightening hospital.
Your dreams give you an oddly medicated feeling.
You have a strange dream about rabbits.
Your dreams give you a strange furry feeling.
You have a strange dream about birds.
Your dreams give you a strange feathered feeling.
You have a strange dream about snails and slugs in your garden.
Your dreams leave you feeling like something is stuck to you.
You dream about the moon.
You dream you're safely at home with a bustling family.
You dream of chasing a beautiful butterfly.
You have a strange dream about frogs in a pond near your childhood home.
Your dreams contain a croaking concerto.
You have a strange dream about fish.
Your dreams give you a strange wet, scaly feeling.
You have a strange dream about animals.
Your dreams give you a strange furry feeling.

Your dreams give you a rough furry feeling.

Your dreams give you a strange content, furry feeling.

Your dreams give you a strange chitinous feeling.

Your dreams give you a strange plantlike feeling.
You have a strange dream about slime.
Your dreams give you a strange slimy feeling.
You have a strange dream about living in a cave.
Your dreams give you a strange reclusive feeling.
You have a strange dream about sea creatures.
Your dreams give you a strange wet feeling.
You have a strange dream about spiders.
Your dreams give you a strange webbed feeling.
You have a strange dream about rats.
Your dreams give you a strange fuzzy feeling.
You have a strange dream.
You feel… OK.
You have a strange dream.
You have a puckish dream.
You dream of the changeling.  Again.
You feel a yearning…
You dream about the zoo, for some reason.
Your dreams… are complex and multifaceted.
You dream of the tropics.
You feel warm.
You dream of a massive block of cheese bigger than you.
You dream of being cozy in a dark place.
You dream of a strange quest for a bush that grows gray apples.
You feel like you're cracking a combination lock.
Red, blue, and yellow cancel each other out, don't they?
Red, blue, and yellow add together, don't they?
You dream you are sleeping.  How odd?
You sleep so well.  You must have been tired.
You have a strange dream about crabs.
Your dreams give you a strange shelled feeling.
You dream of grabbing something in an oversized claw.
You have a disturbing dream of bathing in the sun on a rock.
While dreaming, you see a distinctively lizard-like reflection of yourself.
You have a disturbing dream of undergoing strange medical procedures.
While dreaming, you see yourself dressed in a hospital gown, receiving treatment.
You dream of a hospital where doctors try out experimental treatments.
You have a disturbing dream about running from dogs.
While dreaming, you see a distinctively rabbit-like reflection of yourself.
You dream of digging a hole under a hill to make your home.
You dream of flying.
You have an upsetting dream about falling and being unable to get back up.
Tinnitus follows you into your dreams, where it becomes a chorus of crickets.
You dream of warm breath and fresh blood.
You have a strange dream of carrying a house on your back.
While dreaming, you see yourself weighted down under massive backpack/tent upon your back, as you pass by a mirrored surface.
You have a disturbing dream of eating insects.
While dreaming, you see yourself in a pond, your face has widened and is covered in mucus.
You have strange dreams of soaring through the sky.
In a dream, you see a curiously birdlike reflection of yourself.
You dream of swimming in the open ocean
In your dream, you see a strangely fishlike image of yourself.
You have a vivid dream of hunting in the woods.
Whilst dreaming, you see a disturbingly bestial version of yourself.
You dream of blood and guts.  For some reason, it makes you feel weirdly excited.
You dream of foraging in the woods… mouth-first?
Your dream-reflection is rather bearish.
You dream of brushing the fur on your back against a tree.
You easily bound from the street to a roof…oh, only a dream.
As you dream, your reflection looks rather catlike.
You have a disturbing dream of someone invading your territory.
Your dream-self's muzzle looks… wait, muzzle?
You dream of the moon and feel a sudden urge to howl.
You dream of grazing in an open field.
In a dream you catch a glimpse of a strangely cattle-like image of yourself.
You have a dream of working in a hive.
While dreaming you look into a mirror and see a frighteningly insectoid reflection.
You dream of a feast and excitedly chitter with your pincers… wait, what?
You have a confusing dream of growing in a garden.
You are confused by a plantlike image of yourself in a dream.
You dream of standing still in the rain, drinking in the falling drops… with your feet?
You have a strange dream of living in sludge.
In your dream you see an odd, slimy reflection of yourself.
You dream of living deep inside a dark cave.
You dream you crawl out from under a rock.  And then immediately crawl back in.
You dream of being a primitive cave dweller.
You dream of living on the ocean floor.
While dreaming, a reflection of yourself appears almost like an octopus.
You have a strange dream of spinning webs.
In your dream you see a very spiderlike version of yourself.
You dream of the buzzing of a fly that you cannot see.  It makes you hungry.
You vividly dream of living in the sewers.
In your dream you see a group of rats that look almost like yourself.
You dream of having that success you knew you deserved, back before all this.
Your dream-self looks competent and in control.
You dream of a fortress, sheltering humanity from the zombies.  You're in charge, of course.
You dream of a home in the forests.
You dream you are lithe in the sunlight and radiant with grace.
You feel beautiful, and yet riven with worry…
You can't quite work out what the dream is about… it just keeps changing.
Your dream is filled with creatures, and yet all seem like you.
You dream of stalking some sort of lizard… no, that can't be right, can it?
For some reason you dream of your shoes.  They don't fit, and nothing seems to help…
You dream of… sneaking.
You dream of a cold winter night.  Your jacket is too big to put on.
You dream of walking along the sea floor.
You dream of something biting you but being stopped by your hard outer shell.
You dream you fly across a field of stars.
You dream of multicolor, strange, distant places.
You are terrified by a dream of becoming a lizard hybrid.
You have a disturbingly lifelike dream of living as a lizard.
You have a strange dream about being the Easter Bunny.
You have a comforting and warm dream of living as a rabbit.
You have a dream of doctors and nurses doing unnatural things to your body, which brings you perverse pleasure.
You have a vivid dream of being a medical anomaly, as your heartbeat syncs with the steady drip of an IV line.
You dream of cutting yourself with a knife and watch in fascination as it heals in seconds.
You have a realistic dream of flying south with your flock for the winter.
You are disturbed when your birdlike dreams are more lifelike than reality.
You have a nightmare of being all alone, but then your family flies home to comfort you.
You dream of sneaking into someone's home to listen to them sleep.
You taste iron all night long, like you've bitten your tongue.
You dream in sounds and smells, not images.
You have a disturbing dream of swimming with a school of fish.
When you wake up you panic about drowning from being out of water.
You dream of leaping from the water to catch your prey.
You wake up with your legs pumping as you hop along in your sleep.
You dream of crawling along the world when you realize you can see three hundred and sixty degrees around yourself.
You dream of curling up inside a shell to sleep.
You vividly dream of running with your pack, hunting a wild animal.
A terrifyingly real dream has you killing game with your bare teeth.
Your dream of raiding a giant beehive has you licking your… muzzle in anticipation.
In your dream, you stalk and kill a young wolf, using only your teeth and claws.
A warm, sunny spot high up where you can watch your prey.  What a great dream!
You dream of pursuing and killing a rat, for some reason.
You dream of tearing into a fresh kill.
You dream of finally finding the perfect place to make your den.
You terrifyingly dream of being led to a slaughterhouse by a farmer.
You find it hard to wake from a vivid dream of grazing on a farm.
You are terrified by a dream of serving the hive queen mindlessly.
Your disturbingly lifelike dream has you pollinating plants.
You have a confusing and scary dream of becoming a plant.
The transition from your lifelike dreams of living as a plant to reality shocks you.
Your vivid dream of living as a slime blob frightens you.
You find it hard to control your limbs after dreaming of amorphous blob life.
Your dream of living in the dark for years is almost real.
You are frightened of the outside after your vivid dream of cave life.
Your dreams of living on the ocean floor seem more lifelike than reality.
You dream of living as a terrifying octopus mutant.
You vividly dream of living in a web and consuming insects.
Your dreams of fully turning into a spider frighten you.
You scream in fear while you dream of being chased by a cat
Your lifelike dreams have you scavenging food with a pack of rats.
You see yourself, five years from now, as the leader of a successful city.
Your success in restoring civilization was only a dream.  For now.
NO!  You will not allow this corruption to prevail!
You see yourself reflected in the beauty of the forest.
In your sleep you feel verdant energy growing within you.
You dream of the hunt to end all hunts.
You are many animals, and yet one.
You swim with fish.  You fly with birds.  You run with the beasts of the land.  You change with the changing of seasons.  You are everything.
Hoof.  Talon.  Tooth.  Fight.  Feed.  Forward.
You've never felt so lithe and powerful.
After an exciting and tasty hunt, you retire to your nest.  Mmm, yes, nest.
You weave between the zombies' legs, too small for them to catch.  The gas station isn't far now, with all its soda and chips and- UGH, dream…
Once you finish your tasty dinner of seeds, you look around for your drink, but you already ate it.
You have a disturbing dream of living in a supermarket lobster tank.
Your vivid dream of living as a crustacean frightens you.
The contours of some unknown knowledge tickles at your mind.  It hurts.
You have a vivid nightmare of a mirror image of yourself, blank, screaming silence.
You are terrified by a dream of becoming an ape hybrid.
You blissfully recall days spent lounging in the sun.
You dream of your legions of undead admirers, their attentions, and the wonderful pain.
You have a vivid dream of being a medical anomaly, as your heartbeat syncs with the steady drip of an IV line.
You wonder if your nest will be good enough.
Your dream of soaring over the landscape becomes a nightmare when you find yourself with arms and a glider!
Will your burrow be warm enough for the family in winter?
You dream of outrunning the apocalypse.
You have a comforting dream of swimming with a school of fish.
The thought of being out of water, forced to crawl unsupported, terrifies you.
You vividly dream of sharing a kill with your pack.
A fond memory of throating some prey animal bubbles up.
You wonder if you could find one of those 'salmon runs', or if they were just a legend…
Ah, the wolf-slaying dream again.  That's a good one…
In the dream, you fatten yourself up with all the food you can find to prepare for your next winter hibernation.
Boing!  and you've pounced another yummy critter.
Your nightmare of sentient rats turns successful, as you grab their King and shake it apart!
You leap from rooftop to rooftop, effortlessly avoiding your pursuers while making your way to safety.
You sneak into a house, only to discover a full, intact cupboard of canned tuna!
You dream of a whole field where only lush catnip grows, and you blissfully roll around in it.
You dream of the hunt, the feed, and your pack.
You lead the pack on a glorious hunt, knowing that they will all have your back as you have theirs!
Oh, you should really patrol your territory again, maybe expand.
You dream of a rival pack of hairless bipeds intruding upon your territory.  After a fierce battle, their leader lays lifeless on the ground.
You howl loud and long, ecstatic after securing a whole cache of supplies.
After recruiting a new packmate, you expand your spacious den to accommodate them.
You dream of jumping the gate and leading your herd to freedom.
You bellow on a knoll against the sky, having feasted on the apple time cider.
The herd moves along and you with them, finding greener pastures.
In your dreams, your fangs slip through flesh like scalpels.  You quickly crawl away to let your clumsy prey bleed out.
You flutter through the air, listening for echoes to guide you through your dream.
You dream of friends and family crowded around, chattering noisily, grooming one another, and sharing blood.
You feel smug, knowing that the Queen is dependent on you.
You relax and enjoy the humming adulation of all your followers.
You dream of a weirdly shaped plant, whose nectar surpassed your every wish…
You dream of bees fighting over your sweet nectar.  Mmm.
How grand it would be to sink your roots deep into the soil as the seasons pass you by.
You dream of a gigantic knot of roots, beating like a heart.
You have a disturbing dream of termites chewing all over your body.
You dream of sharing your roots with a vast forest, all plants provided for as the canopy grows ever upwards.
A family of caterpillars munches away at your leaves.
Fire rages around you, licking at your bark and engulfing the saplings and bushes near your roots.  The once chatty forest is quiet in its wake.
You dream of communing with an ancient pine.  Trees are the true survivors of this world, it tells you.
A rather attractive triffid offers you a bouquet of ape heads.  How thoughtful!
Your vivid dream of your pseudopods calcifying into rigid structures terrifies you.
Ah, the painting-the-planet dream again.  Maybe if you assimilated more…
The years seem to fly past as you dream of carving great underground fastnesses.
You have a horrible nightmare of being caught out in the sunlight.
Mmm.  The shellfish dream again.  Yum!
You dream of recruiting a cult of fishfolk to serve your needs.
You excitedly web up an interloper and prepare to feast… nope, dream.
You relax in your web; it's not vibrating, so dinner hasn't arrived yet.
Your dreams of having to live without a web frighten you.
The Fury is so big!  It's GONNA GET YOAAAAAH!  *pant* only a dream.
You find your paws twitching.  There's a cave.  You should go.
You dream of the peaceful world you'll give humankind.  Because no one else can.
You crush those who would disagree with the leadership.  Humanity must be united; independence will get you all killed!
There are underground Faults in the world.  Faults you should remedy.
You pant, terrified at the thought of that FUNGUS destroying your home!
You wish others could understand, and join your struggle…
There is so much that you never imagined, the slime, the legs, and eyestalks but the shell was worth it.
You'll always be home, once you take this last step.
You'd never considered that frogs were generalist predators before this point in your life…
On land and in the water, you control all that you can reach, and your tongue has quite the reach.
Your body flows slightly faster than you expected… oh, just a dream.
FIGHT.  FEED.  FORWARD.
Oh.  No, that 'rex' thing was only a myth.
You stir, saddened that your beautiful hatchlings were only a dream.
You curl up some more in your nest.  Geez, shredded paper really *is* comfy.
Oh boy!  This hidey hole sure is swell.
Once we finish the burrow we'll settle down and start a little family.  Maybe just a dozen boys and a dozen girls.  Nice and cosy.
In your dreams, you blindly run through the pipes of the city, navigating the familiar byways via smell alone.
Sneaky sneak under the floorboards.  We will sneak all their crumbs for us.  But later, back to sleep for now.
You hear the sirens again, but this time you stay in your hole in the wall.  Nobody will think to look there!
You dream of pinching zombies with your claws.
You have a vivid dream of shedding your carapace.  It feels good.
You dream of tearing apart some hapless fish with your pincers.

data.//: The Mycus is ONLY post-thresh, so many more here.
messages: We have been waiting a long time for a place such as this.
We will raise bountiful orchards and beautiful gardens.
The walking plants seek to harness us as a food source.  We will not allow that.
Our colonists are limitless.  We shall adapt to this world, as we adapt to all.
Non-Mycus sometimes reject the Marloss.  Our colonial efforts flourish with broad-minded guidance.
The seething masses attempt to wall non-Mycus away from the Marloss.  We will adapt and defeat them.
Sleeping is tiresome.
Existence is tiresome.
You bask in your forbidden knowledge.

data.//: 4 hours 20 minutes per wall (from regular ground to full palisade) * 373 walls = ~1,567 hours.  Divided into 8-hour work shifts, that's ~196 days, or six and a half months for one person.  Presuming we have ~11 people working in a single shift, each building 1 wall, that should be ~18 days to build.  Please correct me if I messed up the math.

1 hour 30 minutes per wood wall * 50 walls = 75 hours for walls. 132 wood floors * 1 hour 40 minutes a floor = 220 hours. 1 hour 30 minutes per shelf * 68 shelves = 102 hours. (397 so far)  2 hours per roof * 132 roof tiles (assume same as floors) = 264 hours.
data.//2: In total, this takes 661 labor hours to build. Assuming work is in 8-hour shifts, that's 83 days, or 2 months and 22 days for a single worker.  Assume we have ~6 people on the job (isn't as urgent as a wall), this takes us ~14 days to build, or two weeks.

effect.u_message: You feel a deep, churning sensation fill your body.

text: You feel a shift in your body, but it quickly reverts.
Your flesh has taken on an impatient wriggling sensation.
Your skin feels like wax.  Or wet clay.
You feel as though you're on the cusp of something, if you just give it a bit more time…
Your vision swims.  You feel dizzy.
It won't be long now.  Your innards flex and twist in anticipatory contortions.
You begin to feel a sickeningly beautiful ache, the feeling of your cells tearing apart and recombining in strange new patterns.
Your body is slowly reshaping itself!
Every muscle you have begins to minutely spasm and cramp as your body starts morphing, slowly, in unearthly new ways.
You feel your chest wriggle and begin to palpitate.  Here we go.
Tiny ripples begin appearing in your skin and radiating outward like waves.  It is indescribably uncomfortable.
You can palpably feel the churning sensation within fade, your mutation cut short by a lack of nutrients.
The strain of mutation fades, leaving a throbbing sensation like a bad headache.  Or an afterglow.
You're pulled back to reality as your body stops warping, leaving you in your current state for the time being.
Your mutation abruptly ends from a lack of nutrients.  Back to Earth for now.

effect.u_message:
You dream you can fly over a vast plain of grass, mist in the air, clouds obscuring the sun.  You see "home," whatever that means.  But there are other places.  Sad places.  And a dark place.

Are you a traveler?  An explorer?  Do you find them?  Or do you enjoy your time here?  Do you just sleep it away?

You awake in bed.
As you step through the cabin door your movements slow, like you're trying to run underwater.  You then awake in bed.

effect.u_message: Something causes you to stop and reflect.  This place look exactly like you remember.  Yet, you don't recall ever being here.  Something has changed from how it was just a moment ago.  You feel it.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  The sky here is a perfect grey gradient.  It doesn't change, only deepens.  The world has transformed in some way.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  Something creaks in your mind's ear.  It sounds more like settling than aging.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  The air here smells clean.  Just… clean.  Something has changed.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  For a moment, you feel like you're supposed to think about something.  It passes.  Something is different.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  It's warmer today.  Emotionally.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  There's a faint sense of waiting.  Not yours.  Something in this place has changed.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  Lights soften a moment and stays there.  This place spites the dark, as if it has just transformed itself.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  You think about leaving, but the world doesn't suggest a direction.  Yet, something is different, today.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  You feel like you've been here longer than you have.  Have you?  Something has changed in this world.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  This place seems exactly the same, today.  You almost wish it didn't.
You step through the swirling vortex and into a cabin, which quickly unfolds itself in space and time, dizzying your senses.  Then, you find your footing.

data.//: Default modern blast light: three waves expand from the centre — golden-yellow (color_a), then red (color_b), then a clear wave that fades each tile out. It is a translucent light cover (never opaque): a lit tile's opacity decays from alpha_a (bright flash) to alpha_b (dimmer glow) as the light burns, staying brighter than the environment until the clear wave takes it to zero. Per-tile spread jitter makes the wavefronts irregular; in a big blast the wave_gap spacing makes the rings read as distinct travelling waves. Used by any explosion that does not name its own light_effect. Phase two adds a screen-space shockwave: a refraction ring that warps the rendered scene as it expands (CPU mesh warp at present time; silently skipped on backends without RenderGeometry).

Fierier, longer-lingering variant for incendiary blasts: deeper orange A, dark-red B, wider wave spacing and stronger flicker/jitter so the rings are more pronounced and the edge more ragged. Slightly more opaque than the default while still a translucent light cover. Stronger, slightly slower shockwave with a wider refraction band.

Seven-stop rainbow blast, a demo of the N-stop colour ramp: red -> orange -> yellow -> green -> blue -> indigo -> violet, then a clear wave. Each stop is one expanding front (wave_gap spacing pulls the seven rings apart so they read as distinct travelling bands); smoothstep easing softens every hue/alpha transition. The opacity keyframes ride high then taper, so the inner bands stay bright while the outer violet fades. Wider/longer than the default so all seven rings have room to separate; includes a screen-shake and a disc shockwave for the full effect. Preview it with the debug 'Preview explosion VFX' command.

Muzzle flash for gunfire. A single bright, near-instant point: hot white core flashing to muzzle-orange, gone in ~90ms. High flicker for a live, uneven spark; no shockwave; a tiny screen shake so heavy guns have a little kick. Triggered per shot from Character::fire_gun (suppressed for silenced / low-loudness / archery weapons and only when the muzzle tile is visible). Single tile, so duration_per_tile_ms barely matters; the floor keeps it snappy.

Bullet impact spark. A minimal white-to-grey point at the point of impact (any tile: creature, wall, ground, or a clean miss). Even faster and fainter than the muzzle flash, no screen shake. Played from projectile_attack at the trajectory end.

Faint bullet tracer. A very dim, brief warm-white line swept from muzzle to impact along the flight path, drawn under the per-tile bullet sprite for visible normal-bullet shots. Single stop, low alpha, quick fade, no shockwave or shake; meant to read as a streak, not a beam.

Laser beam (red). Bright crimson line from muzzle to impact, fast fade, with a directional shockwave so the beam visibly refracts the scene along its axis. Used for LASER ammo and the BULLETS_AS_LASERS option fallback.
Plasma beam (cyan-green). Hotter, slightly thicker energy bolt for PLASMA ammo. Brighter core and stronger refraction than the laser.
Lightning arc (white-blue). For LIGHTNING ammo: a stark blue-white bolt with strong flicker and a sharp, fast refraction snap.

EMP / electromagnetic detonation. Blue-white electric flash with strong flicker and no fiery embers: a quick rise, cool-toned stops, short duration, and a fast, sharp refraction ring. For EMP grenades and similar.

Flashbang. A single blinding white stop held near-opaque, longer than a blast and with a strong screen shake, then a clean fade. No colour ramp (just white) and no shockwave refraction — it is glare, not a pressure wave.
Gas / smoke release. A slow, low-opacity green-yellow haze with a long lifetime, soft flicker and no shockwave — reads as billowing vapour rather than a flash. For toxic gas, acid, and smoke clouds.

Enhanced incendiary blast. Deeper, longer-burning fire than fire_blast: orange -> deep red -> ember stops, slow waves, heavy flicker and a long tail, with a strong slow shockwave. For napalm / thermobaric / clinging-fire explosions.

Neutral smoke release (grey, not toxic green). Unlike the blast recipes this is NOT an outward-sweeping ring: wave_travel is near zero so the whole puff appears together, jitter (not radius) drives per-tile arrival for an irregular cloud edge, and it holds at low opacity then fades softly over a long life. Reads as billowing smoke settling in place rather than an explosion bloom. For smoke bombs / smoke mortars; distinct from gas_cloud (green-yellow toxic vapour).

Mining zones are useful to remove pavement, for instance. Firing blackpowder loads from a gun fouls it, which reduces reliability and, if left uncleaned, leads to rust.  It fouls the gun much faster than the use of modern smokeless powder cartridges.  Fouling is only a significant impact on reliability at high levels, but black powder fouling accumulates quickly.

Either this gun is brand new and came without lubrication or it was recently cleaned with a solvent without oiling afterwards.  Either way, it's not lubricated and will not cycle properly, and can even be damaged.

Fouling is caused by firing gunpowder loads repeatedly, which reduces reliability and can eventually cause damage to the gun.  Fouling accumulates slowly (unless blackpowder is used) due to the design of modern smokeless powder found in the vast majority of retail cartridges and it is not a significant problem until high levels of fouling are reached due to firing thousands of rounds without cleaning your firearm.

You cannot understand how or why someone would build an elevator shaft going into the depths of the earth like this for reasons other than mining.  It's bottom, if there is one, seems to be far past where light penetrates.

false_effect.u_message: You look down and see the elevator shaft going deeper than you expected.  Much deeper to where you can no longer see beyond.

effect.u_message: You receive an uncontrollable compulsion to step forward into the open elevator shaft.  As you step into the open air… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches… THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

You climb down as far as you can and then you let go… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You try to count but every so often you scrape up against the wall abrading the skin from your limbs, and bruising you to the bone.  You pass out long before you ever hit the bottom.

…Against all odds, you come back to your senses somewhere near the facility; your head still pounding from the inscrutable agony you went though.  Somehow your body has been reverted back to the state right before your fall.
Jump where?  There's nothing to jump to.  Just the other side of the elevator shaft.  There's no ledge over there or stairs, just flat wall.

As you step into the open air… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches…  THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

As you ascend, you inexplicably lose purchase and orientation, and then… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches…  THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

data.name: laser chamber
data.description: A large section of metal tubing, balanced on spring supports to prevent any vibration from affecting the laser inside.

data.name: spatial compressor
data.description: A dizzyingly complex series of devices and readouts is on the outside of this machine's casing.  You imagine the inside would be incomprehensible.

data.name: fractal compressor
data.description: This space is infinite, and has no beginning or end.  But you can see both right here, in this churning mass of angles.

data.name: unfolded laser chamber
data.description: You can see the inside surface of this tube, and what it contains.  Thick, slimy red light oozes within it.

bash.sound: a hollow pop, followed by a sickly wet squelching as congealed light slowly leaks out of the tube.

data.name: leaking laser chamber
data.description: Gobbets of congealed light drip from the gash in the side of this chamber like hot marmalade.

data.name: concrete floor
data.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

data.name: reinforced concrete wall
data.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

data.name: precision laser emitter
data.description: A huge casing for a device that generates and focuses a laser of an incredibly precise wavelength.

data.name: wall of flat space
data.description: From a distance, this looks like where the chamber ends; a flat wall, with a very detailed painting of a tunnel behind it.  But as you get closer, you can see how it ripples, like lazy water, and notice angles of the space beyond that a flat image could never give.

data.name: unfolded machinery
data.description: This inscrutable device is filled with wires, boards, and connections.  You can see every one of them, and it gives you a headache.

data.name: photonic conduit
data.description: You can see through the metal casing of this tube, into the blazing light coursing through it.

data.name: whiteboard
data.description: A wide space of whiteboard, for writing on with washable markers.  No one has washed it in a long time, though; it is covered in dense scrawls of equations and waveform diagrams.
A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It's plugged in and ready to go.
This device effectively sterilizes water.  Activate it to clean all water in a connected tank, at the cost of some electricity.
A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be played.
An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Plugged in and ready to go.
An electric forge, plugged in and ready to be used for metalworking.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a forge, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.

An electric kiln for baking brick or clay.  When plugged in and powered you could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Plugged in and ready to go.

A self-contained pneumatic power hammer using compressed air from an integrated compressor to strike repeatedly with great force.  Used for efficiently shaping and working metal.  Plugged in and ready to smash!

data.name: tempering kiln
data.description: A very long electric kiln made for heat treating metal.  Unlike a forge, it can't get extremely hot, but its temperature is completely programmable.
A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Plugged in and ready to go.
This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Plugged in and ready to go.

A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.
If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Plugged in and ready to go.
This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  Plugged in and ready to go.
A makeshift appliance which decomposes water into oxygen and hydrogen via electrolysis of sodium hydroxide solution, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  It has a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via the Haber-Bosch process, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

An autoclave that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.  This one is plugged into a power grid and running off internal water tanks.

A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When turned on, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

A small device for recharging batteries integrated into a small wooden storage compartment.  When turned on, it will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

A rather heavy brick of metal housing an ASRG, formerly designed by NASA and repurposed for terrestrial use.  Will provide about 130 W, basically forever as far as you're concerned.  Even though the alpha radiation these run off of isn't very dangerous in case of a breach, this unit appears to be armored to take a beating and is a good deal heavier owing to its composite plating.
A microwave connected to a power grid, ready to cook some food.
A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  It has been plugged into a power grid.
A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  It has been plugged into a power grid.

An electric crucible, powered by your electric grid.  Designed for melting large quantities of glass for batch crafting and production of large items, it needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
An industrial-grade lathe, for turning chunks of metal and other hard things into round chunks of metal and other hard things.
A machinist's one knee vertical mill, commonly known as a Bridgeport.  Used to shape blocks of metal into various parts.
An industrial deep fryer, for frying huge batches of food at once.

data.name: industrial oil press
data.description: A heavy-duty press used to create vegetable oil from nuts or seeds.

A huge, pot-bellied device that resembles something between a coal-burning stove and a boiler, with a wide, hinged cage covering the combustion chamber.  Three unmarked gauges sit like alien eyes upon its face.  A side-mounted crank is its only visible control.  In defiance of its apparent function, it has no exhaust vent; in its place is a hose twisted on itself several times, coiled in copper, and terminating in a bulbous back-mounted battery pack.
An electric cooker connected to a power grid.  Place raw food inside and activate it to automatically cook meals.

A stationary bank of interconnected steel tanks holding up to 600 liters of liquid.  Its electric heater can be switched on to keep the contents from freezing, while attached plumbing equipment can provide convenient access or purification.
A small, portable generator, one that people buy for a camp.  It just needs to be fueled up, and then turned on.
