data.name: glowing tendril
data.description: A willowy tendril growing from the floor, gently waving back and forth.  A faint light spills from it.

data.name: wafting anemone
data.description: A fleshy white protuberance growing from the floor, with a cluster of tendrils protruding from it.  It looks almost exactly like a sea anemone, even waving gently as though underwater.

data.name: gasping tube
data.description: A meaty green stalactite with a thickened hide like that of a starfish, extending from the floor to the ceiling.  In the center is a series of ports somewhat like mouths, from which pour bursts of a vile-smelling gas.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: twitching frond
data.description: A spine resembling moth antennae juts from the ground, swaying gently in the air.  Every so often, a cascade of energy arcs along it and discharges into the ceiling.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: scarred lump
data.description: A pile of nondescript alien flesh, twitching and belching strange gases out of injured orifices.
data.//: TODO: Make a custom toxic gas emission that is not visible to the player

data.name: slimy pod
data.description: A slick, translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  It is covered in a thick mucus, obscuring whatever is floating in the gel-like substance inside.

data.name: organ pod
data.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside you can see the dimly outlined shape of human organs, floating in some kind of preservative goo.

data.name: resin pod
data.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside is a clean, clear, resinous-looking fluid.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and take it with you.

data.name: fleshy altar
data.description: This pulsing protuberance juts from the floor, its sides covered in scaled, oozing skin.  The surface is flat, but undulates softly.  A handful of unidentifiable appendages reach from the sides, suggesting a sort of nightmarish living Autodoc.

data.name: scrap antenna
data.description: This contraption looks like some sort of cobbled-together transmitter or receiver antenna.  It consists of a number of mismatched blinking lights, spinning servos, and dangling wires connected to a hefty metal box.

data.name: pictographic signpost
data.description: This simple scrap metal sign has a series of pictographs on it depicting what seems to be a trade interaction.  There is a crude but understandable map beneath it.  You should take a closer look.

effect.u_message: You study the signpost.  It shows a similar set of directions to the ones you already have.  You cross-reference them and don't learn anything new.

You study the signpost.  It shows simply-drawn pictograms of a pair of hands holding out an object, and another pair taking the object and offering a pouch in return.  Beneath the pictures there's a crude but understandable map with arrows pointing to what looks like some kind of castle.  You do your best to relate those to landmarks you know about, and mark the likely location on your map.

data.name: rack of robots
data.description: A wire cage containing a number of robot parts, from chassis to limbs, firmly clamped onto sturdy hanging rods.  It looks like it would be exceptionally difficult to open it and get at them without damaging them, probably by design.

data.name: spinning dish
data.description: A slowly-spinning parabolic dish engraved with an unrecognizable pattern of symbols that might, at a guess, be some sort of circuitry pattern - or maybe a religious incantation.  It is mounted on a completely mismatched electric motor that looks fairly mundane.

data.name: scavenged utility light
data.description: The bulbs emit an eerie greenish glow, and some parts of it have a curved appearance as though the metal were grown in a lab, but by and large this isn't a particularly unusual looking area light.

data.name: warped utility light
data.description: This bizarre lamp is only in two dimensions - it has no depth, like an impossibly thin cardboard cutout.  The bulbs emit an eerie greenish glow, and some parts of it have a curved appearance as though the metal were grown in a lab.

data.name: clanking fluid pump
data.description: The huge, sweating pipes and large tank reveal this clanking and tortuous piece of equipment to be some sort of fluid pump.  It is cobbled together from several apparently ill-fitting parts that have been fitted with some very strange-looking but surprisingly clever adapters.

data.name: metalloid printer
data.description: This huge device fairly closely resembles a 3D printer, aside from its industrial size.  Huge spools of various thin metallic wires atop it feed into what seems to be some sort of nozzle, and massive electrical cables disappear into the wall behind it.

data.name: circuit printer
data.description: A tall device with a lattice of pipes and nozzles.  Based on the pile of products sitting in the output hopper, it looks like it's used as a printer for complex electronic components.

data.name: Mavrik 10-101 power core
data.description:
There is a faded metallic plaque on the side of this cylindrical device.  The lettering is a strange combination of English and Cyrillic script.  It reads:
Mavrik 10-101
Stabиlиtи
Saфetи
A нyuclиar фyutuр ви bilив iн

data.name: spherical generator
data.description: This huge steel-plated sphere gives off a soft hum as it, presumably, generates power.  A heavy lead plate bolted to the front might describe what it is, but it is written in something that looks vaguely like cuneiform.

data.name: fluidic generator
data.description: Twisting reams of copper and steel pipes wrap around a central core that thrums softly.  Although there are no labels in any language you recognize, the cables connected to the base suggest that this is some sort of power generator.

data.name: rusty generator
data.description: A tall, unremarkable cylinder capped by a wide, flat saucer.  There is heavy rusting at the base.  A series of connected cables suggest that it's some sort of power generator.

data.name: personal charging station
data.description: The cyborg equivalent of a bed, this is a custom-shaped near-vertical booth designed to mount a heavy metal frame and connect it to a central power supply and nutrient source.

data.name: simple charging station
data.description: A simple, unadorned, corroded metal charging and feeding station, with hookups for two units somewhat larger than a human to stand side by side and be recharged and refueled.

data.name: shimmering superstructure
data.description: A simple metal superstructure like you might see holding up a radio tower, this one seems to give off just the faintest hint of shimmer, like heat waves.  The metal has a burnt, iridescent pattern.  There is a boxy, unimpressive-looking device at the top of the tower.

data.name: portal enclosure
data.description: A heavy metal ring attached to dozens of wires, charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

data.name: metal ring
data.description: A heavy metal ring sitting on the floor, surrounding a spot charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

data.name: metal ring
data.description: A heavy metal ring sitting on the floor, surrounding a spot charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

data.name: locator antenna
data.description: A tall metal pole solidly fixed to the roof.  It does not look activated but there's a small set of holes near its base, maybe something could be plugged in one to reboot the locator.

effect.u_message: The locator is already active
You don't have anything that could reactivate this device

You plug the rebooter in the locator.
<color_light_green>The locator reactivates.</color>

data.name: crystalline flower
data.description: A crystalline structure that resembles a plant.
data.//: decorative flora for breather biome.

data.name: less than nothing
data.description: There is nothing here.  Not even time or space.

data.name: impaled officer
data.description: A dead body encased in high-tech armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.
A dead body encased in military armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.
data.name: impaled mercenary
empty spike
data.description: A strange otherworldly spike that refracts light in strange ways.  The body no longer rests on it.

effect.u_message: The body is gone but it can't have gone far, you need to destroy it.

data.name: humming fluid pump
data.description: A large tank connected to several pumps, driven by some unseen mechanism.

data.name: humming column
data.description: A floor-to-ceiling cylinder wrapped neatly and tightly in thick copper wire.  It has no markings, but the cables connected to the base suggest that it generates or receives some kind of power.

data.name: inert column
data.description: A floor-to-ceiling cylinder wrapped neatly and tightly in thick copper wire.  It has no markings, but the cables connected to the base suggest that it generates or receives some kind of power.  Perhaps it once worked, but it is now still and silent.
A metal vent on the floor.

data.name: metal container
data.description: An extremely dense metal box.  It has a door with a heavy latch.  A golden plate is affixed to the door, covered in letters you do not understand.  Examine it to use the lever on the door.

data.name: imploded clump of metal
data.description: An extremely dense ball of imploded metal.

data.name: tall vent pipe
data.description: A thick pipe for some sort of ventilation system.  It looks sturdy enough to climb.

data.name: lead tube
data.description: A massive lead tube covered in otherworldly symbols that you do not understand.

data.name: warped utility shelf
data.description: What was once a simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit has been cleaved into three pieces, now mysteriously floating in space in a stair-like pattern, disconnected entirely from each another.

data.name: glowing metal crate
data.description: While this box certainly resembles a large storage crate, its panels are impossibly thin planes of magenta light.

data.name: cooling unit
data.description: A large, blocky appliance encased in sheet metal.  This commonplace fixture is used for cooling large indoor areas.

data.name: central air filter
data.description: A large synthetic membrane used to filter out dust, smoke, mites, and other contaminants from air that passes through it.

data.name: dishwasher
data.description: A large, boxy machine that uses hot water and soap to efficiently clean batches of dishes.  Now that it's sat powerless for a while, a putrid scent of rot is leaking from inside.

data.name: dryer
data.description: A common household appliance used to quickly dry large batches of clothing after they have been washed.

data.name: furnace
data.description: A gas-powered forced-air central heating unit, with an internal fan to push the air through a building's ventilation system to keep it warm.

data.name: washing machine
data.description: An appliance used to clean laundry.  It needs to be plugged into a grid that provides it with electricity and large amounts of water to be used.

data.name: oven
data.description: A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  You could disconnect it and plug it into a working power grid.

data.name: electric cooker
data.description: An electric cooker designed to automatically heat and cook food placed inside.  You could disconnect it and plug it into a working power grid.

data.name: gas oven
data.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It can safely contain a fire, although it's not adequately ventilated.

data.name: gas oven and microwave combo
data.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  This one has an attached microwave.  It can safely contain a fire, although it's not adequately ventilated.  You could disassemble the shelving holding them together and pull the microwave out.

data.name: blacksmith bellows
data.description: An old device for pushing air into a blacksmith's forge to strengthen the fire and maintain a high temperature.  Useless in its current state, but good for parts.

data.name: blacksmith drop hammer
data.description: An anvil with a large metal hammer suspended above it in a metal framework.  It would be useful for shaping softened metal plates, or you could use the anvil by itself.

data.name: vertical mill
data.description: A one knee vertical milling machine, commonly known as a Bridgeport.  Used to shape blocks of metal into useful parts.  You can disconnect it to install somewhere else.

data.name: document shredder
data.description: A simple electronic device mounted to a large basket.  It is designed to efficiently destroy paper documents with sensitive information.  Good for parts, as identity theft and corporate espionage probably aren't big concerns anymore.

data.name: server stack
data.description: A large rack of specialized computers for storing and transmitting information.  Powerless and largely useless for its intended purpose, the laptops mounted inside can still be used if removed.

data.name: supercomputer
data.description: Hanging platters assembled into an inverted cone, their positions kept stable by dense threading of copper cabling.

data.name: large satellite dish
data.description: A large, concave metal panel with simple electronics used to receive signals from satellites.  While the hundreds of expensive machines orbiting the planet will likely continue to function indefinitely, their various purposes have all been lost.

data.name: mounted polycrystalline solar panel
data.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses less efficient polycrystalline solar panels.

data.name: mounted monocrystalline solar panel
data.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses more efficient monocrystalline solar panels.

data.name: oxygen concentrator
data.description: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  It needs power to function.

data.name: high pressure compressor unit
data.description: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  It needs large amounts of power to function.

data.name: deep fryer
data.description: An industrial deep fryer, for frying huge batches of food at once.  You could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

data.name: road barricade
data.description: A large wooden blockade used to block passage through a road.  It is lined with reflective tape to increase visibility.  Despite the name, it does little to stop a moving car.

data.name: gravelbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of stacked gravelbags, uncommonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

data.name: gravelbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked gravelbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: earthbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of stacked earthbags, commonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

data.name: earthbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked earthbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: lane guard
data.description: A simple wooden post to mark the separation between street lanes.

data.name: sandbag barricade
data.description: A low wall made of canvas sacks filled with sand, commonly used to catch bullets and prevent flooding.

data.name: sandbag wall
data.description: A wall of stacked sandbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

data.name: show jump
data.description: A show jump made of a long pole, suitable for showing off your equestrian skills.

data.name: show jump
data.description: The end of a show jump made of planks.

data.name: scattered seaweed
data.description: Seaweed and other detritus, scattered along the high water line of the beach.

data.name: driftwood
data.description: A hollow and twisted piece of a root or a branch, bleached white by sun and salt.

data.name: standing mirror
data.description: A full-length mirror mounted in a sleek aluminum frame.  You can easily see all of the dirt and blood on your clothes, and the weariness in your eyes.

data.name: broken standing mirror
data.description: An aluminum frame for a full-length mirror, with most of the mirror missing.  What remains in the frame are large, dangerous-looking shards of fractured glass.

data.name: bitts
data.description: A pair of vertical iron posts mounted on a wharf, pier, or other form of dock.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

data.name: cleat
data.description: A small horn cleat with two "horns" extending parallel to the deck or the axis of the spar, and resembling a small anvil.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

data.name: manacles
data.description: A pair of metal shackles with heavy chains mounted to a wall or floor.

data.name: statue
data.description: A massive block of stone that has been carefully carved into a work of timeless art.

data.name: statue
data.description: All fine details have been eroded away by the passing of time, leaving only a rough humanoid shape carved from dark stone.

data.name: statue of a gatekeeper
data.description: A demonic figure carved from dark stone stands guard over the bronze pillars ahead.  It holds a bronze censer with one outstretched hand, while the other points upwards into the sky.

data.name: mannequin
data.description: A life-size wooden figure of a person, most commonly used to display clothing in stores, or for tailors to design outfits on.  Considering all that's happened, something about it is somewhat unnerving.

data.name: birdbath
data.description: A wide stone bowl mounted to a pedestal, usually filled with rainwater, meant for birds to play or bathe in.

data.name: gazing ball
data.description: A mirrored glass globe mounted on a cement pedestal.  It warps your reflection when you look into it.

data.name: rotary clothes dryer line
data.description: A central metal pole holding up a wide rotating frame, this would be used to hang up clothes to dry in the sunlight.

data.name: standing lamp
data.description: A light mounted on the top of a metal pole, this would be plugged into a wall socket to illuminate a room.

data.name: lighthouse light
data.description: Very high power, modern lighthouse LED light source with attached heatsinks.

data.name: pine wreath
data.description: A decorative wreath for the winter holidays.

data.name: sand castle
data.description: A glorious castle made of sand.  This mighty fortress will stand tall for the ages to come, a true testament to the skills of its builder.

data.name: decorative tree
data.description: A decorative pine tree littered with ornaments for the winter holidays.

data.name: styling station
data.description: A styling station, is a countertop with a mirror mounted above it and just enough room and cubbies to store a stylist's equipment on it.

data.name: indoor flagpole
data.description: A 2.5-meter tall flagpole on a weighted stand.  You could hoist up a flag here.

data.name: wooden indoor flagpole
data.description: A 2.5-meter tall wooden flagpole on a weighted stand.  You could hoist up a flag here.

data.name: indoor plant
data.description: A small potted plant, used for decoration indoors.  It appears to have dried up and died a while ago.

data.name: yellow indoor plant
data.description: A decorative potted plant with a yellow flower, it looks to have wilted and died some time ago.

data.name: overgrown plant
data.description: This patch of green used to be a cultivated field or some sort of monocrop agriculture.  Neglected for too long, it has been overtaken by nature.

data.name: harvestable plant
data.description: This plant is fully grown and ready to be harvested.  Identifying how to harvest it requires closer examination.

data.name: mature plant
data.description: This plant has matured, and will be ready to harvest before long.

data.name: seed
data.description: A freshly planted seed.  If properly tended to, it could grow into a healthy plant.

data.name: seedling
data.description: A seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

data.name: planter
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.

data.name: planter with dead plants
data.description: Somewhere beneath this heap of dying plants you can see the shape of wooden furniture.  Left without care, the plants it used to nurture have shriveled and died.

data.name: planter with harvestable plant
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a fully grown plant, and will need closer examination to harvest.

data.name: planter with mature plant
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a matured plant that should be ready for harvest before long.

data.name: planter with seed
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one contains a planted seed, and will need attention to grow fully.

data.name: planter with seedling
data.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

data.name: grain stook
data.description: Sheaves of cut grain have been stood upright in a self-supporting A-frame to dry, keeping the seeds off the ground and out of reach of vermin.

data.name: stooking spot
data.description: A space has been cleared out here for grain drying.  Place fresh stalks of grain in this spot and examine to set up a stook.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A sizable, off-white sac of large eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving slightly.  Gross.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A bulbous mass of off-white spider eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving a bit.  Really gross.

data.name: spider egg sac
data.description: A gigantic sac of spider eggs, each one larger than your fist.  They're definitely moving around.  Really gross, just seeing it makes your skin crawl.

data.name: ruptured egg sac
data.description: A disgusting, ruptured sac of giant spider eggs.  The thought of all those massive baby spiders pouring out of it is almost terrifying on its own.

data.name: swamp gas
data.description: A pool of murky water that occasionally bubbles, releasing a mildly toxic gas.
data.//: a very mild toxicant, inducing nausea.

data.name: fog

data.description: A metal vent.  You can feel cool air seeping out of it.
A metal vent.  You can feel cold air blasting out of it.
A metal vent.  You can feel hot air seeping out of it.
A metal vent.  You can feel hot air seeping out of it.
A metal vent.  Toxic-looking clouds seep from it.
A metal vent.  Toxic-looking clouds stream from it.
A metal vent.
A misty cloud of water vapor.

data.name: fireplace
data.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

data.name: stone fireplace
data.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

data.name: wood stove
data.description: A simple metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

data.name: brazier
data.description: A raised metal dish in which to safely burn things.

data.name: makeshift brazier
data.description: A metal bucket with holes, in which you can safely start a fire.  It's too small to fit any fuel item larger than some splintered wood.

data.name: hobo stove
data.description: A small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can.  It's too small to fit any fuel much larger than splintered wood.

data.name: portable stove
data.description: A foldable metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

data.name: fire barrel (200 L)
data.description: A huge metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

data.name: fire barrel (100 L)
data.description: A large metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

data.name: fire ring
data.description: A ring of stones to safely contain a fire.

data.name: clay oven
data.description: A simple clay oven with a chimney, with a firebrick alcove in the middle that can be used to cook food or just to contain a fire.

data.name: parabolic solar cooker
data.description: A faceted reflector dish on a tripod that concentrates sunlight into a focal point for cooking.  Only works outdoors in strong direct sunlight.

data.name: mutated poppy flower
data.description: These strange flowers have appeared in the wake of the Cataclysm, and their buds can be used for medicinal purposes, like the buds of the mundane poppy they're named after.  The dirt around it gently churns as its roots writhe beneath the soil, and it's surrounded by an overwhelming floral smell that makes you feel sleepy.

data.name: dandelion
data.description: A common weed with a yellow flower.  Produces seeds that get carried on the wind by thin, gray filaments.

data.name: burdock
data.description: A common weed with a purple thistle-like flower.  Its seeds tend to stick to clothing and fur.

data.name: wild carrot
data.description: A common white wildflower which could be harvested for its root.

data.name: wild asparagus
data.description: A perennial plant cultivated for its young edible shoots, commonly called spears.  When raw and growing naturally, the plant has a distinctive appearance that changes through its life cycle.

data.name: starry false Solomon's seal
data.description: The blossoms of this flower look like stars in the night sky.  Its crimson berries are edible.

data.name: salsify
data.description: Tragopogon porrifolius, a ragged-looking purple flower with a nutritious root.
data.//: Root can always be harvested, but there is no flower to harvest seeds from in winter.

data.name: chamomile
data.description: A cute white flower with a yellow center, used to brew a soothing tea.

data.name: tulip
data.description: A bright, colorful flower with petals forming a small cup at its top.  It can be poisonous to livestock.

data.name: spurge flower
data.description: A yellow-green flower that grows in densely-packed bushes.

data.name: cattails
data.description: This useful plant is available all year round.  Many parts of the plant are edible.

data.name: black eyed Susan
data.description: A mildly poisonous yellow flower with a dark ball in the middle.  Sometimes known as an ox-eye daisy.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: lily
data.description: A pretty flower that comes in a variety of colors.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: lotus
data.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of fresh water.  A traditional symbol of many Eastern cultures.
data.//: Add flower and bud spawns once useful.

data.name: sunflower
data.description: A tall, wide-headed flower with a large dark center.  Produces many nutritious seeds.

data.name: Jerusalem artichoke plant
data.description: Looking similar to a sunflower, this tall plant has a nutritious tuber.

data.name: lilypad
data.description: This lilypad doesn't look like it would support the weight of the things you've heard croaking in the swamp.

data.name: bluebell
data.description: A common bluebell flower.  Pretty.

data.name: dahlia
data.description: A puffy flower with many tightly-layered petals.

data.name: chicory
data.description: A blue flower imported from Europe, also known as a cornflower.

data.name: datura
data.description: A pretty moonflower.

data.name: pile of leaves
data.description: A sizable pile of leaves.  You could sleep on it if you don't care about comfort or warmth.

data.name: mustard
data.description: A yellow flower known as Brassica Nigra.  Known for its seeds that can be used for making table mustard.

data.name: wild sarsaparilla
data.description: A small, flowering plant known as 'Aralia nudicaulis'.  It is colored in vibrant shades of orange and red in autumn, making it easy to spot.

data.name: wintergreen
data.description: A small shrub native to North America.  The leaves, which remain green even in winter, are valued for medicinal purposes.  It produces edible and sweet berries, too!
data.//: green all year long

data.name: Japanese knotweed
data.description: An invasive species originating from Japan.  The stem looks like it might contain some water.

data.name: fireweed
data.description: Vibrant purple, it tends to be the first to appear after fires, hence its name.

data.name: common selfheal
data.description: A small purple flower.  It got its name due to its usage in traditional medicine.

data.name: spreading dogbane
data.description: It is not only toxic to dogs when eaten by them.  Humans and many other animals are affected, too.  Its fibers sure are worth salvaging though.  Despite its name, it is not actually spreading fast.

data.name: thistle
data.description: A prickly and invasive small plant.

data.name: purple loosestrife
data.description: A pretty violet flower that likes water.  Unfortunately it is invasive and does not benefit the environment.

data.name: wild rice
data.description: Also called Indian rice, Northern wild rice, or manoomin in Ojibwe, is a species of rice that has been harvested and used by Native American tribes of the northeast for hundreds of years.  It's similar to other types of wild rice, offering a fiber-rich and healthy basis of a meal.

data.name: short hedge
data.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.

data.name: tall hedge
data.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.  You can't see past this thick hedgerow.

data.name: abstract topiary
data.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a fanciful abstract shape.

data.name: animal topiary
data.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into an animal shape.

data.name: animal topiary
data.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a dragon shape.

data.name: dam
data.description: A house that beavers built.  The entrance is underwater making it harder for predators to access.

data.name: red algae
data.description: One of the thousands of species of grassy reddish marine plants that inhabit intertidal zones the world over.  Its rubbery little fronds don't look particularly edible.

data.name: green algae
data.description: A short patch of grassy green seaweed, wholly unremarkable.

data.name: sugar kelp
data.description: Also known as kombu, this brown algae grows in a single leaflike blade that can reach more than twice the height of a man.  Young fronds make for excellent soup stock and can even be eaten raw.

data.name: sea lettuce
data.description: Sometimes known as green laver, this leafy algae from the Ulva genus grows in leafy little patches around shallows and tide pools.  Though small, it makes a tasty snack.

data.name: bladderwrack
data.description: Named for the air bladders that grow all over its leafy fronds, this leafy seaweed is technically edible and has a long history of use in folk medicine.

data.name: sea anemone
data.description: This sessile polyp waves its stinging tentacles with the motion of the tides, hoping to capture a tiny fish or crab.  It's wholly inedible and poses no danger to anything bigger than a shrimp.

data.name: sea sponge
data.description: An immobile, lumpy little creature that looks nothing like a square kitchen sponge.  Anchored to the sea floor, its porous body passively filters plankton from the water that freely passes through it.

data.name: Marloss flower
data.description: This flower looks mostly like the other flowers taken by the mushrooms, but its bulb is a brilliant cyan color.  It emits an aroma that is both overwhelming and strangely alluring.

data.name: fungal flower
data.description: This flower has been overgrown by gray, sinewy tendrils of fungus, and the color has been leached from its petals and stem.  It gently sways of its own volition, maintaining an unsettling rhythm.

data.name: fungal mass
data.description: Thick ropes of Mycal matter have covered the ground here completely.  It's soft to the touch, but not firm enough to hold any weight.

data.name: fungal clump
data.description: Alien mold and stems mingle tightly here, swaying around and weaving together, creating a sort of fungal bush.

data.name: fungal tangle
data.description: Thick, ropy tendrils of fungus have risen from the ground and gathered into an impenetrable clump.

data.name: stone slab
data.description: A slab of heavy stone, with a reasonably flat surface.

data.name: stone sarcophagus
data.description: A large stone coffin, adorned with reliefs depicting figures in various poses of mourning.  The lid is firmly sealed, and the interior is inaccessible.

data.name: broken stone sarcophagus
data.description: A large stone coffin, adorned with reliefs depicting figures in various poses of mourning.  Its been desecrated and looted.

data.name: royal sarcophagus
data.description: An army of ossified figures marches across the four sides of this massive stone coffin, their procession led by a regal figure whose features are obscured by a veil.  The lid is firmly sealed, and whatever lies within is inaccessible.

data.name: broken royal sarcophagus
data.description: Pieces of the stone reliefs are scattered across the floor, and the lid has been shattered to allow access to the interior.

data.name: headstone
data.description: A large slab of stone, engraved with information on the deceased individual buried beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the uncountable losses of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

data.name: gravestone
data.description: An upright slab of stone with information engraved on the face about whoever lies beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the countless casualties of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

data.name: worn gravestone
data.description: An aged and eroded gravestone, damaged to the point of rendering the inscription illegible.  Whoever's buried here was probably lucky enough to pass before all this chaos began.

data.name: obelisk
data.description: A magnificent carved statue with an engraved plaque fixed to the base.  It serves to honor the passing of somebody significant, something one wishes was still a practical goal.

data.name: battlefield cross
data.description: A makeshift memorial marker, made of a service rifle - buried in the dirt, or nestled in a pair of boots - with a helmet perched on the stock.  A small way to honor the dead.
A large vat with a motorized mixing device for combining large quantities of chemicals.

broken generator
data.description: This generator is broken and will not help you produce usable electricity.

data.name: Compact Advanced Sterling Radioisotope Generator
data.description: This hefty lump of steel and lead is the housing unit for a Stirling generator powered by plutonium-238, originally designed by NASA and repurposed by the military.  It is plastered with warning signs.  It's really heavy owing to the thick armor plating, but you could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

data.name: mobile antenna
data.description: A stark black directional antenna, seemingly part of a monitoring setup.  An LED mounted on its back lights up with a lazy and irregular rhythm.

data.name: mobile antenna
data.description: A mix of mundane and otherworldly devices deployed from the top of a sleek black case.  It is equipped with a built-in analysis computer, a small thermal printer, and a rechargeable battery.  The case itself is outfitted with back straps and a telescoping stand.  "X.E.D.R.A." and "HE weather station" are engraved on the case.

data.description: Assorted light machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

data.description: Assorted heavy machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

data.description: Assorted electronic machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

data.name: robotic arm
data.description: An automated robotic arm used in assembly lines, which appears to be more general-purpose than specially designed assemblers.  Despite being functionless now, the parts could be useful.

data.description: A bunch of loose cables snake along the floor.

data.description: A thick bundle of electrical wiring protected by a metal conduit.

data.name: capacitor bank
data.description: A bank of heavy metal cylinders connected by large wires.

data.name: control station
data.description: Assorted electronic interfaces and screens.  You could scavenge it for parts.

data.name: nuclear fuel cell
data.description: This fuel assembly consists of cylindrical rods put into bundles.  A uranium oxide ceramic is formed into pellets and inserted into Zircaloy tubes that are bundled together.  The Zircaloy tubes are pressurized with helium to minimize pellet-cladding interaction which can lead to fuel rod failure over long periods.  This fuel cell is used in nuclear power stations to produce heat to power turbines.

data.name: metal detector
data.description: A metal detector like one you'd see at the airport.  This one is no longer functioning.

data.name: Balthazar's server racks
data.description: The servers Balthazar is running on.  Destroying these will severely damage, if not kill them.

data.name: Autodoc Mk. XI
data.description: A surgical apparatus used for the installation and removal of bionics.  The term name 'Autodoc' is something of a misnomer, as it can only operate if programmed beforehand, something that a plethora of labels warn against doing without expertise.

data.name: Autodoc operation couch
data.description: A plush red sofa made less comfortable by the medical machinery directly above it.  It has a single leather strap on the right armrest.

data.name: autoclave
data.description: A device that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.

data.name: filled autoclave
data.description: A device that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.

data.name: sample freezer
data.description: A specialized freezer capable of maintaining temperatures of -80 Celsius, best used for the preservation of delicate scientific samples.

data.name: lab workbench
data.description: A metal storage cabinet topped with a durable resin countertop resistant to most chemical spills and burns.  It has wired-in electrical and gas fittings.
A metal hood atop a lab workspace, with durable glass shutters.  A fan in the hood draws fumes and smoke from dangerous chemicals up into a ventilation duct.
data.name: fume hood
shaker incubator
data.description: A tool for keeping chemical broth nicely mixed and at just the right temperature to grow bacteria.  Although more bacteria is probably the last thing you need, considering the circumstances.

data.name: emergency wash station
data.description: A standing sink with a pair of nozzles, along with a large, brightly-colored handle.  It is specially designed to quickly remove contaminants from the eyes, and is easily usable without being able to see very well.  A sizable notice warns against drinking the water it uses.

data.name: IV pole
data.description: A tall wire frame on a set of small wheels used for holding an IV bag, useful for unattended administration.

data.name: high-performance liquid chromatographer
data.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a liquid or aqueous phase, based on their affinity, to the stationary phase in a tube.  At least, that's what the label says.

data.name: gas chromatographer
data.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a gaseous phase, based on their affinity, to a stationary phase in a tube.  At least that's what the label says.

data.name: mass spectrometer
data.description: Inside this large white box is a carefully balanced set of electric field generators that can precisely separate ionized particles based on their charge-to-mass ratio, firing them into a detector that measures the exact mass of the particle hitting it.  Invaluable for chemical analysis and other advanced sciences, it's not as useful anymore.

data.name: nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer
data.description: A giant electromagnet with carefully tuned measurement equipment used to observe how magnetic fields affect nuclear spins.  It is a common workhorse for the discovery and study of chemical structures.

data.name: electron microscope
data.description: An enormous observational tool for studying the details of samples on an immensely small scale.

data.name: CT scanner
data.description: A massive piece of machinery used to take hundreds of X-ray images from 360 degrees, often used for medical examinations.

data.name: MRI machine
data.description: A massive tool used to take NMR images of a patient placed inside, providing invaluable medical insight.

data.name: scanner bed
data.description: A narrow, flat, and frankly uncomfortable bed for putting someone into an imaging machine for medical observations.

data.name: anesthetic machine
data.description: A large machine with various tanks, tubes, and monitoring devices used to maintain precise levels of anesthesia in a patient to ensure they, at least ideally, remain asleep, unfeeling, but alive.

data.name: dialysis machine
data.description: A large machine for pumping and filtering the blood of somebody without the function of their kidneys.

data.name: medical ventilator
data.description: A sizable box on a set of wheels that will pump air in and out of a patient's lungs when they are incapable of breathing, though often only needed temporarily.

data.name: privacy curtain
data.description: No peeking!

data.description: Stop peeking!

data.description: A centrifuge, a liquid separating device with an automated analyzer unit.

data.name: X-ray scanner
data.description: A table with a movable head, often used for medical examinations.

data.name: dental X-ray machine
data.description: A device for creating radiographic images of the teeth.

data.name: exam chair
data.description: A medical exam chair with an overhead light, bolted to the floor.

data.description: A massive, packed-together block of cement bags wrapped with plastic packaging.  It makes for easy storage of building materials for masonry constructions.

data.name: stack of wooden planks
data.description: Dozens of construction planks tied together for easier transport.  Deconstruct to untie them.

data.name: bathtub
data.description: An ordinary ceramic tub, with a now-functionless steel faucet and a plug fixed over the drain.  Watertight and relatively clean, it would make for a good water trough.

data.name: shower
data.description: A small enclosed ceramic room with a glass door and plumbing fixtures for cleaning oneself.  Before it was a commonplace amenity, but now it's hard to imagine wasting that much water.

data.name: sink
data.description: A porcelain water basin with a water tap and drain, designed to be fitted into an opening on a countertop.

data.name: sink with gravity-feed tank
data.description: A water basin with flowing water, fed by a tank suspended above.  A luxury when the water main is unavailable.  This one has a hand pump to refill from groundwater.
data.//COMMENT: Currently only used in NPC faction camps. Note that this is an infinite source of water if you use it elsewhere.

data.name: toilet
data.description: An invaluable fixture in any home, it would be a miracle to have one that works.  The standing tank may hold a moderate amount of water, but while better than anything that would be in the bowl, it would not be the cleanest.

data.name: water heater
data.description: An insulated metal tank with a small fire used to maintain near-boiling temperatures.  There's no longer any way to power it, but any water left in the large tank from before the power went out should be pretty clean, and it could be used to store large quantities of other liquids too.
data.//: keg_capacity assumed to be from model XE36S06ST45U0 water heater <https://images.thdstatic.com/catalog/pdfImages/2d/2d7ed116-1a8c-439d-b7fe-a62a0a98f806.pdf>

data.name: family–sized water heater
data.description: An insulated metal tank with a small fire used to maintain near-boiling temperatures.  There's no longer any way to power it, but any water left in the large tank from before the power went out should be pretty clean, and it could be used to store large quantities of other liquids too.
data.//: keg_capacity assumed to be from model XG55T06EC50UO water heater <https://images.thdstatic.com/catalog/pdfImages/7e/7e7928b1-8b4f-472a-8ee8-b48eb1e7932a.pdf>

data.name: water purifier
data.description: This device effectively sterilizes water.  You can plug it into a power grid to use it.

data.name: exercise machine
data.description: A heavy set of weightlifting equipment for strength training, with a pair of heavy weights affixed to opposite ends of a sturdy pipe.  You can adjust the set by hand-picking the weights you wish to use.

data.name: ball machine
data.description: A simple machine for launching sports balls of various types, with a pair of motorized wheels that, if spun up, would fling the ball at moderate speeds.  Probably not the most effective ranged weapon against the undead.

data.name: parkour bars
data.description: A complicated set of monkey bars, to be used by adults to train parkour.

data.name: pool table
data.description: A large wooden table with green felt carpeting on top, and a set of symmetrical holes that carry billiard balls to an opening on one side.  While not a good substitute for a normal table, you could take it apart for a substantial amount of wood.

data.name: diving block
data.description: A chunky plastic stool bolted onto the ground, intended as a safe way of diving forward into a body of water.

data.name: target
data.description: A long sheet of metal, cut into a roughly human shape and held upright by a pipe frame.  There are two bullseye targets painted onto it, a large one on the torso, and a smaller one on the head.  It is peppered with small dents and holes, and a large amount of the paint has flaked or chipped off.

data.name: arcade machine
data.description: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Useless for its intended purpose without power, it's bound to have valuable parts.

data.name: pinball machine
data.description: An iconic game, this machine has a brightly decorated background on its intricate obstacle course, which is covered by a long sheet of glass.  While inoperable without power, it's still impressive to look at, though probably more useful if disassembled.

data.name: ergometer
data.description: An exercise machine with a set of handles and plates meant to emulate rowing a boat.  Without power it can't be operated, but it might have useful parts to be scavenged.

data.name: mechanical ergometer
data.description: An exercise machine with a set of handles and plates meant to emulate rowing a boat.  This an older model with mechanical resistance adjustments, so it works without power.

data.name: treadmill
data.description: A motorized conveyor belt with a control panel for running in place.  Without power, it's an immense challenge to move the belt.  Regardless, you're probably getting enough cardio on your own.

data.name: gravity treadmill
data.description: A gravity-driven conveyor belt with a mechanical control panel for running in place.  The belt is positioned on an adjustable incline, so it slides back under your weight without needing to be powered.

data.name: heavy punching bag
data.description: A hefty, oblong leather bag, suspended from a ceiling mount with a steel chain.  It can be used for exercise and combat training, with the notable advantage that it doesn't fight back.

data.name: piano
data.description: An elegant piano, capable of producing beautiful music if used by a skilled player.  A set of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of hammers, which strike their corresponding tightly-coiled wire to produce sound.
data.//: While heavy, most large pianos have casters for relatively easy movement.

data.name: speaker cabinet
data.description: An upright wood-panel case of large speakers, built to produce a potentially deafening volume level.  While it would be a terrible idea to use this now, it could hold useful parts.

data.name: dancing pole
data.description: A tall steel pipe mounted vertically, securely fastened to the ceiling and floor.  Usually used for various forms of dancing, often in adult-oriented venues.

data.name: roulette table
data.description: A huge table specially made for a specific form of gambling, with a grid painted onto the felt top, and a concave spinning wheel intended to give a random selection of the inscribed possibilities.

data.name: pipe organ
data.description: A majestic pipe organ.  Dubbed "the king of instruments", it is capable of producing powerful sound harmonies if used by a skilled player.  Rows of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of iron pipes, which resonate at a specific pitch when pressurized air is driven through them.

data.name: training dummy
data.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is made from wood and has some duct tape to mark the striking points.  It has been erected in the ground on its post.

data.name: armored training dummy
data.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is covered in scrap armor and looks on guard.  It has been erected in the ground on its post.

data.name: box archery target
data.description: A soft target for archery consisting of tightly-packed cloth stuffed into a cardboard box, with a bullseye marked on the front.

data.name: bale archery target
data.description: A soft target for archery consisting of a bale of hay with a bullseye marked on the front.

data.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

data.name: cell phone signal booster
data.description: A specialized piece of equipment that receives phone signals and amplifies them to reach further destinations with more clarity.  Now that there's no longer signals for them to boost, they're only good for parts.

data.name: satellite dish
data.description: A small sheet metal disc designed to receive radio waves from orbital satellites.  Satellites that will assuredly continue to orbit, with nothing to broadcast.

data.name: chimney crown
data.description: The top of a brick chimney, the opening is stained black with soot.  Definitely too narrow to fit in.

data.name: TV antenna
data.description: A simple metal antenna to increase the reception of non-cable television broadcasts.  Almost wholly obsolete for years, only being good for parts isn't new for this item.

data.name: vent pipe
data.description: A sort of chimney spout for a building's internal ventilation system, this can be used for circulation, venting fumes, and other such functions.

data.name: wind vane
data.description: A metal fin that swivels around a central pivot, indicating the direction of prevailing wind.

data.name: roof turbine vent
data.description: A rotary wind turbine that will catch the wind and pull out air from inside.  It is most commonly used for improving air circulation, particularly in poorly-ventilated areas like attics.

data.name: bale of hay
data.description: A massive packed-together block of hay, it makes for easy storage of straw for livestock.  If your only other option is the floor, it makes a tolerable bed.

data.name: pile of woodchips
data.description: A large mound of piled wood chips.  Unpleasant to lay on, hard to walk through, and a large fire hazard, it's probably best to shovel it out of the way.

data.name: bench
data.description: A simple bench with wood slats nailed to a frame.  While uncomfortably flat and just as cold as the ground, it could serve as a bed if needed.

data.name: armchair
data.description: A simple upholstered chair with armrests.  Soft and fairly warm, it definitely beats the ground for sleeping on, though not by much.

data.name: airplane seat
data.//: Used in airliner.json, it yields short rope as a seatbelt
data.description: A cheaply-upholstered folding airplane seat, it has a simple across-the-lap seatbelt.  You likely wouldn't be the first to sleep in this.

data.name: wooden chair
data.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.

data.name: sofa
data.description: A wide upholstered bench, large enough for two people to comfortably sit alongside one another, or for one person to lay down on.  It's not quite a bed, but it's a hell of a lot more comfortable than the floor.

data.name: wooden stool
data.description: A simple stool with four legs and a seat.  While it's a touch more maneuverable to sit on, the lack of back support means it's significantly less comfortable than a normal chair.

data.name: camp chair
data.description: A somewhat uncomfortable folding chair, with fabric strung across a metal frame.  Not the best, but better than nothing, and very easy to pack up for transport.

data.name: log stool
data.description: A short section of a tree trunk with one of the flat ends smoothed down.  Makes for a decent place to sit, but not quite a real chair.

data.name: deck chair
data.description: A folding deck chair with fabric sheets mounted to a wooden frame.  While it's built to handle outdoor conditions and is an improvement over the ground, it's not particularly comfortable.

data.name: metal bench
data.description: A bench made of metal.  Not the most comfortable furniture you've ever sat on.

data.name: wooden bench
data.description: A simple wooden bench made of two thick, makeshift legs and a flat piece of wood on top.  Certainly nowhere near as good as a bed, but sitting on it makes you feel like you're out camping.

data.name: park bench
data.description: A wooden bench with a metal frame and a back support.  Cold and uncomfortable to sleep on, but sitting on it is not terrible.
data.//: The numbers are adjusted in such a way that the park bench should appear on two tiles next to each other.

data.name: bar stool
data.description: A bar stool with a leather seat on a steel support.  Not practical for sleeping at all, but it does feel nicer than sitting on the ground.

data.name: folding chair
data.description: A black foldable plastic chair on a steel frame.  Not particularly comfortable, but at least you have something to sit on.

data.name: plywood chair
data.description: A simple chair made of plywood on a steel frame.  Quite uncomfortable, but it works for sleeping if it's the only option available.

data.name: black wooden chair
data.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair is painted black.

data.name: white wooden chair
data.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair is painted white.

data.name: barber chair
data.description: a stationary chair made of cloth and steel.  With adjustable height and the ability to swing.

data.name: bean bag
data.description: A large cushion filled with beads often used as a seat.
data.//: Size of bean bag used for measurements is approx. 1m x 1m x 0.2m

data.name: bulletin board
data.description: A wide wooden frame with a sheet of corkboard inside.  Good for pinning various notices for other survivors to read.

data.name: sign
data.description: A simple signpost made of wood.  Basically two planks alongside each other nailed to another plank that holds them up.

data.name: warning sign
data.description: A triangular signpost painted white with a red border.  Designed to easily catch the eye, signs of this nature seldom display anything but bad news.

data.name: evac shelter info board
data.description: A wide wooden frame surrounding a sheet of cork, on to which a number of full-page notices have been neatly tacked.  Most seem to provide emergency information, or instructions now woefully outdated considering the state of things, but a map pointing to the nearest refugee center catches your eye.  You should take a closer look.

then.u_message: You study the board.  It shows a similar set of directions to the ones you already have.  You cross-reference them and don't learn anything new.

else.u_message: You study the board.  One of the pages has a map and address for a nearby refugee center alongside minutia you no longer need trouble yourself with now that society has collapsed, like 'operating hours' and 'acceptable forms of ID'.  You take careful note of the map on the board and mark down the coordinates.

false_effect.u_message: It's too dark to read.

data.name: stop sign
data.description: An octagonal red sign on a long metal pole, marked with the word STOP.
data.//: 36x36 inch aluminum sign on 7 feet U-channel post (post weight is 3 pound per foot, but we don't really have any sort of beams, so pipe is used instead), mounted using 2 bolts

data.name: bed
data.description: A standard mattress on a sturdy wooden frame.  Even without blankets or pillows, and despite being a completely ordinary mattress, it's a sight for sore, tired eyes.

data.name: bunk bed
data.description: A bunk bed with a sturdy wooden frame built to hold two single-person mattresses above one another.  While these usually mean sleeping closer than you'd like to somebody you wouldn't normally want to share a mattress with, a bed's a bed.

data.name: down bed
data.description: A down mattress on a sturdy wooden frame.  Even without blankets or pillows, and despite being a completely ordinary mattress, it's a sight for sore, tired eyes.

data.name: down bunkbed
data.description: A bunk bed with a sturdy wooden frame built to hold two single-person mattresses above one another.  While these usually mean sleeping closer than you'd like to somebody you wouldn't normally want to share a mattress with, a bed's a bed.  This one has two down mattresses.

data.name: triple berth
data.description: This bunk bed can hold three people at once - a perfect sleeping solution for places where empty space is at a premium.

data.name: bed frame
data.description: A sturdy wooden bed frame built to hold most standard mattresses.  Despite being one half of a bed, it's just about impossible to lay on by itself.

data.name: mattress
data.description: An ordinary mattress lying on the floor.  While it's not as comfortable as a proper bed with a frame, it's pretty close.  If it's somewhere actually safe to sleep, this is practically a luxury in and of itself.

data.name: down mattress
data.description: A squishy, feather-stuffed mattress lying on the floor.  While it's not as comfortable as a proper bed with a frame, it's pretty close.  If it's somewhere actually safe to sleep, this is practically a luxury in and of itself.

data.name: hammock
data.description: A large sheet of cloth with ropes on two sides tied to nearby objects.  It's quite comfortable to sleep in, but provides no warmth.

data.name: net hammock
data.description: A large net with ropes on two sides tied to nearby objects.  It's quite comfortable to sleep in, but provides no warmth.

data.name: makeshift bed
data.description: An improvised mattress on a flimsy wooden frame.  Almost as good as a normal bed, albeit with a slightly lumpy mattress.  Considering the circumstances, it's not too bad at all.

data.name: straw bed
data.description: An improvised bedding pile made of hay.  Better than nothing, but not particularly comfortable, and quite itchy.

data.name: bookcase
data.description: A simple wooden shelf for storing dozens of books.  While designed for books, it does a decent job of storing anything else that'll fit.

data.name: entertainment center
data.description: While not quite as cool by itself as the name might imply, this large wooden cabinet can store a variety of things, like a TV and media systems, with shelving space and cupboards for anything that'll fit.

data.name: coffin
data.description: A humble wooden casket for the respectful burial of the dead.  While a standard practice before this all happened, it is now a rare honor for one to be given a proper final resting place.  An honor that countless many will likely never receive.

prying_data.failure: You pry, but the coffin remains closed.

data.name: open coffin
data.description: A humble wooden casket for the respectful burial of the dead.  While a standard practice before this all happened, it is now a rare honor for one to be given a proper final resting place.  This one is open and unoccupied, and gazing inside fills you with a sense of melancholic weariness.

data.name: crate
data.description: A sealed wooden storage container.  Lacking any labels, it could hold just about anything inside.  If you don't have a proper tool to pry it open, smashing it is an option, albeit one that risks destroying the contents.

prying_data.failure: You pry, but can't pop open the crate.

data.name: open crate
data.description: An open wooden storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has been pried off and is leaned adjacent to it, and with a fresh set of nails, could be sealed back shut.

data.name: large cardboard box
data.description: A large box made of brown corrugated paper.  Could contain a number of things.

data.name: reinforced large cardboard box
data.description: A large box made of brown corrugated paper that was doubled up for extra strength.  Could contain a number of things.

data.name: dresser
data.description: A simple wooden cabinet with a column of short drawers.  While intended for storing clothes, there's nothing stopping you from storing whatever fits.

data.name: glass front cabinet
data.description: A tall metal cabinet with a sheet of glass across the front for viewing the contents.  Often used for displaying rare, visually pleasing, or otherwise valuable goods, it's odd that it doesn't have a lock.

data.name: open gun safe
data.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  This one is wide open.

data.name: closed gun safe
data.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  This one is closed, but not locked.

data.name: locked gun safe
data.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  If you had something to pick its lock with, you could probably open it.
data.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock on the gun safe door opens.

data.name: jammed gun safe
data.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  Unfortunately, the lock is completely broken, and short of some pretty serious machinery, you have no possible way of opening it.

data.name: electronic gun safe
data.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and an electronic locking system, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  If you had some way of hacking into it, you could probably crack it open.

data.name: locker
data.description: A tall sheet metal cabinet, useful for storing just about anything that'll fit.

data.name: mailbox
data.description: A small metal box on top of a wooden post, designed to receive mail deliveries.  Although considering the circumstances, it will likely never see proper use again.

data.name: clothing rail
data.description: A metal frame on a set of wheels used for hanging large amounts of clothes.  Usually used in theater or retail environments, it's easy to use and quick to access.

data.name: display rack
data.description: A sheet metal shelving unit, with the storage surfaces angled in such a way as to show off the items stored.

data.name: locked display rack
data.description: A sheet metal shelving unit, with the storage surfaces angled in such a way as to show off the items stored.  Metal fasteners with a lock hold the items securely to the rack.
data.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock opens.

data.name: wooden rack
data.description: A wooden shelving unit with angled storage surfaces designed to show off whatever is stored on it.

data.name: simple wooden rack
data.description: Wooden planks joined together and tied with cords to form a set of shelves.

data.name: coat rack
data.description: A tall wooden pole with a set of hooks used to store outdoor jackets and hats to allow easy access.

data.name: recycle bin
data.description: A large plastic bin painted green with a 'recycle' symbol emblazoned on it.  While intended to store discarded things to be processed back into a factory, the drastic change in priorities as of late means that these may hold valuable materials.

data.name: safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock.  This one isn't actually locked, just closed.

data.name: safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock.  With something to listen really closely and a hell of a lot of time, you might be able to crack it.

data.name: open safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock, albeit significantly less secure with the door open.

data.name: trash can
data.description: A plastic bin for storing discarded waste as to be disposed of later.  Although, considering the circumstances, it might be worth seeing what's inside.

data.name: metal trash can
data.description: A crude metal bin typically used to dispose of waste.
data.//: The constructed trash can variant, deliberately looks like the original. Does not spawn naturally, although feel free to add it to worldgen.

data.name: wardrobe
data.description: A very large wooden cabinet for storing clothes, effectively an upright closet.  Could technically be used to store anything else that would fit, though.

data.name: Torah Ark
data.description: An ornately-carved cabinet designed to hold a Torah scroll.  This one is decorated with a tree motif, referencing Proverbs 3:18.

data.name: filing cabinet
data.description: A rack of metal drawers designed to hold various files and paperwork.  Paperwork that has more than likely lost all relevance and value by now.

data.name: utility shelf
data.description: A simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit, intended to store tools and materials for easy access to workers.

data.name: warehouse shelf
data.description: A huge, sturdy steel shelf for storing pallets of crates in warehouses.

data.name: wooden keg
data.description: A large standing wooden barrel, completely watertight.  Good for storing liquids of all kinds.

data.name: display case
data.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Not actually as secure as it looks, as the display windows are easily broken.
data.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock and the display case opens.

data.name: open display case
data.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Not actually as secure as it looks, as the display windows are easily broken.  This one has had its lock picked and is open.

data.name: broken display case
data.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Would be useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off, if the glass hadn't been shattered.  Careful not to cut yourself when looting.

data.name: map board
data.description: A secure metal board with a locked glass panel used to display a map.

data.name: broken map board
data.description: A metal board with a smashed glass panel used to display a map.

data.name: fireman's cabinet
data.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out, visibly holding tools behind a thin panel of tempered glass.
data.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock on the cabinet opens.

data.name: unlocked fireman's cabinet
data.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out.  Its glass panel door was left unlocked and slightly ajar.

data.name: open fireman's cabinet
data.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out.  Its protective glass panel lies broken from some past emergency or looting attempt.

data.name: standing tank
data.description: A huge metal tank that can be used to safely store large amounts of liquid.

data.name: bulk storage tank
data.description: A 2 meters high tank that can store up to 1500 liters of liquid.  That's a lot.

data.name: fuel tank
data.description: A tank filled with gasoline.

data.name: broken fuel tank
data.description: A broken tank which was filled with gasoline.

data.name: fuel tank
data.description: A tank filled with diesel.

data.name: broken fuel tank
data.description: A broken tank which was filled with diesel.

data.name: dumpster
data.description: A large metal dumpster that will likely not be getting picked up by the city's waste management any time soon.  Despite the unpleasant nature of climbing inside, it could make for a viable hiding spot.
data.//CCB: 撤销 PR #84430 — 移除垃圾箱CLIMBABLE标记

data.name: butter churn
data.description: A metal tube with a built-in mixer for making butter.  Rather than needing electricity, it is pedal-driven, allowing use without power.

data.name: riveted metal crate
data.description: This huge box is made of a dull metal, riveted together.  There is no obvious opening mechanism, and the rivets don't match any of your tools.  The only way in would be to smash it.
data.//: To-do: There should be an Exodii riveting tool that can convert this to f_metal_crate_c

data.name: sealed metal crate
data.description: A huge, tightly sealed storage crate made from welded and riveted sheet metal.  The sealing mechanism is too tight to open bare-handed and would need some kind of prying instrument to release.

prying.message: You wrench open the metal crate.

prying_data.failure: The lid is sealed more tightly than you thought.

data.name: open metal crate
data.description: This large metal crate's lid is unsealed, and hinges open easily to reveal a number of storage shelves inside.  Once open, the side panels also swing wider for easy access.
A sealed wooden storage container.  Lacking any labels, it could hold just about anything inside.  It has a simple metal latch.
data.name: wooden chest
steel foot locker
data.description: A steel storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

data.name: aluminum foot locker
data.description: An aluminum storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

data.name: big collapsible drum
data.description: A black collapsible drum with a valve and D-Rings.  Yellow text on its top clearly says "FLAMMABLE".

data.name: packed pallet
data.description: A wooden pallet loaded with cargo, wrapped with a watertight cover, and belted to secure the contents.
data.//: probably should remove locked_object, because it mention you can pry it when actually you can't

data.name: damaged pallet
data.description: A wooden pallet, containing cargo and possessing a torn cover.  You can reach the contents, but it's awfully hard due to the belts still being in place.

data.name: Exodii kiln
data.description: An imposing kiln produced by the Exodii, used to produce their ceramic armor.

data.name: counter
data.description: A plain wooden countertop, either free-standing or affixed to a wall.  Makes a decent surface for storage or crafting.

data.name: cupboard
data.description: Store your cups.  Or other things, if you're feeling wild.

data.name: closed counter gate
data.description: A commercial-quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.  It's currently closed.

data.name: open counter gate
data.description: A commercial-quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.  It's open, allowing passage.

data.name: desk
data.description: A wooden desk with drawers.  You could decorate it with trinkets, eat a meal off it, use it as a workbench, read a book, write in a journal, put a laptop on it, put your feet up, rest your head for a nap if you're sitting down… who knew desks were so useful?

data.name: workbench
data.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

data.name: leather tarp
data.description: A large sheet of leather lying on the ground.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering as it does not soak up blood.

data.name: plastic groundsheet

data.name: beautiful nether lily
data.//: Its thing is making itself irresistible to the PC. TODO: Make this effect more obvious
data.description: A very tall, mesmerizing blood red flower.  Its beautiful, pristine form is rooted firmly on the innards of the beast.  The flesh around it is decayed, being consumed to feed its ornate, magnanimous body.  You feel an urge to sit and admire this priceless miracle of life.

effect.u_message: You admire the lily.  Isn't it beautiful?
You worship the lily, and feel truly fulfilled.
You bow to the lily, and gain immense satisfaction in having done so.
You focus on the lily and realize it truly is perfection *incarnate*.

data.name: nether grass
data.description: A bed of waist high segmented blue plants that remind you of grass.  As you wade past, they react to your movement and always swivel to face you.

data.name: tall nether grass
data.description: A clump of tall, segmented blue plants that remind you of grass.  As you approach, they bend towards you, hugging your body and making movement difficult.

data.name: nether patchwork
data.description: A peculiar plant that is hard to distinguish, resembling a tangled mess of different terrestrial flowers and weeds firmly wedged into the monstrous flesh.  It pulses rhythmically as it rearranges its form into even weirder shapes.

data.name: nether lichen
data.description: A bed of orange, flowering lichen, covering the surface of the yellow ichor.  Every now and then, a flower disappears into the liquid, but seems to reappear the moment you look away.

data.name: refrigerator
data.description: A standard household refrigerator.  If powered, it will cool its contents to extend the time before they spoil.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: minifridge
data.description: A small fridge, often used in places where full-size fridge would be too big or too much a hassle to transport, or when you only need a small amount of items chilled.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: single glass door fridge
data.description: A modern refrigerator with a thick sheet of glass for a door, used in stores to show off the goods while keeping them cool.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: double glass door fridge
data.description: A modern refrigerator with two glass doors, to fit twice as much goods for consumers.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: heavy-duty fridge
data.description: A heavy, bulky refrigerator, used in professional kitchens.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: display fridge
data.description: A big glass chamber, designed to display different food in multiple rows, while cooling it at the same time.  Looks gorgeous, but has nothing good to show to you.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: minifreezer
data.description: A small upright freezer, used to store a small amount of perishables long term.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: chest minifreezer
data.description: A small chest freezer, used to store a small amount of perishables for a long time, if you're willing to dig them out each time that is.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: chest freezer
data.description: A chest freezer.  Big and power efficient, this is the dream for every Cataclysm survivor.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: heavy-duty freezer
data.description: A heavy-duty upright freezer, one that is used in a professional kitchen.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: glass door freezer
data.description: A commercial upright freezer, used to show ice creams, frozen veggies, pizza, or anything else a consumer may want frozen and preserved.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: display chest freezer
data.description: A commercial chest freezer, used to show off ice creams, frozen veggies, pizza, or anything else a consumer may want frozen and preserved.  Conveniently tall enough for any curious child to gaze in at the sweets.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

data.name: black glass figure
