A nasty looking figurine of a mutant zombie, with a large tongue sprouting from its face.  You thankfully haven't encountered something like that yet.
An expensive looking figurine of a gnarly, jet-black alien covered in menacing looking spines.

data.description: A normal-sized manufactured figurine.  This is the default variant, if you see it something went wrong.

variants.description: A figurine of some unnamed swordsman, covered with scars and equipped with sturdy leather armor.  Seems to be ready to fight.
A plastic figurine of a young woman.  She's meant to be dressed up and accessorized with a wide variety of clothing, sold separately.
A plastic figurine with a nightmarish, scarred face.  He wears a hat and has three long blades extending from a glove on the back of his hand.
A figurine of a blue unicorn.  It is in a sitting position, shyly covering both eyes with its front hooves.
A figurine of a scaly green swamp monster emerging from some fetid lagoon.

Your heart leaps to your throat as you see the face of Death itself staring back at you, scythe raised for the harvest!  You relax significantly once you realize it's only a few inches tall and made of plastic.

A figurine of a redheaded mermaid sitting on a rock.  Like in the film this toy is based on, she gazes longingly out to a world she wants to be a part of - or she would be, but the face isn't drawn very well and doesn't express much emotion at all.
A plastic figurine of an anthropomorphic avocado, holding a salt shaker and a spoon.  Makes a great gift for the guacamole lover in your life, or as a decoration for your kitchen.
A superhero action figure.  Its limbs can be adjusted for different poses, and it is designed to do battle against a wide variety of crooks and supervillains, sold separately.

data.description: A simple yoyo on a string.  Now you can be bored with style.
A fidget spinner.  An artifact from when the times were simpler.

effect.u_message: You spin your fidget spinner.

data.description: Its legs are mismatched, its arms misshapen, its eyes more crooked than its smile.  Everywhere, it sparkles with the golden thread that has put it back together.  It's beautiful.
They're different colors and different lengths.  It would be hard to run away with these.
The spun cloth fingers are fraying away.  There's nothing that they could hold on to.
A pair of mismatched buttons and some dull yellow thread, to put on a brave face with.
A big plastic airbag filled with hydrogen gas.  Provides lift if installed on a vehicle, but you'll need a propeller to do anything more than float up and down.
data.//: Realistically, each kg of lift would take about a cubic meter but that's literally the tile volume limit and we'd need 30 of those, so stick to a value actually allowed to exist.

data.description: A steel propeller and spinner from an airplane.  When attached to a vehicle, engine power will provide lift to any installed wings, allowing it to take off.
A wooden propeller and spinner from an airplane.  When attached to a vehicle, engine power will provide lift to any installed wings, allowing it to take off.
A light, flammable gas compressed for use as fuel.  Requires a lot of energy to produce, even moreso without pre-cataclysm industry.  Quite energy dense, though not very volume-efficient.
data.//: 25 kg per cubic meter, in the lower half of the range for compressed hydrogen.

data.description: A wooden mast with sails fit for a yacht or sloop, and about as much rigging as a single sailor can handle.
data.//: About half the weight and volume of the wooden beam, assumes a good amount is lost in the recipe

data.description: A standard alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.
A compact, lightweight alternator used to power small vehicle electrical systems.

data.//: based on: https://www.amazon.com/Wai-Danie-Generator-Waterproof-Alternating/dp/B07X2B1DVG
data.description: A very lightweight alternator used to power a bicycle's headlights.
A larger and more powerful alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.
A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

Heavy steel beams and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along, reinforced to withstand the rigors of the apocalypse and ill-advised off-roading.  You would still need separate armor for said creature to wear.
data.//: calculating weight: yoke_harness (1000 g) + frame (20 000 g) + scrap (50 g)x35 OR steel_lump(1000 g)x5 + pipe(1250 g)x2 + chain(3628)x2. Total 1: 32506 g. Total 2: 35756 g. With rounding and fudge factor: 35000 g. Previus eyeballed guess before doing any of this math was 30000 g.

data.description: Several interlocked rods of rebar serving as makeshift armor, allowing for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.
A makeshift combination of springs and scrap that protects a particular section of a vehicle from the shock of impacts.  The springs can absorb a surprising amount of damage.
A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.
data.//1: 58Ah @ 12VDC. Could supply ~833 watts for an hour
data.//2: Approximate energy density 0.3 MJ/L / 0.14 MJ/Kg for lead-acid batteries

data.description: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.
data.//: 12Ah @ 12VDC. Could supply ~125 watts for an hour

data.description: A miniature 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.
data.//: ~2.4Ah @ 12VDC. Could supply ~125 watts 30 minutes or so

data.description: A large storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.
data.//: Approximate energy density 2.1 MJ/L / 0.73 MJ/Kg for lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC) batteries

data.description: A huge storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Holds a tremendous amount of energy.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.
A medium storage battery containing multiple lithium-ion cells.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.
A small storage battery created with pre-Cataclysm lithium-ion technology.  Useful for crafting.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.

A battery case for storage batteries.  It has a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of a storage battery to a vehicle's power grid, if you can lift the battery.

A mount for batteries usually used in handheld tools.  It has a power converter, a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of such batteries to a vehicle's power grid.

A ready-to-deploy portable rechargeable battery unit that comes with an inverter for powering home appliances and outlet ports for your electronic devices.  Useful for camping, power outage, and surviving the apocalypse.
A wooden board that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
Logs tied together to make a vehicle float.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
A rigid plastic sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
A rigid carbon fiber sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
A pair of oars for a boat.
A sail for a boat.
An inflatable boat section.
An inflatable airbag.
An aluminum hull that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
A large wire basket from a shopping cart.
A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.
A set of locks designed to be installed on a vehicle.  Attached to a suitable cargo space, it will prevent other people from accessing the cargo and taking your stuff.
A large wire basket from a shopping cart, modified to be foldable.
A simple bike basket.  It is small and foldable.
A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.
A section of flooring with a cargo space beneath and a hinged door for access.

A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large animal in place.  It is meant to hold large animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
A spare tire mounted on a carrier rig, ready to be attached to the rear bumper of a vehicle.

A locker used to contain animals safely during transportation if installed properly.  There is room for animal food and other animal care goods.  It is meant to hold medium or smaller animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
An L-shaped aluminum plate with straps and skid runners for a hand truck.  If attached to a sturdy frame, you could use these to move furniture.
data.//: https://www.magliner.com/extruded-aluminum-nose-flush-mount-300248
data.//1: The linked item weighs about 4kg, added another 2kg for skid runners.

data.description: A set of small monitors.  Required to view cameras' output.
A security camera you could connect to a display.  Image quality is quite low, but the field of vision is great.
A security camera with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.
A steering wheel, accelerator, and brake pedals.
A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.
A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.
A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

name.str_pl: sets of drive by wire controls

data.description: A sophisticated set of electronic controls that allow you to control the vehicle from a vehicle remote while you are not in it.

A set of servos, microcontrollers, and other devices, to allow a vehicle to drive itself, or you to drive it remotely using a controller.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.
A set of motors, cameras, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.

A pair of adjustable rods with a simple trigger.  They easily can be easily installed on top of vehicle controls and will allow a car or similar vehicle to be driven by those who can't use their legs to do so, whether due to disability or small stature.  These are designed for automobiles and will not work on bicycle style foot pedals.
These thick rubber pads can clamp securely onto a vehicle's gas and brake pedals, allowing even very short people to drive a car.
It is probably not a great idea, but if you wanted to, you could tape these blocks to a vehicle's gas and brake pedals so that a kid or very short adult could drive.

A powerful 6-cylinder gasoline engine strong enough for a pickup truck, SUV, or full-size van.

A medium-sized steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

data.//: Based on Allison 250-C30R.  Doubled the published weight to account for a transmission.
data.//2: The real materials used to make gas turbines are real-life superalloys and high-end stainless steels, but superalloy is reserved for sci-fi things.
data.//3: I chose a tempered steel as it's a highest-end mundane steel in game. New material (aerospace_steel?) can be added later.

A large, rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes.
A small, telescoping steel cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes.
A makeshift pallet lifter.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 0.5 metric tonnes.

A kickstand to keep a bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean a small vehicle forward or backward to change a tire.
An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.
data.//: Reapers and seed drills are made mostly out of mild steel.

data.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.
An assembly of a blade, wheels, and a small lever for engaging/disengaging, used to cut down crops prior to picking them up.
An advanced electronic device used to cut down, collect, and store crops.

An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.  This one is equipped with an electronic control system and will avoid damaging itself when used on untilled land.
A heavy assembly of wheels and steel blades that turn up the ground.

data.description: A light metal framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
A small, lightweight frame made from pipework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

A small, lightweight frame made from pipework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
A metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Increased mass makes it more resistant to damage in collisions.

A wooden framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and nail construction means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools.

A light wooden framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

A small frame made of a few pieces of wood, held together by rope.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and rope constructions means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools or nails.
A small skateboard frame made of thin layers of wood glued together.  Other skateboard components can be mounted on it.
The chassis of a concrete mixer.

A muffler from a car.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.
A safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse.  Usage of it now seems terribly unwise.
A stereo system with speakers.  It is capable of being hooked up to a vehicle.

A thin sheet of metal.

Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds. data.//: Recycling shredders (which I imagined this thing to be like) use tool steels or carbide blades (https://maxtormetal.com/shredder-blades-material-life/), but that seemed too hard to get, so I substituted a medium steel, as it cans still be found in larger quantities (in vehicle axles etc.)

initiate: You decide to not use any martial arts.

initiate: You force yourself to fight unarmed.
%s decides to fight unarmed.

data.description: Aikido is a Japanese martial art focused on self-defense, while minimizing injury to the attacker.  It uses defensive throws and disarms but its techniques lack offensive power.  Modern instruction in the United States tends to emphasize escaping assailants, and disengaging at the first opportunity.
initiate: You enter the hanmi stance.
%s enters a relaxed combat posture.

static_buffs.name: Aikido Stance
static_buffs.description:
By disregarding offense in favor of defense, you are better at protecting yourself.

You have +2 blocking effectiveness and +1.0 Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Intermediate Aikido
static_buffs.description:
You've learned the fundamentals of Aikido.  Your movement would be familiar to any practitioners in a pre-Cataclysm dojo.

Blocked damage reduced by 25% of Dexterity, +1 blocking effectiveness, +1 dodge attempt.

static_buffs.name: Advanced Aikido
static_buffs.description:
An advanced Aikido practitioner can protect themselves even against multiple opponents.

+1 dodge attempt, and one dodge each turn will not consume stamina.

onblock_buffs.name: Fluid Blocking
onblock_buffs.description:
After a smooth block, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

ondodge_buffs.name: Fluid Dodging
ondodge_buffs.description:
After a dodge, you have an opportunity for a clean escape.

-50% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: Bōjutsu, "The Way of the Staff", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a staff.  Bōjutsu focuses on maintaining a good stance to effectively block and counterattack.
initiate: You position yourself into an agile stance.
%s enters an agile stance.

static_buffs.name: Bōjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
An agile stance that allows your blocks to reduce incoming damage.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity.

static_buffs.name: Skilled Striking
static_buffs.description:
As you get more skilled you're able to begin targeting striking points that allow for more damage.

Melee skill increases bash damage cap.

onmove_buffs.name: Rolling Staff
onmove_buffs.description:
As you move you begin to rapidly and fluidly roll your staff between your hands.

+10% bash damage.
Enables "Rolling Strike" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: Barbaran Montante originated in 16th century Spain and focuses on overcoming thick armor with heavy weaponry and sweeping blows, transferring kinetic energy through armor and into vulnerable organs and bones.
initiate: You heft your weapon, stretch your shoulders, and slide into the Represa.
%s rolls their shoulders and prepares to duel.

static_buffs.name: Barbaran Represa
static_buffs.description:
Sliding footwork enhances the crushing continuity of your attacks.

Armor penetration increased by 75% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Reversing Destreza
onblock_buffs.description:
Blocking a key strike will turn the battle around.

-5% move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onkill_buffs.name: Movimiento Natural
onkill_buffs.description:
Formal victory is attained, and your mind is cleared to focus on your next moves.

+1 block attempt.
Lasts 5 turns.

onmove_buffs.name: Ricasso Step
onmove_buffs.description:
You switch or sturdy your grip mid-step to aid your blocking.

Blocked damage reduced by 40% of Strength.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onpause_buffs.name: Vulgar Preparation
onpause_buffs.description:
You prepare for the final crushing strike.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Strength, armor penetration increased by 225% of Strength.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: Sport of the true gentleman, modern boxing has evolved from the prizefights of the Victorian era.  Strength reduces blocked damage and moving increase Dodging skill.
initiate: You lower your chin and raise your fists to eye level.
%s prepares to fight with raised fists.

static_buffs.name: Boxing Stance
static_buffs.description:
A solid stance allows you to block more damage than normal and deliver better punches.

+1 accuracy, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Footwork
onmove_buffs.description:
You make yourself harder to hit by bobbing and weaving as you move.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.

ondodge_buffs.name: Counter Chance
ondodge_buffs.description:
You've seen your chance.  Now strike back!

+25% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: You're used to hand-to-creature fighting.  You know how to fight when unarmed or with any weapon to a certain extent.  It's not stylish or sporting, but it gets the job done.
initiate: You grit your teeth and prepare for a good fight.
%s gets ready to brawl.

static_buffs.name: Enhanced Blocking
static_buffs.description:
Combat experience has led to you being able to block multiple attacks at a time.

+1 block attempt.

onpause_buffs.name: Preparation to Hit
onpause_buffs.description:
You take a moment to prepare your stance before the enemy, allowing you to hit a little more accurately.

+1 accuracy.  Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

data.description: A dance-like style with its roots in Brazilian slavery, Capoeira is focused on fluid movement and sweeping kicks.  Moving briefly enables stronger techniques.  Missing an attack grants bonus damage for a short time.
initiate: You begin performing the ginga.
%s begins to rhythmically rock back and forth.

static_buffs.name: Capoeira Stance
static_buffs.description:
You never stop moving while performing the ginga.  This makes you very mobile while fighting.

+1.0 Dodging skill, +1 dodge attempt.

onattack_buffs.name: Capoeira Tempo
onattack_buffs.description:
Hit or miss, it's just part of the dance!  And the best part is about to start!

+5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Capoeira Momentum
onmove_buffs.description:
You can feel the rhythm as you move.  You are harder to hit, and your kicks are even more amazing!

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Spin Kick" and "Sweep Kick" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

data.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Crane uses intricate hand techniques and jumping dodges.  Dexterity determines your damage, rather than Strength; you have a higher chance to dodge and dodging unlocks strong techniques for a limited time.
initiate: You raise your leg slightly and balance like a crane.
%s assumes a crane-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Precision
static_buffs.description:
Your attacks strike at your opponents' weak spots with speed and precision instead of brute force.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Stance
static_buffs.description:
Like the beautiful crane, you are very skilled at evading danger.

+2.0 Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Grace
static_buffs.description:
Masters of the Crane style can evade multiple foes with ease.

+2 dodge attempts.

ondodge_buffs.name: Crane's Flight
ondodge_buffs.description:
Much like the crane, you are quick to avoid danger and strike back.

+1 accuracy, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Crane Kick" and "Crane Strike" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

data.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Dragon uses fluid movements and hard strikes.  Intelligence improves your accuracy and damage instead of Dexterity and Strength.  Dodging and blocking increases your damage.  Pausing increases your defenses.  You can perform a powerful strike against a downed opponent.
initiate: You relax and patiently await conflict like the great dragon.
%s assumes a dragon-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Dragon's Knowledge
static_buffs.description:
You plan your attacks far in advance, relying on your intuition instead of your speed to strike true.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Intelligence but decreased by 25% of Dexterity, bash damage increased by 75% of Intelligence but decreased by 75% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Dragon's Vortex
onblock_buffs.description:
Life and combat are a circle.  An attack leads to a counter and to an attack once again.  Seek to complete this loop.

+10% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.

ondodge_buffs.name: Dragon Wing
ondodge_buffs.description:
Life and combat are a circle.  An attack leads to a counter and to an attack once again.  Seek to complete this loop.

+10% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Dragon Power
onpause_buffs.description:
You take a moment to reflect on battles past and to come.  This insight will protect you from future harm.

+2 blocking effectiveness, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Intelligence, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: Eskrima, also known as Kali, is a Filipino martial art.  It emphasizes rapid strikes with knife and baton weapons, along with a variety of improvised substitutes.
initiate: You enter an open guard stance and prepare to strike.
%s enters an open stance.

static_buffs.name: Eskrima Stance
static_buffs.description:
You are skilled at getting the most out of your weapons.  The term 'weapon' might be very subjective.

+2 accuracy.

You can follow up a critical hit with a stronger attack if the opportunity presents itself.

%s moves into a fencing stance.

static_buffs.name: Fencing Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your side stance reduces the chance that you will be harmed in combat.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Dexterity.

onblock_buffs.name: Parry
onblock_buffs.description:
Your next strike will find its mark much easier after your parry.

+1 accuracy.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmiss_buffs.name: Remise
onmiss_buffs.description:
Your feint is the perfect setup for a devastating followup attack!

+1 accuracy.

onpause_buffs.description:
You fake an attack and prepare yourself to unleash a Compound Attack.

+2 blocking effectiveness.

data.description: Medieval Europe's martial techniques for fighting with hooked weapons.  The "Flower of Battle" places great focus on countering one's opponent and knocking them down before landing a killing blow.

%s grips their weapon tightly.

static_buffs.name: Stand Your Ground
static_buffs.description:
You are stalwart and will not budge against any threat.

+2 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, -1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Tactical Retreat
onmove_buffs.description:
You moved and nullified the effects of Stand Your Ground!

-2 blocking effectiveness, -1 block attempt, +1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage increased by 50% of Strength.

They fell for your feint!

onblock_buffs.description:
Each successful block reveals an opening in your opponent's guard.

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Displace and Hook" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

data.description: Judo is a martial art that focuses on grabs and throws, both defensive and offensive.  You are resistant to most effects that can knock you down and can counter grab and takedown attacks with a strong judo throw.

%s prepares for a grapple.

static_buffs.name: Judo Stance
static_buffs.description: Your knowledge of grappling allows you to recover from knockdown effects instantly.  In addition, you can counter grabs and takedown attacks with a judo throw.

ondodge_buffs.name: Perfect Position
ondodge_buffs.description:
You've moved into a perfect position to counter attack!

+30% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: Karate is a popular martial art, originating from Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise attacks, blocks, and fluid movement.  A successful hit allows you an extra dodge and an extra block on the following round.

%s adopts a classic karate stance.

static_buffs.name: Karate Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your no-nonsense stance allows you hit more accurately.

+2 accuracy.

onhit_buffs.name: Karate Kata
onhit_buffs.description:
Landing a hit allows you to perfectly position yourself for maximum defense against multiple opponents.

+1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -10% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: A martial art that combines western boxing with elements of Karate, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, and Savate, particularly in the use of kicks.  American Kickboxing in particular focuses on high kicks without knee or elbow strikes.

%s brings their fists up and stays light on their feet.

static_buffs.name: Kick stance
static_buffs.description:
You have adopted a stance which allows for greater mobility and stability.  Your hands are in a guard position with elbows forward to protect yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 25% of Strength.
+1.0 Dodging skill.

data.description: Originating in Israel, Krav Maga is based on taking down an enemy quickly and effectively.  It focuses on applicable attacks rather than showy or complex moves.  Popular among police and armed forces everywhere.
initiate: You assume a practical combat stance.
%s assumes a practical combat stance.

static_buffs.name: Krav Maga Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training makes it easier to land hits and fight multiple opponents.

+1 accuracy, +1 block attempt.

onblock_buffs.name: Strike Vitals
onblock_buffs.description:
Like a fool, your opponent has left themselves wide open.

+5% critical hit chance.

data.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Leopard focuses on rapid, strategically-planned strikes.  Dexterity determines your damage rather than Strength, and also increases your critical hit chance.

%s assumes a leopard-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Leopard's Strategy
static_buffs.description:
You fight by overwhelming your opponents with speedy strikes that are much harder to defend against.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.

static_buffs.name: Leopard's Ambush
static_buffs.description:
Go for the throat and take out your foes immediately!

Critical hit chance increased by 100% of Dexterity.

oncrit_buffs.name: Leopard's Agility
oncrit_buffs.description:
Just like a cat, you are quick, agile, and hard to pin down.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.

data.description: The art of the longsword and sword & buckler, preceding the later development of fencing.  Designed for combat both unarmored and in armor, it includes grappling as well as defensive and offensive sword techniques.  This style is a combination of the Italian and German traditions.

%s takes on a knightly stance.

static_buffs.name: Swordsman's Stance

Through chivalry and vigilance, your defense with a blade has increased.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

You parry and return the attack with greater vigor!

+10% damage, -10% move cost.

You maintain the momentum from your last strike to move more quickly.

data.description: Also referred to as the "Art of 8 Limbs," Muay Thai is a popular fighting technique from Thailand that uses powerful strikes.  Your Strength decreases blocked damage.  Blocking attacks or getting hit will increase your damage and blocked damage further.

%s performs a short war-dance.

static_buffs.name: Muay Thai Stance
static_buffs.description:
Strength is everything in Muay Thai and you know how to make the most of yours.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

ongethit_buffs.name: Determination
ongethit_buffs.description:
Taking a hit will not slow you down.  You will outlast your opponent and win this fight.

Bash damage increased by 25% of Strength, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 5 turns.

data.description: Ninjutsu is a martial art and set of tactics used by ninja in feudal Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise, silent strikes.  Ninjutsu is almost entirely silent and you have a higher chance to critically hit on your first attack.  It also provides small combat bonuses every time you move.
initiate: You perform a kuji-in mantra with your hands.  Rin, Kai, Jin!
%s performs a series of intricate hand signs.

static_buffs.name: Ninjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training allows you to make no noise when attacking and less noise when moving around.

Melee and unarmed attacks generate 0 noise, moving generates 1/2 as much noise.

static_buffs.name: Sneak Attack
static_buffs.description:
To a true shinobi, the first strike and the last strike are one and the same.

+25% critical hit chance.

onattack_buffs.name: Loss of Surprise
onattack_buffs.description:
Your intentions are known!  It will take you a few moments to sneak attack again.

onmove_buffs.name: Momentum Shift

Ninja are trained to be extremely agile and mobile.

onkill_buffs.name: Escape Plan
onkill_buffs.description:
Your target has perished.  It is time to leave and plan your next attack.

+2 dodge attempts, +10 movement speed.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

data.description: Niten Ichi-Ryu is an ancient school of combat, transmitting a style of classical Japanese swordsmanship conceived by the warrior Miyamoto Musashi.  Perception increases damage and reduces blocked damage.  Moving and attacking reduces dodging and damage until you pause.  Pausing for a moment increases Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Niten Ichi-Ryu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Cautious watchful eyes,
measure and display your skill.
Practice makes perfect.

Armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Perception.

onmove_buffs.name: Waning Moon
onmove_buffs.description:
Blackened like darkness,
nightmares approach from all sides.
Flee at any cost!

-5.0 Dodging skill.

A sharp sword cuts true.
Although, all things fade with time.

Luck be the light,
on a dark and cloudy night,
as the moon shines down.

The eye of the storm,
a fleeting moment of peace,

data.description: An ancient Greek martial art once used by the Spartans.  It combines boxing and wrestling techniques to create a brutal sport, though the modern revival of the art is more restrained and rules-based.

+20% damage.

data.description: Pencak Silat, of Indonesian origin, is a fighting style that covers the use of short blades and bludgeons.  Fighters stay low and mobile to avoid attacks, then unleash deadly critical hits.

%s gives a combat salute.

static_buffs.name: Silat Stance

You try to stay as loose as possible when fighting to have more chances to dodge.

Each time you dodge an attack, you learn a bit more about your opponent's fighting style.  This allows you to make more precise attacks against them.

+5% critical hit chance.

data.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Snake focuses on sinuous movement and precision strikes.  Perception determines your accuracy and damage, rather than Dexterity and Strength.  Standing still increases the accuracy and critical hit chance of your next few attacks.

It also includes strength training; your blocks absorb extra damage and your attacks do more damage if you are not holding anything.

Using your legs to attack keeps your hands free for better defense.

Its ability to absorb the force of an attack makes your Perception decrease damage further on a block.  Pausing for a moment enables powerful palm strike techniques.

static_buffs.name: Tai Chi Stance

It has a high stance, with one's weight resting entirely on the rear leg.  Wing Chun focuses on sensitivity to the opponent's direction of force, and flowing around it to create opportunities for attack.

data.//: This material ID is for plastics that can be reshaped and molded by application of heat and return to their original properties when cooled, and these specific ones are quite hard and durable when in solid state.
data.//1: Most consumer polymers and plastics receive a UL94 rating for flammability and the lowest UL94 rating is HB, generally considered self-extinguishing. Plastics are flammable but should only contribute significant fuel in intense fires.

data.name: Epoxy
data.//: 'epoxy' is a general catch-all for strong, brittle polymers that cannot be reshaped with application of heat.  Not all of these are necessarily going to be literally epoxy, but it's close enough.
data.//1: Epoxy greatly varies in flammability depending on its curing state, but here we'll assume any item with this material has set epoxy.

data.//: There is some historical evidence that animal bones have been used as an *added* combustion fuel by humans, but bones overall are a difficult material to use for this purpose and vary greatly in their suitability. data.name: Flesh
data.//: Density of non-fat parts of human body, also around upper-level densities for all organic matter
data.//1: It's rather difficult to find citeable data on how well arbitrary volumes of human flesh burns, so I've settled for just spitballing it, using wood as a baseline and knowing that cremation takes a lot of fuel. Now it burns less well than wood. So, big improvement. This data was last touched 7 years ago, in a 2016 PR which also cleaned up the fire code. They thought it was crusty and nonsensical at the time. I checked to see what had changed since then. Essentially nothing. So these values never made any sense.

data.description: A robot body with the head of a human.  All kinds of electronic wires and devices are implanted in its head.  The remaining patches of skin look diseased or rotting.  This cyborg moves erratically and has a confused and deranged look in its eyes.  Any personality or humanity it once had is clearly gone for good.

While their eyes are empty, the flashes of pain that occasionally cross their face remind you that, deep down, there is a person just like you trapped in this grotesque body.  Someone with enough surgical skills might be able to restore some of their humanity.  If only anyone cared…

It bristles with an arsenal of weaponry, and while it doesn't seem to be in a rush to target you, you feel that you should keep your distance anyway.

Wearing a military uniform with an armored vest, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Tense, dirty hands grip a combat knife as their bloodshot eyes scan for threats.
A rough-looking feral human, clad in black leather and wielding a pump-action shotgun, that seems to be empty already.  It seems body-armor wasn't one of their priorities however.
Clad in swimwear and with a stick in hand, this once normal person is now a bloodthirsty maniac.

Clad in a grimy and tattered naval uniform, this former sailor clutches a massive wrench as some form of makeshift weapon.  At a distance, you could mistake them as being another survivor.  However, upon closer inspection you make note of how their veins are visibly bulging, their wide open eyes have a primal, animalistic quality to their gaze, and their breaths come in ragged, wheezing pants.  Whatever the Cataclysm has done to the military crewman that this twitching shell of their former self once was, you're certain that they're not fully human anymore.

Spattered from head to toe in large swaths of dried viscera, the deep blue of this person's tattered naval uniform has been stained the color of rust.  Having seemingly had enough presence of mind to consider arming itself, this former crewman carries a crash axe in its shaking hands.  The veins on the back of their neck are visibly bulging, their eyes bloodshot, and a mass of crisscrossing blackened veins stand out against the pale skin of their face as they regard the area around them for perceived threats.

Clutching a stout mop in their quivering hands, this crewman was presumably assigned to basic deck sweeping in their final moments, before the Cataclysm struck and stripped them of their humanity.  Dressed in basic naval fatigues, you'd be forgiven for believing them to be another survivor.  However, their bloodshot eyes, blackened veins, and spastic twitching tell a far different story.

Still dressed in a grease spattered uniform, this crewman appears to have once been a naval engineer.  With tangled hair, oil stained working attire, and a lug wrench clenched in their fist, you assume that they were either assigned to shipside maintenance or responsible for servicing onboard aircraft.  Now all that's left of the crewman that this person once was is a madly twitching, psychopathic monster.

This twitching, bloodied person is still clad in a ragged Marine uniform, the insignia of the Marines visible on their coat and a corresponding tattoo on their forearm.  Clutching a rifle in their quivering hands, you see them repeatedly pull the weapon's trigger, constantly muttering incoherently and yanking back on the gun's charging handle every time the rifle fails to fire.  Seemingly having lost the capability to comprehend that their weapon is empty, you'd feel relatively safe were it not for the gleaming bayonet still attached to the end of their firearm.

This person, clad in the tattered uniform of a naval officer, twitches erratically as their bloodshot eyes dart about and their breaths come in ragged pants.  The Cataclysm has clearly done something horrible to this military professional, inaudible mutterings emanating from their lips as they creep about like a skittish animal.  In their quivering hands they clutch a service pistol, the officer's fingers nervously fidgeting with the weapon.  They may not be an undead corpse, but you doubt that they're any more rational than the zombies which now infest the world.
Another of the crazed humans among the dead.  This police officer angrily mutters to themselves, wandering about with a truncheon in hand in search of someone to brutalize.

A maddened and crazed police officer infected by the fungus.  Their body armor is overgrown with fungal matter.  Though obviously in pain they don't seem any less keen to batter you to death with their baton.

This frenzied prisoner has somehow avoided turning into one of the undead thus far, though seeing how zombies seem to ignore this shiv-wielding, blood-stained maniac, they are likely not far off from that fate.

This person, clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, looks healthy.  Their eyes are bright, without any red markings; their hair has a pleasant shine; and their skin is practically glowing.  Only the twitching and the pipe held in one hand as they walk among the zombies would tell you that they've gone feral.

Clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, this feral swings a pipe as they walk.  They hold it in one hand and move it like it's a stick, despite the  fittings on the end that must be increasing its weight.
data.//: Much shorter half-life since Noonien both reduces healing and suppresses feelings of hunger

data.description: Despite the myriad rips and tears in this feral's orange jumpsuit, they don't have a single scratch on them.  Only their bloodshot eyes and the way the zombies ignore them indicate something is wrong.

With bloodshot eyes and a ripped orange jumpsuit, this obviously-feral human wanders among the undead.  Their movements are uncanny, almost like an old-fashioned camera film that's been sped up.  All of their motions are jerky and unfocused but they make them at blinding speed.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

data.description: Despite their bloodshot eyes, this feral exhibits a level of awareness not seen among most of their fellows.  Their eyes purposefully scan their surroundings for danger, they carry a homemade spear, and they wear a set of armor they've cobbled together from bits of riot armor and lab supplies.  The remnants of an orange jumpsuit are visible under their improvised armor.
In light, this feral is clearly visible but they blend into the darkness like a ghost, despite the orange jumpsuit they still wear.  They don't seem to have any problems seeing in the dark either.
data.//: No PARROT since Anaximander makes you silent

data.description: A blood-red, gigantic razorclaw.  With its sword-like pincers, it serves as a protector of the nest.
