data.description: A half-translucent fish larva… though this one is far larger than the usual.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to but you can safely tell that it is going to outgrow normal fish you're used to seeing.
A brown trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
A brook trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
A lake trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
A rainbow trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
An Atlantic salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.
A Kokanee salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.
A lake whitefish, closely related to salmon.  One can assume they taste just as nice when smoked.
A round whitefish, closely related to salmon.  One can assume they taste just as nice when smoked.
A largemouth bass.  Very popular with sport fishermen.
A smallmouth bass.  Infamously intolerant to pollution, the presence of smallmouth bass is a good indicator of how clean a body of water is.
A striped bass.  Mostly a saltwater fish, they migrate to fresher water to spawn.
A small, sprightly perch.  It is a very bony fish, still has some tasty meat on it though.
A walleye.  A green-brown medium-sized fish with a white belly.
A banded sunfish.  A small fish related to bass and bluegill.
A pumpkinseed sunfish.  A small fish related to bass and bluegill.
A bluegill, an invasive species in Japan.  Commonly gutted and cooked whole.
A redbreast sunfish.  A small fish related to bass and bluegill.
A green sunfish.  A small fish related to bass and bluegill.
A rock bass.  Related to sunfish, this tiny fish has a camouflage-like patterning and red eyes.
A black crappie.  A medium-sized fish also known as a 'calico bass'.
A warmouth, similar to a rock bass.  This small fish is related to the sunfish.
A brown bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious when battered and fried.
A yellow bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious when battered and fried, though smaller than its brown cousin.
A channel catfish.  It has a forked tail and long whiskers.
A white catfish.  A small whiskered fish with a broad head.
A northern pike.  Pike can be pretty aggressive fish, careful around those teeth.
A chain pickerel.  It looks like a pike, but slightly smaller.
An American pickerel.  It looks like a pike, but unlike its chain pickerel cousin, this one is way smaller.
A muskellunge.  Closely related to pike but even larger, it shares the same aggression and sharp teeth.
A white sucker.  It has a streamlined body with a round mouth.
A golden-yellow common carp.  Some people think they don't taste great, but you can't afford to be choosy in the Cataclysm.
A huge grass carp.  A golden, herbivorous fish.
Yes, this is that common pet fish.  Though, given its size and the fact that it's still alive, you can take a wild guess that this one is feral.
A bowfin.  These fish are related to gar but without the huge teeth, skin-rending scales, and aggression.
A large ancient type of fish with a mean jaw and poisonous eggs.
A relatively large fish that looks like a cross between a catfish and an eel, and is the only freshwater fish from the order that cods hail from.
A very large armored bottom-feeder, the lake sturgeon is one of the largest unmutated fish one can find in the freshwater regions of New England.
While the shortnose sturgeon is still large, it is nothing compared to its cousin - the lake sturgeon.  What really sets it apart, however, is its signature shorter snout.
A fallfish.  These fish are small cyprinids, related to carp.

A dark greenish crustacean in its natural habitat.  These were once considered pests barely worth eating, then some marketing genius started selling them to people as a delicacy and they took off in popularity… and price.
This crustacean looks like a tiny lobster, but is actually a completely different species.  If you could get ahold of a bunch more of these, a hefty pot of boiling water, and some spicy seasonings…
A minuscule half-translucent crustacean larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.
An American eel.  They used to be quite common in these parts until the dams were built.  They'll get a second chance now that those aren't running.
A mutant crayfish the size of a dog, with a brown carapace, claws, and long antennae.
A mutant, terrestrial variety of crayfish, this massive crustacean resembles a humongous lobster.
An enormous mutated gray crayfish with pincer claws and long antennae.
A large crayfish larva already larger than non-mutated adults of its kind.
A man-sized crustacean clad in iron-like chitin, capable of emitting horrible shrieking noises.  Often spotted near shipwrecks or other dark, damp places, which it uses as nesting grounds.
This thing looks like a carp, but huge and very, very angry.  Death is the gift of the carp god.
A mutated salmon roughly the size of a person.  Quite dangerous to the inexperienced angler.
A huge mutant salmon grown almost to the size of an alligator.
A huge mutant salmon, one that outgrows even the other ones present.  On its sides, beneath the fins, are visible two flesh-colored tubes which propel water as it leaps.
A large, mutant variety of carp.  It has shimmering green scales and a mouth lined with three jagged rows of razor-sharp teeth.
An Atlantic mackerel, known for its distinctive striped pattern.
A flatfish, the summer flounder, also known as a fluke, likes to stay camouflaged against the ocean floor.
A small, robust fish, the black sea bass is known for its dark, mottled color and meaty texture.
Also known as porgy, the scup is a small fish commonly found in Atlantic coastal waters, recognizable by its silver body with blue and purple tinges.
The bluefish, a moderately proportioned marine fish, is known for its aggressive nature and sharp teeth.  It sports a distinct blue-green coloration.
A large, white-meat fish known for its mild flavor and flaky texture.  Highly prized in both commercial and recreational fishing.
A popular food fish, the haddock is recognized by its dark lateral line and a black blotch above the pectoral fin.
One of the largest and fastest fish in the waters of New England, the bluefin tuna is a streamlined predator with a dark blue back and silvery sides.
The largest flatfish in the ocean, known for its dense, firm texture and mild flavor.
A member of the cod family, pollock is a versatile fish known for its white, delicate meat and mild taste.
A broad fungus, looking much like a glowing blue sunflower.  It appears to emit finer spores than the typical fungal emission.
Looking at first glance like a dull gray privet, this "hedge" is really a mass of barbed fungal tendrils, defending the fungal tower.
A long and delicate-looking tendril with a sharp tip.

A veritable wall of fungus, grown as a natural defense by the fungal spire.  New spores erupt from the surface every few seconds, and tendrils constrict around it, pulling new mass into its shape.  They move with an inexorable strength that could snap limbs.

A pale white fungus, one meaty gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores are periodically expelled from its gills, and a few tendrils extend from the base, allowing mobility and some basic means of defense.

A large white fungus, a bulging gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores float from its gills and tendrils extend from the base.  Chunks of rock, metal, bone, and wood are held by tendrils as a kind of armor.

special_attacks.description: The fungaloid shambler throws a rock!

data.description: An enormous fungal spire, towering over the ground.  It pulsates slowly, continuously growing new defenses.
An immense fungal blossom, towering over its surroundings.  It pulses with a soft blue glow, continuously pumping its spores into the air.

An enormous fungal tower.  On closer inspection, its cap is supported by LOTS of fungal tendrils of various thicknesses, emerging from yet more bristling tendrils at ground level.  Between this redundancy and their noticeable movement creating frequent gaps, it's tough to get a solid shot on the thing.
A fungal stalk several feet in height.  Two vicious-looking tendrils extend from its thorned and leathery exterior, and it moves about faster than the larger fungaloids.
A mass of spores the size of a balled fist, wafting around in the air.
data.//COMMENT: This monster is meant to have the 'PLANT' special attack, allowing the fungus to spread incredibly rapidly. However with that attack their growth becomes *quadratic*, far outside of any reasonable means. There have been various proposals to balance to the faction, but none successfully implemented. If and when it can be balanced it is hoped that one day they can get the attack back. But definitely not before then.
data.//COMMENT2: Same deal as the first comment this is meant to upgrade into mon_fungaloid when the faction has been properly balanced for it.

data.description: Pale, sickly gray in color, this giant ant's cracked exoskeleton is barely held together by coils of fungus erupting from every joint in its body.
The abdomen of this sickly-looking giant spider is now home to many lumps of blooming fungi.  It leaves behind a trail of tainted secretions as it struggles to drag itself along the ground.

A huge wasp the size of a large cat.  It's bright yellow markings have faded and ripped to show a disgusting mass of mold and rot beneath.  Her wings jut into extremely odd angles, making flight impossible.  Even still, it chases anything without any sense of self-preservation.
data.//: sting 3-5 dmg, 40 hits to max intensity, 50 to max duration

data.description: A wasp worker split down the middle.  While it's condition looks fatal, it doesn't seem to die, supposedly by the large mushroom growing from once it's wings were.  It's emotionless face still seems to cry with pain and anger.

A mutated wasp queen that has been consumed by a sickly gray mold covering it's body.  Abandoning it's duty to laying eggs, it seemingly searches for anything to attack, as a mist of spores emit from it's mandibles.

A gigantic wasp worker, its body now a host for a plethora of mushrooms and spores.  Her abdomen glows faintly with a blue light, each pulse bringing a new crack for fungal growths to escape from.  Its stinger seems to have a soul of its own, reaching out towards anything that isn't infested like itself.
data.//: sting 5-15 damage, 8 hits to max intensity, 9 to max duration

data.description: A wasp worker which seems to move like a puppet on strings.  It ambles backwards, its stinger, grotesquely swollen and pulsating, serving as a perverse compass guiding it forward, seeking relentlessly for something—anything—to pierce.  It periodically contracts and then abruptly expands, ejecting a fine mist of spores into the surrounding air.

The head of this colossal queen wasp appears to be attached by only a few slender threads, wobbling precariously as additional tendrils sprout from the silky white exoskeleton.  Her batch of eggs has decayed due to lack of proper care, yet they seem to twitch, as if something within is attempting to break free from the hardened shells.

A mutant bee the size of a small dog.  It's fur, once used to collect pollen has been trapped with thousands of spores.  it moves erratically on the ground, seemingly having great difficulty to keep any sense of coordination as visible growths of mold worsen underneath the thin hairs.

A sickly-sweet smelling gray goo pours from the mandibles of this dog-sized insect, stirs an odd sense of hunger within you.  However, the writhing syringe-looking needle and thick plumes of spores around quickly quell your appetite.
data.//: 21 hits to max intensity, 25 hits to max duration

data.description: This oversized insect's every move is coerced by a seemingly invisible entity, like a puppet on strings.  Thousands of live spores fume from it's mandibles, forming thick clouds.  A stark blue gel leaks from it's splintering limbs, bubbling and sizzling, revealing soft, pulsing gray material beneath.

Large, yellow, coral-like fungi grow from this spot, their spires riddled with intersecting holes.  Despite lack of wind, it seems to wave at a set rhythm, occasionally pulsing out spores.  A chorus of weak, whistly voices, mixed with different accents and languages—some you recognize, others that seem like meaningless gibberish—emanates from it.
This shambling corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This writhing corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
Once alive, then undead, now something else entirely.  Fungal tendrils sprout from its mouth, eyes, and other orifices, holding together a shambling mass of mold-covered flesh.
This grotesquely swollen corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This grotesquely swollen corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.  The overall visual effect is similar to a cherry or upside down lollipop.
With its swollen gray skin overgrown by thick layer of mold, this balloon-like fungal zombie looks like it could violently burst into a cloud of noxious spores at any moment.
This smoke-shrouded corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder lighter in color than smoke and ash.
This smoke-shrouded corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
Every breath of this crooked, fungus-ridden zombie emits a fine dust of spores, and it constantly looks like it's emerging from a cloud of mist.
This moving corpse covered in knobby bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This already horrific moving corpse covered in bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.
This moving corpse covered in twisted bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This already horrific moving corpse covered in twisted bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.
This towering creature covered in plated bone has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
Layers of plates of bone rise high above, ending in a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the enormous bulging skull.

Fungi bloom from the crevices in the ossified plates of this ponderous bone titan, and it seems even its eyes are lost to it.  A dust of spores lands on the ground with every sluggish stomp of its heavy legs.
This small, stumbling child has been dusted with a thick gray powder.  Something about the way it moves is uncanny.
This child moves slowly, as though sleepy.  A short stalk of gray fungus has burst from the top of the little head.
It is hard to recognize a human child in this creature.  Disgusting-looking mold covers most of its skin.  Many cracks perforate its body, with small fungal stalks poking through.
This rotund and bloated corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This rotund and bloated corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
A rotund and bloated human body with pasty, fungus-ridden flesh.  Its mouth drips with a frothing gray sludge.

This small child lies on the ground shaking gently, dusted with a thick gray powder.  The chest of the child appears to have broken open like a gory flower and there is strange pulsing movement and also unpleasant wet sounds within.

This small child lies on the ground smiling serenely, a short stalk of gray fungus bursting triumphantly from the top of the little head.  The chest of the child appears to have broken open like a gory flower and there is strange pulsing movement and also unpleasant wet sounds within.

This severely deformed child lies on its back, its ribs exposed to the sky.  With its limbs contorted in ways only possible through a lack of bones, the child's ribcage stretches far beyond the boundaries of human biology, appearing akin to a bony hive coated in quivering fungal matter.  Spores occasionally waft from its hollowed interior, and, periodically, you can catch sight of weak movement within the abomination's guts.

special_attacks.monster_message: Through a plume of fungal spores, a small beast struggles to take flight from the wretch's abdomen!

data.description: Heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, this small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.

This small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, joined by a short stalk of gray fungus reaching upward.

Infested by a thick crust of fungal growth, this small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it is made of human parts.
This recently-risen body has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, but still moves quickly.
This recently-risen body has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.  This appears to slow it down in some way.
Fungal sprouts seem to support the host's broken legs like crude splints.  Even with its eyes shrouded with tiny spores, it darts towards anything that seems to move in a small radius.
This badly decayed corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This badly decayed corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

The rotten skin that flakes from the host's body seems to be covered in tiny blue dots; occasional popping and crackling sounds are heard, like cracking wood.  This corpse can't be discerned as human by the naked eye.
This muscular moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This muscular corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
This terrifying fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms end in jagged points as fungal tendrils burst forth.
This zombie's entire body bulges with distended muscles heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This inhumanly muscular corpse has numerous festering wounds and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
This bulky fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its chest and face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms and legs are grotesquely swollen.
This zombie's muscular body has swollen to six times the size of an average person and has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This enormous muscular corpse has swollen six times larger and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

This inhumanly warped and swollen fungal construct is entirely covered in thick fungal sprouts.  The body shape is still roughly humanoid but the size is too large, about the size of six people combined.
This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

This fungal monster struggles to move as bulbous mushrooms grow from its exposed back.  Its leg seems to be wrapped in sturdy tendrils, and its arms visibly swell and pop gruesomely with each drag along the ground.
This heavy moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.
This heavy corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.
Thousands upon thousands of fungal bulbs, sprouts and tendrils jut out from every angle of this walking carcass.  Large patches of yellow pulsating mold seem to be growing in the zombie's fat folds.
This heavily scarred moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.
This heavily scarred moving corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

The tough callouses and scar tissue of this unfortunate corpse are the only remaining signs of something once made of flesh; any spot seemingly soft enough has been thoroughly punctured by thick fungal tendrils that have started to creep over this disfigured husk.
This acrid smelling moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.
This sickly looking moving corpse with prominent yellow veins has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

A grotesque fusion of rot and mycelium, this zombie's flesh is pocked with open sores that lazily drool a strange yellow-green acid.  Pale fungal stalks have burst through its corroded skin, their slimy caps dripping with what seems to be the same fluid.  The air around it is thick with the scent of rot and acrid chemicals.
A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding it from the ground up.

A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  It creaks like a loose floorboard.
A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a large mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding into a large mass.

A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a large mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the large pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  Its own weight seems to grind on the bones keeping it together.
A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a giant mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding it from the ground up.

A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a giant mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  Its form is unnaturally hunched over, but its mass alone makes it a threat nonetheless.

The deformed, animated, and again reanimated corpse of a what looked like the concept of a canine.  It has lost almost all of its dog-like features, except for its constant aggressive growling, and tendency to bite.  It shakes its fur like a wet dog, sending tiny spore clouds everywhere.

This formerly-majestic beast has lost any semblance of what a moose is, aside from its outgrown antlers, now covered in writhing fungal tendrils, seemingly trying to break into the cracking bone.  The animated corpse seems to be in a state of constant disrepair, held together by strange, sticky blue orbs.
This four legged, oversized cat seems to spew spores from its pawpads with each clumsy landing, as if constantly gaining and losing balance in air.

This hulking horse-figure seems to re-learn galloping with every step, as large fungi cling and sprout off of its mane.  It travels towards anything moving, even though in the center of each eye lies multiple fungal blooms.
This rotting tiger has lost its stumble, as large fungal bulbs seem to have extended its pawpads thoroughly.  Its head crackles when trying to turn, seemingly stuck facing forward.
This deer's thick fur is spotted with blue orbs that seem to pop and ooze every few minutes, and its rotten skin seems unable to fall off, held together by thick fungal bedding underneath.
This bumpy, discolored reindeer resembles a malformed Rudolph, its nose having a faintly glowing red fungal sprout.  It'd look almost comical if it wasn't mutilating bodies with its innate strength.

description.str: A fake monster.  If you're seeing this something went wrong.

data.description: A huge mutated worm living deep underground.  It has a round, gaping mouth lined with dagger-like teeth, and its flesh is slick with bubbling blue slime.

This huge subterranean creature is a far cry from its earthworm ancestors.  Despite only seeing its head, you can tell its grown to a mind-boggling size.  While the image may be quite unsettling, it doesn't appear to pay you any mind.
A squiggling severed portion of a wounded graboid.
A squiggling severed portion of a wounded giant worm.
A huge, mutated garden worm peeking out from the earth - pink, ringed, and most importantly docile.  Despite its size and looks, it appears to be peaceful.
A disturbingly large wriggling earthworm with the moist earth still clinging to its slimy body.  Despite its size it appears to be peaceful, a refreshing change for once.
A squiggling severed portion of a wounded oversized worm.
A white wriggling worm.
An aggressive mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.

A giant, sickly-looking cockroach that appears to be using the undead as its primary food source.  The diet of infected flesh doesn't seem to harm it, but something about the roach's biology is clearly changing.  It doesn't seem interested in you.
A sickly-looking mutant cockroach about the size of a rat, raised from birth on a healthy diet of zombie flesh.  It still has enough natural instinct left to avoid approaching you.

This giant cockroach has been feeding on the undead for some time and started to mutate chaotically.  Extra limbs and growths sprout from its thorax, and it is notably aggressive even to creatures much larger than itself.
A mutant cockroach the size of a dog.  This size advantage is apparently all it needs to start regarding humans as food!
A baby mutant cockroach about the size of a rat.
A mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.  Its abdomen is heavily swollen with eggs.
An oversized mutated silverfish the size of a small dog.
A mutant silverfish roughly the size of a person.  Doesn't seem at all interested in you.
A baby mutant silverfish about the size of a rat.
A mutant bee the size of a small dog.
With a stinger the size of a kitchen knife, this dog-sized insect's black and yellow markings warn you to leave it undisturbed.
data.//: 21 hits to max intensity, 25 hits to max duration

data.description: An enormous mutant bee with black and white markings and a long stinger spelling doom.
A brightly-colored mutant centipede the size of a small dog, skittering quickly in the underbrush.  Probably won't think you're suitable prey, but beware its venom.

special_attacks.//: Bite does 6-10 dmg, armor penetration 5, 8 hits to max venom intensity

data.description: A two-meter-long centipede with a menacing set of venom-dripping mandibles and a worrying number of grabbing appendages, moving swiftly on dozens of spindly legs.  It has a pair of small compound eyes, but seems to mostly orient itself with its antennae.
data.//: 10-20 dmg, 4 hits to max intensity, 5 hits to max duration

data.description: A juvenile centipede.  Despite its young age it is still quite large and you reckon these mandibles could pack quite a bite.

A giant centipede grown even larger, hind segments curled up to protect a huge clump of eggs and its children of different ages.  Sometimes one of its young gets shaken off by its clutchmates and disappears into the underbrush.

special_attacks.monster_message: A small centipede is shaken off in the struggle!

data.description: A huge mutated centipede covered in interlocking chitinous plates of metallic gray, reminding you more of a runaway train car than any living animal.  Its mandibles end in jagged points, seemingly specialized to hunt prey at least as well-armored as itself.  You really don't want to try if you'd fare better.
data.//: 3 hits to max intensity, 4 to max duration

data.description: A mass of spindly legs the size of a large dog.  It is watching you intently, but doesn't go out of its way to hunt you.

A house centipede grown to immense size, with a slender body the size of a child held up by a constantly-twitching mess of legs.  Already a fearsome hunter at its normal scale, both its hunger and range of acceptable prey grew to match its new size.
A baby house centipede about the size of a rat.

A predatory, aquatic dragonfly larva, normally barely a centimeter long and feeding on small fish, grown to the size of a catfish.  Underneath its sharp mandibles you can see that its folded lower jaw has changed into something resembling a barbed spear.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s's mouthpart shoots out at you, and it pierces your %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s's mouthpart shoots out at <npcname>, and it pierces their %2$s!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s's mouthpart hits your %2$s, but it glances off your armor!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s's mouthpart hits <npcname>'s %2$s, but it glances off their armor!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s thrusts its mouthpart at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %s thrusts its mouthpart at <npcname>, but they dodge!

data.description: A ferocious, bright green dragonfly, still lightning-fast despite growing to the size of a schoolchild.  Its head is little more than a basketball-sized pair of rainbow compound eyes, and its legs - already specialized for grasping prey - end in curved talons.

What appears to be a single, enormous insect with a swollen abdomen is actually the unholy union of two dragonflies in the act of mating, bodies still locked into the telltale heart shape.  The remains of their wings and abdomens form an egg sac they sluggishly pull between them, periodically dropping a handful of glistening eggs.

A mutated firefly grown to the size of a large housecat, brightly glowing abdomen bobbing up and down as it tries to impress its unseen mate.  It looks strangely uninterested in you and everything else.
An oversized larva of a firefly.  Shockingly large when compared to the adults of its kind.
A mutant housefly the size of a small dog.  Its buzzing is high-pitched and somehow sad.
A tremendous housefly the size of a dog, predictably accompanied by a loud, incessant buzzing sound.
A grub the size of a small dog.
A mutant housefly the size of a cow, creating a loud buzzing sound as it inexplicably stays airborne.
A mutant mosquito the size of a small dog, buzzing and fluttering erratically.
A giant mutant mosquito the size of a dog, fluttering erratically.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.
A large mosquito larva.  A bit more unsettling now that it isn't microscopic.
A mutant mosquito the size of a cow, with huge, thin wings and legs.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.
A mutant moth fly the size of a rabbit.
A moth fly the size of a small dog.  It appears to pay you no mind.
A large moth fly larva.

A cellar spider - also known as "daddy long-legs" - grown to distressing size.  Its body is about the size of your head, with the long, spindly legs raising it up to your knee.  It tries getting away from you with an unnervingly fluid run.

A huge brown spider in constant movement, with a small body the size of a child held up at chest level by a set of spindly legs that branch into three-pronged graspers at the end.  Unlike the smaller variant it obviously decided hunting you is worth a try, and follows you with mandibles chittering in anticipation.
A juvenile cellar spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

This surprisingly shy giant cellar spider holds a head-sized ball of crawling spiderlings of different ages in its mandibles, carefully balancing on her long legs not to drop the precious cargo.  She seems uninterested in you.

death_function.message: The spiderlings fall to the ground!

data.description: A tangle of branching chitinous legs operating seemingly independently, somehow still managing to carry a cow-sized central body.  A number of malformed, twitching legs hang from the cephalothorax, but the head -and especially the mandibles- still seem to be in working order.

special_attacks.monster_message: The maimed legs start twitching erratically!

effects.message: One of the %s's legs falls limp!
One of the %s's legs falls limp!
One of the %s's legs is disabled!

data.description: The strangely branching leg of a mutated cellar spider that… fell?  crawled?  off of the main body when hurt.  It now flails about blindly, irregular clawed appendages grasping at anything that comes close.
A mutant spider the size of a small dog with long forelegs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.
A dog-sized mutant spider with big forelegs and two pairs of inquisitive-looking eyes.  It can leap quite quickly, even into the treetops.
data.//: 13 hits to max intensity, 17 hits to max duration

data.description: A juvenile jumping spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

An enormous hairy mutated spider the size of a cow, with strong forelegs and a raised, bloated thorax.  Its vast increase in size has caused it to lose much of its mobility, and when near it you can smell rotten eggs for some reason…
A dark brown mutant spider the size of a dog with a bulbous thorax, big eyes, and oversized fangs.
A gigantic dark brown spider with a bulbous thorax.  It digs a deep underground burrow that serves as a pit to trap unwary prey.
A juvenile trapdoor spider, about the size of a beer bottle.
A cow-sized mutant spider with strong, thick legs and a bulbous thorax, dark brown in color.  Anything it pulls into its underground lair is unlikely to see the light of day again.
A light gray mutant spider the size of a dog with a long legs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.
A giant, light gray mutant grass spider, it waits for prey to become ensnared in the vast webs that it weaves between the trees.
data.//: 5 hits to max intensity, 6 hits to max duration

data.description: A cow-sized mutated grass spider with long spindly legs, light gray in color.  It moves ponderously, depending on its webs to prevent prey from fleeing.
A juvenile giant grass spider, about the size of a beer bottle.  Too young to be venomous, or to walk proficiently for that matter.
A black mutant spider the size of a small dog with a long legs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.  There is a red hourglass shape on its thorax.
A dog-sized mutated black widow spider.  There is a red hourglass shape on its thorax.  A highly venomous nightmare come to life.
A cow-sized mutated black widow spider with a distinctive red hourglass shape on its thorax.  Still possesses its infamous venom, but it probably doesn't even need that to crush you like a bug.
The horrid spawn of a giant black widow spider.  Though, given the size that it currently is, it appears relatively harmless.
A shaggy brown mutant spider the size of a dog with eight long legs, two especially big eyes, and oversized fangs.
A wolf spider mutated to about thirty times its normal size, it moves quickly and aggressively to catch and consume prey.
data.//: 5 hits to max intensity, 6 hits to max duration

data.description: A juvenile wolf spider, about the size of a beer bottle.
A cow-sized, hairy mutant wolf spider.  Its mouthparts have noticeably changed, and it moves much more slowly now with the additional weight it needs to carry.

A dog-sized white grub, featureless apart from a vestigial mouthpart.  It hangs upside-down in its cell, and regurgitates sweet-smelling fluid in return for the scraps of viscera fed to it by the workers below.
data.//: 30 days of development from egg to adult.

data.description: A wasp larva undergoing metamorphosis into a full-grown giant wasp.  It looks like a strangely immobile adult coated in a thin white membrane, its legs and wings packed tightly into its cell.
A huge wasp the size of a large cat with bright yellow markings on her jet-black carapace and a threatening stinger.  She flies around erratically, searching for smaller prey.
data.//: sting 3-5 dmg, 40 hits to max intensity, 50 to max duration

data.description: A mutated wasp worker, buzzing around the nest.  While her foraging sisters are relatively content to leave you be, this one won't hesitate to attack anything she considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

A mutated wasp queen grown to the size of a person, laying a single white egg in each empty cell she comes across while scurrying around on the paper walls of her home.  She struggles to fit into some of them, but the newer cells seem to be getting larger…

A gigantic wasp worker, scouring the landscape for an easy meal to feed the next generation.  Her abdomen glowers with ominous yellow stripes and ends in a half-hidden stinger the size of a kitchen knife.
data.//: sting 5-15 damage, 8 hits to max intensity, 9 to max duration

data.description: A wasp worker grown to the size of a person, buzzing around her home.  While her foraging sisters are relatively content to live and let live, this one won't hesitate to attack anything she considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

A yellowjacket queen grown to the size of a horse, towering over her daughters.  Even with her abdomen swollen with eggs and wings long unused she still poses a threat to interlopers, should her children have failed at subduing them.
data.//: sting 15-45 damage, 6 hits to max intensity, 8 to max duration; bite 10-30

data.description: A fat white grub as big as a squirrel, with a pair of large, spadelike mandibles.
A colorful parasitoid wasp grown to the size of a dog, with a huge ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She darts around in search of a suitable home for her many, many children.

A dermatik grown even larger, her wings and ovipositor chewed off by her sisters.  She now stands watch in the nest, tending to the unfortunate hosts dragged home and ensuring they don't perish before their purpose is fulfilled.

A recently pupated parasitoid wasp the size of a large cat, with a raw fleshy look to her pale exoskeleton and an underdeveloped ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She's extricating her wings with repeating spastic motions from the fraying membrane they are still bound in, almost ready to search for a suitable home for her many, many children.

special_attacks.monster_message: %1$s pulls her wings free and begins to take flight!

data.description: A recently pupated parasitoid wasp the size of a large cat, with a raw fleshy look to her pale exoskeleton and a fully developed ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She sluggishly buzzes about on still-stiffening wings, ready to search for a suitable home for her many, many children.
A paralyzed, emaciated deer.  It spasms as it notices your presence, terrified eyes darting around the muddy chamber when it fails to stand and flee.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

data.description: A barely living dog, panting in a pool of slime and blood.  As you draw near it lets out a faint whimper, and you see the smallest hint of a twitch in its tail.
A giant, mutated spider lying on its back, legs twitching without pause.  A translucent slime, mixed with its ichor seeps from its joints, and its chitin is marked by numerous exit wounds.
A mutant red ant the size of a dog, covered in chitinous plates.  She possesses a pair of wriggling antennae and vicious-looking mandibles.
An enormous red ant covered in chitinous plates.  She possesses a pair of wriggling antennae and vicious-looking mandibles.
data.//: No stinging, for now

data.description: A dog-sized mutant brown ant with a swollen abdomen that ends with a small orifice at the tip.  Glistening liquid drips out periodically.
A monstrous brown ant with a swollen abdomen that ends with a small orifice at the tip.  Glistening liquid seems to drip out periodically.
data.//: No stinging, for now

data.description: A squirming yellow grub that seems to be oozing liquid from both ends of its body.  It appears its chitin hasn't developed enough to resist acid.

An enormous brown ant with an elongated, pulsating abdomen.  Her orifice seems developed only for egg-laying rather than spraying acid like the rest of the colony, but she doesn't seem affected by the acrid liquid either.
A massive woolly brown ant that towers over the worker ants with a giant head crest.  Along with her huge mandibles, a corrosive liquid seeps from the end of her bloated abdomen.

A cow-sized, woolly brown ant.  Corrosive liquid seeping from her huge mandibles.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.
A pulsating sausage of glistening white flesh, the size of a large cat.  On one end is a set of squirming mouth parts.
A colossal red ant with a bulging, bloated thorax.  She moves slowly and deliberately, tending to nearby eggs and continually laying more.
A huge and hairy red ant almost twice the size of other giant ants.  Bulging pincers extend from her jaws.

A cow-sized, hairy red ant.  Bulging pincers extend from her jaws.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.
A yellow and brown mutated locust the size of a small dog, with big eyes and long, powerful legs.
A yellow and brown mutated locust the size of a dog with big eyes and long, powerful legs.  You don't think it'll eat you, but it could cause massive damage to nearby plants.
A cow-sized yellow and brown mutated locust with huge, staring eyes and long, powerful legs.  The bane of the post-apocalyptic farmer.
A locust the size of a rabbit.  You'd hate to think what a swarm of these could do.
This huge aphid is as big as a hamster.  It's not as thirsty as bigger ones, but a herd of these could eat your crops easily.
A green aphid about the size of a rabbit.  It is constantly searching for plants to suck from.
A green mutant insect with sharp grappling spikes on its front legs.  It's a little smaller than an adult person.
An enormous green insect grown to about the size of a bear.  It moves in a weird, dance-like pattern and looks ready to chop your head off at any moment.
data.//grab: Good at pulling, grabbing, chewing your face off afterwards

data.description: A mantis nymph about the size of a dog.  Even though its far smaller than the adults, you have a feeling it wouldn't take kindly to you coming too close.
This ferocious cow-sized mantis stalks the fields of New England.  It's probably capable of killing a moose with its powerful arms.
An enormous underground bug.  Beware its ear-splitting screech and strong shovel-like front legs.
A whitish mole cricket nymph the size of a dog.
This is a mutated lady bug the size of a big dog.  While not as dangerous as her giant sisters, she's still troublesome to deal with.

The normal-sized version of this red and black beetle is generally considered cute, and is adored by children and associated with good luck.  This monster, on the other hand is clearly a ferocious predator capable of killing swarms of ants, aphids, and unprepared humans.
A large armored larva looking not unlike a centipede.  Even though it's just a juvenile the armor on its back already looks functional.
A large grasshopper a few times bigger than a regular one.
A huge green grasshopper about the size of a big dog, with long and strong back legs.  It hops, it hops and never stops.
A grasshopper nymph the size of a rabbit.
Something about this cow-sized larva is pitiable, despite its immense size and sickening cream color.
data.//: when taming becomes more involved, this should be slowly tameable with honeydew, allowing for a tamed stag beetle through almost a year of effort

data.description: It was called a giant even before the Cataclysm, but now this mutant beetle is the size of a small horse.  It looks ready to molt again, even though parts of the shell are still soft.
This enormous stag beetle has reached mutated maturity, but continues to grow.  Thankfully, that growth is exposing vulnerable cracks of flesh in the strained chitin.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s rams you in the %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s rams <npcname> in the %2$s!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s rams your %2$s, but you hold steady!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s rams <npcname>'s %2$s, but they hold steady!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s flicks its horns at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %s flicks its horns at <npcname>, but they dodge!

data.description: This stag beetle rivals an armored personnel carrier in size, bearing horns that could fell a tree and chitin thick enough to ignore most bullets.  Its bulky shell looks nigh-impenetrable, and the cracks have sealed with a foul paste.

weakpoints.name: a foul scar in the chitin

data.description: This huge grub has powerful mandibles and a hungry look.  It hides in the dirt and awaits its prey.
A ferocious mutant flying antlion as big as a cat, darting through the air with a cluster of fangs for a mouth.  Despite its dangerous looks, it doesn't seem interested in you.
This water bug is several times larger than a regular one.  Its movements are fast and fluid.
This water glider is about as big as a domestic cat.  Its legs are more fin-like and a swollen body is mostly submerged underwater.
A water strider nymph the size of a rabbit.
An oversized butterfly with vibrant colored markings.  Unlike the other big insects of the Cataclysm this is a very peaceful nectivore.
A mutated butterfly larger than a human.  Despite its size it is very lightweight and feeds mainly on the nectar produced by triffid flowers.
An enormous butterfly with regal looking wings.  This giant of the sky flies cheerfully under the sun, leaving dust as it passes.
An oversized moth with its typical wood-like motifs.  It is as peaceful as the mutated butterflies found during the day.
A mutated moth larger than a human.  It silently flies with its huge wings after dusk looking for nocturnal flowers to feed upon.
A majestic moth painted in pale colors.  This giant of the night only comes out after the moon is out, leaving glittering dust.
The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.
A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.
The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.
A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.
The mutated larval form of a cicada.  It doesn't produce noise like the adults but its digging claws seem suited for scratching.
A huge cicada the size of a person.  These insects are mostly harmless but may bite if attacked and produce a loud buzzing sound.
A woodlouse grown to the size of a dog.  These humble crustaceans are harmless and enjoy damp places.
Woodlice reproduce by carrying their eggs in a pouch and releasing them as juveniles.  Their mancae look like small adults except for their pale color.
The predatory, aquatic larva of a diving beetle grown to large proportions.  It is quite slow but still a good ambusher.
Water beetles can be found in all freshwater environments, with diving beetles being their predatory variant.  These however seem to have grown far larger with the Cataclysm.
A slender relative of the water bug, grown close to human size.  It uses its long tail as a snorkel while ambushing prey.
The nymph of a water scorpion, looks like a smaller version of its parents.

An amalgamation of throbbing organs from various creatures have fused together into this lurching, vaguely-humanoid shape.  Its myriad roughly-formed mouths susurrate in a chorus of sibilant groans and whispers.

A seeping conglomeration of spasming muscle and organs have fused together into this towering caricature of the human form.  Various organs fall off of its hulking body only to be reabsorbed moments later.

A putrid amalgamation of body parts from humans and other creatures have fused together in this aberration of flesh.  The eyes of all the heads dart about rapidly and the mouths form a chorus of groaning screams.
data.//: Forest of limbs and heads mean multiple grabs and bites

data.description: This octopus seems larger than you remember from visits to the aquarium and doesn't seem as slowed by land as would be expected.  Its body seems to mimic its surroundings.
A young Cecaelia.  If one is out here, a very protective parent is likely nearby.
The kind of octopus that can take down small boats by itself.
data.//grab: Not getting much more grabby than a half-ton octopus

data.description: The water froths as a great bulk of tentacles breach the surface.  A great bulk swiftly rises until the beak rises above the water and a shriek erupts from the beast.
data.//grab: Could get higher, but keeping the 0-100 scale for now

description.str: Placeholder for human corpses.  If you see this, it's a bug.
Placeholder for charred human corpses.  If you see this, it's a bug.
Placeholder for children corpses.  If you see this, it's a bug.

data.description: One of the vesper bats, a family of winged insect-eating mammals.  It roosts in caves and other hollows, and uses a form of echolocation to aerially navigate through tricky terrain at rapid speeds.
data.//: I ain't about to make a unique bat faction when I don't know any predators specialized in hunting bats but not birds. Batman's gotta make do.

data.description: A juvenile American black bear.  This one isn't much of a threat, but be wary of its parent; black bears are known for their protectiveness.

The American black bear.  A large omnivorous scavenger, it has powerful claws and jaws, and is an effective ambush hunter.  Most individuals are shy around humans, but they're fiercely protective of their cubs.
data.//: 220 days gestation period, the mother and cubs remain together for 16-17 months.

data.description: The North American beaver, the continent's largest rodent.  Its paddle-shaped tail helps ferry it through the water, and its prominent teeth can chew through wood, which it uses to build dam-like nests in lakes and streams.
data.//: 128 days gestation period + 14 days average to wean the young.

data.description: A small baby beaver.
data.//: 2 years to reach independence.

data.description: The black rat, an omnivorous rodent with sheer black fur and a long, rough tail.  Harbinger of pestilence, famine, and mange, it will sometimes swarm over the dead or dying.

The albino Norway rat, an omnivorous rodent with sleek white fur and a long, rough tail.  While its ancestors were harbingers of plague, these clever animals are omnipresent in modern biomedical research.  Due to its albino nature, its vision in both day and nighttime environments is very diminished.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s lets out a happy squeak as you give its head a small scritch.

data.description: Originally not native in the U.S., this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig gone feral in the wilderness.  This one is just a baby, and is surprisingly cute.

Originally not native in the U.S., this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig gone feral in the wilderness.  Its population has skyrocketed during the last few decades.
A spotted wild cat living across much of North America.  It is not a serious threat to humans, but it can be aggressive when threatened.
A cuddly kitten meowing and scampering amidst the death.  Currently feral.
data.//: Kittens do not have their full fur yet and are really sensitive to cold temperature

data.description: In the absence of human stewardship, this small, domesticated predator has grown wary of humans.  Harried by the elements and the rigors of survival, it has become very skittish but is still motivated by food.
data.//: Their fur keeps them warm

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s softly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

data.description: A small domesticated predator gone feral in the absence of human stewardship.  Located near the old Isherwood cabin.
This fluffy feline has longer hair than average.  Looks both beautiful and warm.  You want to bury your face in its soft fur and forget about the Cataclysm.
data.//: Longer fur, more cold protection

data.description: Barely more than a ball of fluff with eyes, this kitten looks like a longhair breed.
Impressively large for a domestic cat, this thick-haired breed was once native to the state of Maine.
This young Maine coon has tufted ears and a striking pattern on its face.
This cat has the distinctive dark extremities of a Siamese, first native to Asia but a common domestic breed in North America.
With cream-colored fur and dark points, you guess this kitten must be a young Siamese.
The short nose and rounded face of this cat suggest it comes from the popular Persian breed.  Its fur is already matted without anyone being able to groom it.
An adorably squashed nose and sad pleading eyes beg you to adopt this tiny Persian.
Looking like a spotted wild cat, the Bengal breed derives from the Asian leopard cat and Egyptian Mau.  Domesticated but very energetic.
You have seen spots like this on Bengal cats, but this one is just a kitten.
An unusual-looking cat with strikingly large eyes and ears, sporting a soft curly coat of fur.
This curly-coated kitten has enormous ears and inquisitive eyes, possibly a Devon Rex.
The Sphynx cat has practically no fur on its body, exposing its curiously wrinkled skin.
data.//: No fur, no cold protection

The Northern bog lemming, a small, predominantly vegetarian rodent that spends its life in the murk of swamps and other wetlands.  Contrary to popular belief, these creatures are not particularly hapless or suicidal, but they can eat themselves into scarcity within a few generations.
The American mink, a partially aquatic weasel, once factory-farmed for its fur.  It is a capable fisher, but the presence of otters in these parts makes it rely more on food from the land.
Small subterranean mammals, they have cylindrical bodies, velvety fur, very small inconspicuous eyes and ears, reduced hindlimbs and short powerful forelimbs with large paws adapted for digging.
The Eastern moose, the largest living species of deer.  While they aren't typically aggressive unless provoked, the autumn mating season can make the bulls quite ill-tempered.
The baby moose is called a calf.  They can outrun a human within days of birth and gain weight at an incredible pace.
data.//: 4-5 years to reach sexual maturity, so we're assuming 3.5 years to reach roughly the size of an adult.

data.description: A mutant variety of megafauna that evolved after the Cataclysm.  Easily recognized by the underslung tusks off each side of the mouth, in addition to an impressive rack of antlers. data.description: The baby moose is called a calf and so are its mutant descendants.  They can outrun a human within days of birth and gain weight at an incredible pace.

The common striped skunk, similar in size to opossum or domestic cats, these mammals can often be smelled before they are seen.

The Boeing-Daewoo RMES (Recon Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be used in a scout-recon-sniper role, due to its mobility, integrated laser sniper rifle, and suite of optics for target designation and battlefield awareness.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

The Boeing-Daewoo CMES (Combat Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be used in a fire support role, due to its fearsome integrated Gatling laser.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

The Boeing-Daewoo LMES (Lifting Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be piloted by an operator to load and unload heavy material, and for limited combat support roles.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

data.description: A deformed mutant in a torn jumpsuit, looking at you with insane hatred.  Their skin is a chaotic mix of scales, fur and chitin, and their fingers end in long talons.

A towering mutated test subject, covered in thick fur and the torn bottom part of a jumpsuit.  Their legs end in large padded feet not unlike a dog's, but they still manage to stand upright, freeing up their clawed hands to tear you apart.

A gigantic mutated test subject, still wearing the tattered remains of an orange jumpsuit.  They walk on four warped legs ending in hooves, and their head is dominated by a glistening, tangled crown of antlers that scratch the ceiling.

A horribly mutated experimental subject.  Their original body - still wearing an orange jumpsuit - flops around lifelessly, carried by twelve segmented legs covered in hairy chitin erupting from their back.  At the base of the front pair of legs, an almost-human scalp gives way to a dozen irregularly-sized eyes and a set of mandibles, and from their hind end a stinger not unlike a scorpion's emerges.

A mutated test subject, running on all fours at alarming speed.  Their short fur changes color to match the background in an instant, making you struggle to keep the thing in focus.  Their thin limbs end in long talons, and their mouth is held perpetually open by a set of knife-sized fangs.

An experimental subject wearing a surprisingly clean orange jumpsuit.  They look unchanged at a distance, but as you approach their head spins towards you with unnatural speed.  Their face is disconcertingly beautiful, but their eyes shine with an intelligence far beyond human - and a deep disgust directed at you.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mutant gestures at you and barks a few orders, sending its pack of mutants into a frenzy.

data.description: A thin child with a shaved head, wearing a too-large white lab coat over a baggy orange jumpsuit.  They turn their head towards you with uncanny speed, and you're taken aback by the inhuman curiosity burning in their eyes.  Their angelic smile does very little to reassure you of their intentions.

death_function.message: The child's eyes widen, and they try to say something before falling to the ground.

data.description: An enormous mutant hidden beneath a gray segmented shell, crawling on a carpet of innumerable tentacles covered with suckers.  They hold three thicker, branching limbs high on their front end, each dotted with dozens of unblinking eyeballs.
Sometime between the Cataclysm and now, this black bear has gained two extra heads.  This doesn't seem to have improved its disposition.
This mutated beaver is almost double its normal size, and its back is covered with tough-looking bristles.
An unnaturally large baby beaver with an array of bristles covering its back.
This mutant beaver's body is covered with brightly-colored feathers in a particularly eyecatching pattern.  It must have been very lucky not to have been caught by a predator before now.
This beaver kit lacks any fur covering its body, instead looking reminiscent of a plucked chicken.
Were it not for the misshapen snout and visible teeth, this would look like an ordinary Northeastern coyote.  Closer inspection of its mouth reveals row after row of serrated, shark-like teeth.
A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.
Unnatural bulges line the neck of this obviously-mutated coyote; green-tinted foam flecks from its lips, and there's a crazed look in its eyes.
A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.
This once-ordinary deer has grown a disturbingly agile array of extra limbs, plus three extra eyes.  Its antlers wriggle subtly in the wind.
data.//: 201 days gestation period. The fawn will stay with its mother for approximately one year, suckling for three to four months.

data.description: This obviously mutated adolescent deer moves unsteadily on its eight legs, nervously scanning the area with all five eyes.
This dog of unidentifiable breed looks like it has seen better days.  Its wiry hair is patchy, revealing scales underneath, but it still happily wags its tails anyways.

This dog has undergone visible mutation.  While its body is larger than normal, its legs are noticeably elongated, muscular and covered in long cord-like fur.  It easily stands as tall as you and watches your every move closely with reflective eyes.
data.//: 1-4 puppies & 270 days per-litter for size small canines

data.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its legs seems off.

This stocky dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its jaw has widened and features more teeth than any dog should ever have.  While its toothy grin is unnerving, its tail wags as energetically as ever.
data.//: 1-4 puppies & 270 days per-litter for size small canines

data.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its mouth seems off.
This dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its paws are larger than normal and have developed long digging nails.  Its fur is extremely short, barely covering its leathery skin.
data.//: 1-4 puppies & 270 days per-litter for size small canines

data.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its paws seems off.

data.description: This dog is so heavily mutated you weren't entirely sure of the original animal for a moment.  It has no fur at all, being covered entirely by scales instead, and its serpentine head has yellow eyes and a pair of vicious fangs near the front of its muzzle.  It is not looking at you like it wants you to pet it.
data.//2: 1-4 puppies & 270 days per-litter for size small canines

special_attacks.//: Bite does 6-10 dmg, armor penetration 5, 8 hits to max venom intensity

data.description: A heavily mutated small dog.  Almost all of its fur has been replaced by scales, and it has no ears.  Its eyes are an unsettling yellow color.
Its paws have grown to be longer, and it seems capable of briefly standing on its hindlimbs.  You wonder if this sleazy beast is able to open doors yet.
An eight-foot-tall, ghastly white penguin.  Its muscular body suggests immense strength, but it seems placid unless otherwise provoked.
A hellish, vaguely humanoid horror, two stories tall.  Its face is grotesquely stretched out, its limbs deformed to unrecognizable outgrowths.

This is some form of unnatural changeling creature; its appearance is a bland mockery of the human form.  Featureless and pale, its repugnant countenance is all the more unsettling due to its lack of eyes and distinguishing features except for a perfectly round mouth.  Adding to its unearthly appearance is the way it moves, stiff and doll-like as though it was only feigning knowing how to walk.
This was some form of unnatural changeling creature, but now it's you.  It looks like you.  It moves like you.  It even smiles like you.
A defiled human body, once living.  Tortured to death long ago, it remains chained to the altar, the putrescent flays of its peeled skin quivering like so much flotsam upon a murky pond.

This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.
A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.
Uncountable jagged spikes, cleaving reality as they fly through its invisible seams.
Misshapen spikes of concrete and rebar crumble upwards from the floor, held aloft by strands of visual distortion.  Sound around it is drowned and distorted into an incessant drone.

death_function.message: The distortion fades as the %s crumbles.

special_attacks.monster_message: Scraps of metal fly off the spur and into the nearby swarms!

data.description: It stalks thin slices of reality like gossamer threads, each a narrow conduit between worlds unknown and its kaleidoscopic maw.
An explosion of glistening fangs, itself a small fragment of a greater horror.
Strands of shadow snap from their ordained positions, briefly reaching out before recoiling back into the darkness.
The distressed movements of the juvenile reveal conjoined layers of flailing legs and fangs.

death_function.message: The %s shatters like pane of glass.

data.description: Layers of flailing limbs struggle against an impaled emerald lance.
A gigantic shadow, chaotically changing in shape and volume.  Two piercing orbs of light dominate what can only be described as its head.

data.description: A former cultist of some sinister order, now a walking corpse.  Strange scars on their body indicate that they must have participated in unspeakable rites before, or after, their demise.
A domesticated mongrel of the canine persuasion.  In the absence of human society, it has turned feral.

An enormous disembodied eyeball the size of a person, flying through the air through some unknown agency.  Wreathed in unnatural flickering blue flame, it possesses a blazing yellow iris with a slitted pupil like that of a cat, and trails a set of flailing black tendrils as it slowly drifts about.  You involuntarily get a heavy, sinking feeling deep in your gut as you watch its gaze comb over the world around it.

data.description: A half-polypous, utterly alien creature.  It's only partly material and has the ability to fly, despite the absence of wings.  It produces strange whistling noises which dominate every other sound.

data.description: There was nothing here a moment ago, but now you see the faintest outline of an otherworldly creature approaching you with jittery leaps.  Trying to focus on it reveals a pointed beak dripping translucent fluid and rows upon rows of bladed legs grasping the floor, before your eyes begin to burn and your head starts to spin.
data.//grab: Great at pulling, bad at holding - maybe it's playing with you

data.description: This is some sort of unnatural cross between a bull and a man.  Quite different from the minotaur of legend, it possesses a shaggy white bull's head on an otherwise unremarkable human body.  Clad in sagging socks and stained jockey shorts, it grunts and snuffles, drooling ropey strands of white slobber down its chest.  You occasionally catch a glint in its eyes and freeze up involuntarily, like a deer in headlights.

This is some form of eldritch monstrosity; an uncouth black being with smooth, oily skin and unpleasant horns that curve inward toward each other.  Tall and thin, the shadows cling unnaturally to its vaguely defined humanoid form as it shuffles along, its hands twitching and spasming so rapidly as to appear a little more than a black blur of claws.  Despite the night-terror esque appearance, it doesn't appear aggressive.
A dog's body with a mass of ropey, black tentacles reaching out from its head.

A burial shroud contours a humanoid form which frequently breaks when the shadows of its all too many limbs press against the garment.  What limbs you can see are unnervingly life-like, and heavily adorned with bracelets and golden chains.

Isometry is torn from the fine structure of space, and the emptiness between disgorges its terrible brood upon the world.  Its form is both incomprehensibly vast and infinitely narrow, with splayed limbs that could fold into the paper-thinness of edges.

data.description: A grotesque dog-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, its twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare step beyond time and space.

data.description: An enormous fleshy snail, with an oddly human face.  Eyestalks protrude from where the eyes should be.

This is some sort of great viperine creature, possessed of a curiously distorted head and massive clawed appendages.  It partially supports itself with the aid of black, rubbery wings of monstrous dimensions.  The wings beat slowly like an eagle while the body coils through the air like how an eel swims in water.

This is some form of otherworldly hound.  Lean and hungry-looking, its twisted red flesh is stretched tightly across its misshapen, angular frame.  Loping grotesquely along, its unusually long neck stretches forward, its skull-like head near the ground as it sniffs out its prey.  Its foulness partially veiled by some arcane force, it seems to almost flicker in and out of your perceptions as if you were looking at it from the corner of your vision.
data.//: a good candidate for an alien anatomy harvest

data.description: An animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, trying to forcefully supplant your own.
