data.description: An animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it glides silently across the floor, wriggling and flexing as it moves.

A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  The rapid and chaotic way it reconstitutes itself gives the impression of it boiling over with some kind of primordial fury.
An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.
A human body, but with its limbs, neck, and hair impossibly twisted.  It clambers around swiftly, making awful screeching sounds.

A huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long fangs glistening with ropey strands of saliva, which leave smoldering stains wherever they drip.

special_attacks.description: The yugg launches a viscous barb!

data.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

An animate blotch of conflicting symmetries, erratically hovering through the air.  It's not even real enough to hold a stable shape, and its entire form is constantly in flux.  You can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shifting mass passes through you as if you were an illusion, and a slight wave of fatigue washes over you.

data.description: A twisted shape floating in midair; its angles don't seem to quite add up - it hurts to look at.  Is it inanimate?  Alive?  Something else?  You can't make heads or tails of it at all, but you can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: You get a very clear view of the impossible shape.

data.description: Every sense you have claims this space to be empty, but your mind is not fooled.  There is an emptiness here that is far from natural or safe.

special_attacks.monster_message: The absence intensifies.

death_function.message: The %s returns to normal levels of empty.

data.description: A gigantic, probing appendage blindly feeling the area around it.  All of your senses scream at you that it's the size of a truck, and yet it only takes up about as much space in the world as you do.  It seems to be jutting through a portal, suggesting that it's merely a smaller extension of something much larger.

death_function.message: The %s is pulled back through the closing portal.

data.description: An oblong figure floating parallel with the ground, some feet in the air like a piece of paper - Its far thinner than one as well, to the point it would be invisible if looked at with the right angle.

special_attacks.monster_message: Standing close to the %s, your body is violently dragged down to the second dimension.  You're there for only an instant but the experience is enough to send you reeling.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

data.description: The silhouette of a human body, reaching towards you like it needs help.  It has no eyes, but you can still feel it staring through you.

death_function.message: The %s begins to cry as it disappears.

data.description: Your mind can't decide if this is a vast structure, or an endless swarm of tiny flying sharp things.  The only thing you know for sure is that it is far too large to fit in the space it occupies.

special_attacks.monster_message: The integrity of spacetime is violated.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

data.description: You are uncertain whether this dwarfs you or you dwarf it.  Its exact shape and number of dimensions is constantly changing, but it is always sharp enough to cut a moment in half.

special_attacks.monster_message: You are cut in ways worse than physical.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

data.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies as if it reacted to you.
data.//: No NETHER or it will run away at low HP

special_attacks.monster_message: The chunk twists and tears itself as it reacts to your presence!

death_function.message: The material stabilizes and reforms itself into a small chunk of unknown composition.

data.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles and pulses on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its pulsing intensifies as if it reacted to you.

This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles violently and noisily on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes sparkling with electricity.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies and its sparks grow brighter as if it reacted to you.
This looks nothing like you.  It's barely real.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

death_function.message: The %s vanishes but you can still feel it.

special_attacks.monster_message: You can feel the %s.

data.description: This looks almost nothing like you.  Its form isn't even stable.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?
This only looks a little like you.  It's obviously not you.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?
This doesn't look like you.  It looks like what you've dreamed you could be.  Why does your mind keep mistaking you for a bad copy of it?

A figure in a high-tech suit, their outline contorted as though you were viewing them through a prism.  Their movements are strained but determined, pushing through apparent pain with feverish resolve, dead-set on reaching their target.

special_attacks.monster_message: The creature screams "SOMEONE HELP ME, ANYONE!".

data.description: A figure in combat gear, distorted and shattered like broken glass.  They thrash around as they move, an expression of shock and anguish frozen on their face.

death_function.message: The soldier fades away to nothing.

data.description: Your shadow is host to something alien.

death_function.message: Your shadow seemingly becomes normal again.

data.description: A common human.  It looks exactly like a human looks.  You can see them.  They can see you.  You know they know you can see them.  They know you know you can see them.  They move towards you.
data.//: it must be spooky, but god im bad in this stuff

special_attacks.monster_message: You feel something was destroyed inside you.

data.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, memories of your wrongdoings rise to the surface.

special_attacks.monster_message: The guilt makes no physical movement and yet you feel the force of its assault.  Everything feels heavier.

data.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, a desire to stop moving rises.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sloth does nothing, and you feel time itself aiding your desire to do nothing.

data.description: What looks to be a loose mass of worm-like appendages reveals a solid body beneath, a great maw of rows of serrated fangs taking up most of the body.  It is either very lethargic or stalking prey, sitting in place without much obvious motion.
A wriggling brown grub of unnatural origin, slithering along the ground and unnaturally pulsating.  As it moves along, it chews through any available flesh with surprising speed.
A strange quadrupedal creature with long, lanky limbs and a gaping maw.  A long sharp spike protrudes from its back, which occasionally launches from its joint to stab prey before slinking back in.
A very wet, snake-like creature which you estimate to be five feet long, covered in slime and slithering about.  Occasionally, it will attach itself to the flesh around it and begins to suck.

Tall, partially armored, barely humanoid creature with a long appendage growing out of its side.  Flexible spearlike rods protrude throughout its body, seemingly holstered under the skin.  It feverishly darts and scouts the surroundings, looking to rip its victims apart.

special_attacks.description: huntsman's appendage hurls a sharp outgrowth out of its body!

data.description: A small fish symbiote that resembles a deformed, eyeless piranha.  It swims blindly in the yellow ichor, wriggling incessantly with malicious intent.

There is barely anything there, but you do notice hints of a faint, translucent veiled creature that you can only describe as butterfly-like.  While strangely alluring, it seems unsuited to the atmosphere and is slowly falling apart.
A small chunk of curious looking roots, constantly trying to grow and expand but failing miserably.  It has grown weak, as if incompatible with the very soil it is in.

Mostly covered in wet-looking, long strands that remind you firmly of hair, this abomination has a single but very pronounced leg.  It keeps its balance with its odd hair on the rear.  Yet it seems to shrivel and die with each gust of wind it is hit with.
This small, three legged bug-like creature curiously wriggles its 5 antennae.  Its body somewhat reminds you of a stink bug.  It looks like a fish out of water and is getting weaker by the minute.
A writhing mass of strange flesh and something that oddly resembles tentacles.  It is getting more pale by the minute.

Pink and translucent, with all of its otherworldly organs visible through its skin, this meter-high conical creature creeps along the seabed with its stubby, furry legs.  It retracts some sort of barbed filaments into an orifice at its rear as it aims at potential prey.

A multitude of thin, fluorescent purple strings violently writhe about the air.  Occasionally, individual strings lash out extremely far before retracting almost instantly.  The strings are so dense that they form a nearly solid, suffocating mass.

death_function.message: The %s shatters into innumerable, impossibly small fragments!

data.description: A mass of uncountable, gleaming halos, each large enough to encompass ten humans, all impossibly intermingled and rapidly rotating.  At its core is a dark flame, with the shadow of a twitching humanoid.

death_function.message: The %s implodes upon itself with a deafening crack!

data.//: A sightless, noseless horror that uses star-vampire attacks.  Very roughly based on 'real-life' melon heads.
data.description: This creature would look almost like a small human, except for its proportions.  Its emaciated body sits below a massive, bloated head.  In place of a face is a deep divot, almost like a satellite dish - surrounding it is a thin line of razor sharp, fang-like teeth.  When stopped, it stands eerily still.  When it moves, it takes several small measured steps at a time, rotating slowly to scan its surroundings, as if it were performing a practiced dance.

special_attacks.//: Bite for targets whose blood the star vampire does not want or cannot drink.  Should never target the player unless they can't bleed or have unappetizing blood.

data.description: As it moves, this cat's colors shift unnaturally in the light.  You can't make out the breed, but its fur pattern seems to change with every step.
data.//: Higher dodge due to the constantly changing fur pattern

data.description: It is universally known that cats are liquid, but this cat's body is actually quivering while it walks around.  It also enjoys resting while twisting its body in ways that would break a normal cat's bones.

death_function.message: The %s's body splashes one last time.

data.description: Seeing how unnaturally dark this black cat's fur is, you are certain this is no ordinary cat.  Its fur seems to absorb light from the surroundings.

This dog doesn't cast a shadow, and if you squint hard enough you can see right through it.  Its condition doesn't appear to do any harm to it, though it seems to cause trouble when it tries to groom itself.
A rather average looking dog until you notice the third eye, right on its forehead, covered by a thick eyelid.  Whenever its open, small particles of dust from the ground rise and swirl around it.

You are completely unable to recall anything about what this dog looks like.  You know it's a dog, you know it's there, you know you can see it, but any further information about it isn't retained in your mind.

data.//: Labyrinth monster naming convention: first number - amount of 'chaos' (How weird is this creature).  Second number - difficulty level.
data.description: Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  It moves wildly, but not like a zombie; more like a machine gone haywire.

Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  In place of hands it has two long, wired, hollow tubes, each with a tall box that looks like a firearm magazine.  It moves wildly, but not like a zombie; more like a machine gone haywire.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a bony dart at you!

data.description: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  In place of one hand is a wired airgun.  It moves with dire purpose, like a trained combat machine.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a bony dart at you!

data.description: At first glance, this looks like a turret made from scraps.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area.

At first glance, this looks like a turret set upon a buoy made from scraps.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area.  A metal gun has been clearly implanted into the flesh via, copper tubes, shielded wires, and fleshy sinew.

An immense tube, something between a fire hose and a cannon, set upon a rotating platform.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area, an orange laser following its movements.

An immense tube, something between a fire hose and a cannon, set upon a buoy of what appears to be scrap metal and plastic.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area, an orange laser following its movements.

This lanky, quadrupedal entity has a loosely humanoid torso, towering high over the ground on long bladed legs.  Its body is covered in what looks like fur made of rusting, metallic wire, and its face is a polished, hollow mask with holes where the mouth and eyes should be.

A flattened mockery of a cyborg, its form split into two overlapping, paper-thin silhouettes fused at their core.  Smooth metal plates ripple like ripped foil.  Its face is locked in an eternal scream, but it is unnaturally silent, as if it cannot throw its voice into this world.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a glowing dart at you!

special_attacks.monster_message: Standing close to the %s, your body is violently dragged down to the second dimension.  You're there for only an instant but the experience is enough to send you reeling.

data.description: A floating pylon boasting three high-powered searchlights.  Upon closer inspect, the buoy it floats upon appears to be breathing, and the searchlight itself is made of a twisted mass of copper and bone.

At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence, and it moves with a speed and fluidity that betrays its robotic core.

At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles, massively engorged and clearly weighing the creature down.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence.

A massive tangle of vines hanging from the ceiling, dripping with blood and acrid ichor.  A metal gun dangles from its vines, tangled in a mix of copper tubes, shielded wires, woody tendrils, and fleshy sinew.  The amalgamation of flesh and metal slowly rotates, scanning the area.

This lanky, quadrupedal entity has a loosely humanoid torso, towering high over the ground on lanky, thorn-covered tendrils.  Its body is a jumble of rusting, metallic wire and dripping, plant-like tubes.  Its face is nothing but a clump of hanging wires and dead vines, slowly inflating and deflating like foul, external lungs.
A resplendent alien fern, crowned with flowers colored deep indigo.  It appears to be the centerpiece of this otherworldly bloom.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech blossom!

data.description: A resplendent and voluminous alien fern.  A faint buzzing sound emanates from it, and the shadow cast by its canopy continuously glows with electric charge.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech stalk!

data.description: A trunk reaches tall into the sky, its topmost branches glowing with yellow light.  A low drum periodically shakes its vicinities.
The translucent egg pods of an alien plant, firmly attached by luminous rhizomes.  You can barely distinguish a root drone floating within a cloudy substance.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the pod cluster!

data.description: This clump of woody vegetation hastily clambers around in a lizard-like fashion.  Three translucent scale-leaves stand tall on the backside of the creature, and the thin ridges within them periodically glow through some unknown means.  It's seemingly a symbiote of the nearby alien ferns, and looks ready to defend them with its life.

special_attacks.description: Sparks fly from the root runner!

data.description: A small bulb with a beak-like protuberance, skittishly roaming about under three tendril rhizomes.  Dripping and glistening, it resembles a newborn animal rather than a sapling grown from seeds.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the root pod!

data.description: A cloth facsimile of a bird, flailing around in the air.  It seems deliberate with its movement.

description.str: This is an abstract monster for other snakes to copy from, so that we have some common foundation to work with.  If it appears in the game that's a bug.
This is an abstract monster for other snakelets to copy from, so that we have some common foundation to work with.  If it appears in the game that's a bug.
This is an abstract monster for other turtles to copy from, so that we have some common foundation to work with.  If it appears in the game that's a bug.
This is an abstract monster for other turtle hatchlings to copy from, so that we have some common foundation to work with.  If it appears in the game that's a bug.

data.description: A timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.
The most venomous viper native to New England.  Climatic changes have extended its range far into the north.
data.//babies: On average, a female rattlesnake gives birth to at least eight babies, up to around fifteen.  Most baby rattlesnakes are born in the early summer, but sometimes in late summer and early autumn.

data.description: A common species of snake found all across North America.
data.//: The numbers here can technically go up to 80 snakelets, with averages reaching 40, but lets be honest the game couldn't handle that.

data.description: A garter snake in its juvenile stage.
A small burrowing reptile that's just enjoying its time hunting earthworms.
data.//1: The reason its using the lizard faction is that it feeds on worms, so it can't use the snake factions that hunt other small animals.
data.//2: Actually no info on weight, I just kinda assumed 1g per 1cm of length since they're tiny.

data.description: A worm snake in its hatchling stage.  Not that much smaller than an adult, actually.
A dark-colored species of freshwater turtle with bright orange markings.
A painted turtle in its hatchling stage.
data.//: In northmost regions of the range we're looking at 6 years as an absolute minimum to reach adulthood.

data.description: A prehistoric-looking species of freshwater turtle with a nasty bite.
data.//: Similar to the garter snake, we're reaching 80 at maximum estimates, but that is a deeply unserious amount of baby turtles for the game to handle.

data.description: A common snapping turtle in its hatchling stage.
data.//: 12 years to reach maturity. It should probably be 15 years, because we're reaching the Northern range of the species in the setting, but odds are nobody is ever gonna see those grow to adulthood anyway.

data.description: A small species of skink.  The only native lizard of New England.
data.//: This is only a guesstimate. Other species of skinks with similar bodyplan reach ~40g of body mass at over double body length, so what we have is likely higher than in reality.

data.description: A five-lined skink in its hatchling stage.
data.//: Sexual maturity at 2-3 years, but there's no way in hell they don't reach adult size before that, so we take 10 months as a fairly safe guesstimate.

data.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.
A large mutated timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.

A large mutated timber rattlesnake, about six times as large as the norm.  While it still isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is much more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

A primal fear strikes when the club-like tail of this massively warped snake shifts, an assortment of bones rattling softly.  Multiple sets of hollow fangs have erupted in its maw, which itself is flanked by skinless ropes of powerful muscle.  Its scales constantly shed off and regrow with unnatural speed.
data.//grab: Big jaw full of long fangs - about as grabby as you can get without multiple appendages, consider a coiling attack on next update
data.//grab2: You brought this upon yourself, serpentdom is proud
data.//babies: Rattlesnake's gestation period is around 90 days, but it varies depending on the breed.  The timber rattlesnake has a gestation period of up to five months.
data.//babies2: Deathrattle is heavily mutated, so a short gestation period and all-year large clutch birth are plausible

data.description: An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from lack of sunlight.  It swarms beneath the ground, and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines.

description.str: The larval form of some species of frog.  This one is only hypothetical and you shouldn't be seeing it without debug.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

data.description: A speckled, gray-brown tadpole.  Its tail is broad and paddle-like, and its body rotund.  Sometime soon it will grow legs and lose its tail entirely.
Every part of this speckled, green-brown tadpole is thick and broad.  It must be from some larger species of frog.
The larval form of some species of frog.  Soon enough it will undergo metamorphosis into its adult form.  This dark, speckled one has a rather large, bulbous body compared to its thin, tapered tail.
The larval form of some species of frog.  Soon enough it will undergo metamorphosis into its adult form.  This dark, speckled one has a rather large, bulbous body compared to its thin, tapered tail.
A tiny larval frog.  Almost solid black, this one is barely a speck in the water around it.
This rather unique tadpole might be mistaken for a small fish.  It sports a very broad tail with bright red-orange coloration at its end, dotted with black spots.
A brown and tan speckled tadpole with a wide body and very broad, feather-shaped tail.
This yellowish tadpole is covered in flecks of brown and cream coloring.  Its eyes rest close together on a notably pointed face.
A corpulent green tadpole with a yellow underbelly and black speckles.
This mottled brown tadpole appears rather typical until you can get a glimpse from the side.  Then its high, peaked mouth and low round belly stand out in profile.
A squat and wide-bellied tadpole with wide-set eyes.
A tadpole the size of a bass.  It could win awards if it hadn't been debugged.
A giant, gray-brown tadpole.  Its body is covered in irregular, chaotic speckles of pitch black and chalk white.
data.//: When possible, add effect for rare flicker of very low luminance.

data.description: This giant, green tadpole would have been an oddity before the collapse.  Now it's simply part of the scenery.
This big tadpole has already grown some warty bumps on its softball-sized body.  Its nearly whip-thin tail appears to have no trouble propelling its much larger core.
Some kind of giant tadpole.  This speckled one has a body the size of a grapefruit and a thin, tapered tail.  It flits about the water in quick bursts.
A much larger than average tadpole.  Despite its unusual size, it is hard to make out any features from its dark, almost black, tint.
This tadpole's expanded size only accentuates its other unique feature.  Its tail fin is a vibrant gradient of crimson to yellow.
A hypothetical frog, if you're seeing this there's a problem.
Leopard frogs are named for the brown spots on their backs and legs.  Although limited by size, they too are voracious predators.

This large frog is covered in chaotic markings like a fractal river map over a background of TV static.  While most lose their gills during metamorphosis, this frog seems to have retained them, or something like them.
data.//: When possible, add effect for rare flicker of very low luminance.

data.description: The American bullfrog, in its natural habitat.  It feeds on insects, mice, lizards, and any other living thing it can stuff down its gullet.
Based on its vestigial tail, you would surmise that this bullfrog still has some growing to do.  That is if it weren't already larger than any adult frog.
Fowler's toads secrete a harmful and distasteful compound from their backs.  This helps safeguard them from predators and also gives them a distinctive odor like boiled peanuts.
You could almost smell it before you saw it.  This toad reeks.  You're not quite sure what like, but it's hot and musky and it sticks in your nose until you're tasting it.
data.//: NO_BREATHE flag is to prevent gassing by other 'foul' toads.  When possible, add effect for aoe morale debuff around toad. Possibly stack up until triggering nausea/vomiting.

data.description: American toads can vary greatly in appearance.  Individual toads will shift their coloration and patterning throughout the seasons to better camouflage.
Wide as a watermelon and halfway up to your knee, this toad's size is alarming.  So too are its odd proportions.  It's as if it hasn't fully grown.
This diminutive frog has a distinctive chirping call and bands of darker skin that come to form a rough 'X' shape on its back.

A small brown frog with a very big voice.  When it calls, its whole criss-crossed torso expands and trembles like an inflatable suit.  The loud squeaky sound it makes is more charming than troubling.  The frequency can be exhausting.
This treefrog can change its coloration much like a chameleon, shifting from a near-white gray, through greens and browns, to a dark, almost charcoal color.
You've seen it wrinkle its skin into bark and disappear on a tree; settle on a toadstool and take its spots.  It's no trick of the light, this frog's skin shifts not just color but texture.
This pungent frog is named for the mammal with which it shares both name and odor.  Its skin is light green underneath a heavy spatter of almost black mottling.
This very large, funky frog has an accentuated, paddle-like tail that accounts for half its body mass.  It is green with many brown spots scattering across its back.

The pickerel frog is identifiable by two rows of roughly square-shaped spots that run along its back, shaded a darker brown than the rest of their skin.  Though not more than an irritant to humans, their skin secretions are known for being fatal to most things their size.

You're quite sure that no frog this bright and garish could be native to New England.  Most of its skin is a light brown, but the large, squarish patches on its back and legs are of every different hue, all of them bright.

True to its name this frog is green.  Though this one is certainly of the Northern subspecies, they are common throughout, and native to, the Eastern half of North America.  The shades of green can vary greatly and there might be some brown on the limbs or mottled on the back.
This frog wears a pattern of tans and browns, with a darker eye mask and a light cream underbelly.  Its coverings make for great camouflage among the dry leaves and tree bark.

The eastern variety of the American spadefoot toad is a squat, round toad with vertical pupils.  Its body is colored a muddy mixture of browns, tans, and yellow-greens.  Their name comes from the keratinous projection on their hind legs that aids them in digging.

You see a whole leopard frog and then some.  This poor thing must have almost a dozen extra legs sticking off of it.  It is difficult to determine an exact number as most of them are underdeveloped or otherwise malformed.
A green frog that has suffered some kind of mutation.  At its hips it has clusters of extra legs, some are complete but others lack feet or end at the first joint.
This cream and brown frog looks more like a great insect in profile.  It has evidently mutated, growing many additional, spindly legs that rise high before attempting to bend back downwards.
An unreal frog of unusually large size.  This one is here by mistake; likely drawn by some kind of (de)bug.

data.description: A mutant bullfrog larger than most dogs.  It looks unwell, as if this growth spurt was less than comfortable.
This toad seems to have been mutated to absurd size by the Cataclysm.  It's only half your size but that hardly feels comforting.

Bioluminescent trails trace through the dark speckled patterns on this oversized frog's skin.  What would be cleanly defined spots on another frog, are instead fragmented collages of gray and black pigment over pale skin.  Its vestigial gills have grown into something else.  You can see them bulging the flesh under its mouth.

This lumpy oversized toad is a real stinker!  A miasma like rotted onions coated in rancid peanut butter surrounds it.  Even approaching it makes your eyes water and your throat tighten until you're coughing to catch breath.  It doesn't help that its leathery skin looks to be coated in a thick greasy substance, no doubt related to the creature's horrid odor.

data.description: On thick, over-proportioned legs, this large treefrog slings its weight with notable force.  It doesn't seem dangerous, but its size is still cause for concern.  Even scrunched up, it is as large as a Thanksgiving turkey.

dynamic_line.no: &The creature rolls slowly onto its back, staring up at you with stark, white eyes.  "Lay.  Sleep in the earth.  You can leave this place.  You will be safe."
dynamic_line.yes: &The creature doesn't pay you any attention.

dynamic_line: &The creature releases a slow, tired sigh.  "Like you, but not.  We can escape.  Please, we must sleep.  It is the only way."
&You lay beside the shade.  It is comfortable, but also unfamiliar.  You feel like you could stay here forever, though you might not be comfortable.
&You close your eyes.  Sleep takes you.  Then, there is light beyond your eyelids, and your mind's eye is flooded with red and gold afterimages.
&As you move to stand, the shade wipes a hand over your eyes.  Sleep takes you.  Then, there is light beyond your eyelids, and your mind's eye is flooded with red and gold afterimages.

&As you move to stand, you see the shade stir.  A buzzing sensation, neither sight nor sound, fills your senses, then passes.  Was it grabbing you?  Just reaching out to touch you?  You don't know, but you roll out of the way and stand up.

text:
Even out here you can still see the burning cities lighting up the horizon.  What scares you most is not the gunshots you sometimes hear in the far distance, but the idea of what people keep shooting at.  Tonight you hear automatic gunfire winding down into single shots.

Just what could make them shoot that much, all the way out here?

You suddenly realize this area seems almost devoid of life.  The few bits of blackened grass you can see are barely recognizable as grass, even discounting the night.  Sure the zombies might be tearing people apart, but what happened to the grass?  What, is the grass coming to life to eat people too?
You snort at the idea, but it doesn't feel safe out here.
You have a vague feeling of being watched.
Your ears perk up as something rustles, but it just turns out to be unnaturally withered and blackened vegetation you stepped on.  Wait, this can not have happened on its own.
The night feels longer than usual.
You suddenly yearn for a beautiful sunrise.
The wind faintly cries into the night.
The darkness makes you nervous.

The nights are mostly calm and lonely nowadays, but you could almost swear it's been getting darker since the Cataclysm.  Every once in a while you feel like the darkness is creeping up on you when you turn your back.
The wind sure is howling tonight.  It almost sounds like something is out there.  Out here.  With you.

In the distance you think you saw something …skitter?  Crawl?  It didn't move like anything you've seen before.  Whatever it was, it's probably a bad idea to let it surprise you in unfamiliar terrain in the darkness.
You gut tells you that something is right around the corner.
You narrowly avoid stepping into a black tangle of withered, blackened vegetation.  A trail of weird soot leads away from it.
The night feels like it is dragging on for eternity.
You suddenly long for a bright and beautiful morning, almost as in desperation.
Suddenly, there are some vague, but threatening shapes in the distance you do not recognize.
For a moment, the wind picks up and whistles an eerie song.
The darkness makes you anxious.

data.description: This zombie's skin has been preserved and appears almost living, but its drawn visage, corded muscles, and bulging eyes leave no mistake that it is undead.  Its ceremonial-looking metal armor hangs loosely about its body, stained black long ago by some now evaporated substance.

A mix of dead human and even deader technology, this twisted mess of steel and flesh moves like a puppet in the hands of an angry toddler.  Its robotic components seem to have shut down, and new bands of flesh have wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  Bits of metallic skeleton and armor plating jut from its flesh, which has turned black and hard from long-term exposure to cold.

Frostbitten human bodies, robots, and cybernetic enhancements fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs both biological and robotic sticking out of its bloated body at grotesque angles.  The nature of the thing makes it difficult to estimate how close it is to dying.

A dead, staggering creature, more cyborg than human.  Robotic components cover most of its body, with only a few bands of black flesh, frostbitten by long exposure to cold, wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  It staggers about, its awkward limbs clanking against armored torso.
A short, fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.
A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground, with heavy, broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.
A drooped, quivering plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are closed, and pulsate ominously.

data.description: A thick stalk, rooted to the ground.  It rapidly sprouts thorny vines in all directions.
A thorny vine, twisting wildly as it grows with incredible speed.
A teeny-tiny triffid that has recently germinated.  Like a house cat, you know it wants to eat you but it just can't figure out how.
A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.
A creeping mobile plant, as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.  Nature is healing.
A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.
An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.
A stout, woody plant that can dig through the ground and flick spines from its branches.  The thorns carry a fungicidal compound with paralytic effects.

data.description: A giant plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are open with an ominous shine in the center.
A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.

A 9mm MP5 attached to a motorized chassis with basic autonomous software control.  There is no mechanism to reload the weapon when its magazine is empty, and the fire control system is only designed for semi-automatic fire.
A pylon boasting three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI, continually seeking targets.
A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a .50 caliber M2HB machine gun.
A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 5.56 caliber M249 machine gun.
A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 7.62 caliber M240 machine gun.

These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the Cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner-city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' does not mean 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the Cataclysm, massive stockrooms of these things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not mobile anymore.

According to the ads, it uses a state-machine of a complexity never seen before.  Uncanny even hired professional actors to record its lines.  Examine to befriend.
A busted grocery bot, it can still carry your bag but its arms are too damaged to push a grocery cart.  Despite its current state, it's still smiling at you.  Examine to befriend.

data.description: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its legs are smooth faceted figures, with no visible joints, and hold its gem-like body aloft with an eery, sculpted grace.  At the peak of the gem-body is a deep, goblet-shaped crown that slowly swivels about, pointing at nothing in specific.  Though nothing about its appearance is familiar to you, it nevertheless strikes you with a mixture of awe and dread.
data.//: A lot of gold in this bad boy.

data.description: This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  This walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.
A huge swollen zombie dog, smeared black with slime.  Its teeth have grown longer, and its broad back ripples with muscles and oozing wounds.

data.//: Cuspated just means angled, sharp, pointy. Other ways of translating the feel of the name may be something akin to 'scythe dog', or 'beaked beast'.
data.description: This dog's snout and jaw have seemingly fused together, the skin and flesh ranging from completely gone to barely hanging on.  The boney mass as a whole has an incredibly sharp yet jagged point.  It stumbles around, barely keeping its hefty 'beak' from hitting the ground.
data.//2: Can't bite because it doesn't exactly have a mouth anymore. Instead, it's effectively a one-hit, one-trick wonder. It tries to drive its extremely sharp beak into you. If it succeeds, you're thoroughly damaged. If it fails, it's screwed.
data.//3: Minor amounts of protection due to the boney jaw.

data.description: The underbelly of this undead canine expands and contracts arrhythmically, almost like it's breathing.  Despite that, it is clearly in an advanced state of decomposition.  Its snout and throat appear far too large for its species, and the remains of its eyes appear much more analytical than its brethren.
A charred and damaged corpse of a canid, covered in fused patches of burnt hide and flesh.
What may once have been a dog is now a grotesquely swollen monstrosity, standing on four limbs as wide as trash cans and showing massive, jagged teeth.
A charred and damaged corpse of what you can only assume was once a horribly mutated dog.  Covering its entire body is a layer of fused and melted hide, giving it an armored appearance.
A four-legged creature covered in fused bony plates, shaped somewhat like a dog or wolf.  Joints and cracks across its body ooze with black goo.

This undead boar appears to have been a truly massive specimen in life.  Stretching eight to nine feet in length, the most arresting feature of this animal is that the enamel of its tusks has spread across its face, leaving a skull-like appearance with deep-set eye holes.
Billowing clouds of yellowish gas precede a boar-shaped shadow.  Glimpses of a zombified boar are quickly obscured by the gases spewing forth from the open wounds on its body.
This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.
This undead cougar's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its fur is torn, revealing deep, festering wounds.  Its claws and teeth are unnaturally long, and sharpened into dangerous looking spikes.

As if a zombified bear wasn't already a problem, this one is layered in thick bone growths that protect it from harm.  The irregular way the plates grow against each other has somewhat stifled its movement, but not enough to stop it from easily gaining up on you.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is the outline of a large, shambling cat.
Most of this bear's fur has burnt off and its body looks to be falling apart, not entirely immune to its own acidic fluids.  Despite its weakened state, the strength of a bear hasn't left it.

The abdomen of this once majestic horse has grown rotund to the point you can see through the skin, at the reservoir of caustic bile inside.  Its neck is equally enlarged as well as slightly longer than normal.

A zombified horse without skin, its overgrown, bloody musculature clear for all to see.  Some muscles occasionally tear from their tendons as it barrels towards its target, flailing around like a loose hose before weaving back into place.

This undead horse has a charred hide as black as soot, the underside of which is littered with gashes and holes.  Pillars of choking black smoke pour from the wounds, smothering everything that draws near.

With plates of asymmetrical bone tissue overlapping its body, this ignoble steed needs no rider for you to fear its approach.  Completing its ghoulish look is an overgrown skull which, judging by the flattened and battered forehead, has become its main weapon.
This once-great moose's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.
data.//grab: Assuming it's grabbing with its mouth a bit grabbier than a zed should be about right

data.description: This once-great moose is covered with long, matted hair twisted with thorny vines that wrap together and then twist back into its body.  Long, interlocking thorns wrap its antlers, dripping with a silvery liquid.
data.//grab: Let's say the thorns make it half again as grabby

data.description: Once a normally-aggressive, normally-hungry bull shark, this undead terror is now even more aggressive and more hungry, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.
Once a former apex predator of the seas, now an undead nightmare, this zombified Great White shark terrorizes the waters with its relentless hunger and aggression.
The deformed, animated corpse of a canine; a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.
data.//grab: Pretty low, but they tend not to be alone

data.description: A zombified version of one of the German Shepherd dogs used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.
An acrid smell accompanies this animated canine corpse.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.
A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating its vicious-looking white fangs.
This black bear's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.
A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.
data.//: 1d8->2d5, minor bonus over 1d9

data.description: This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, its gore-stained ribs clearly visible.  Its most prominent features are the fearsome incisors dribbling thick, black goo from inside its mouth.  It doesn't look interested in chewing on trees anymore.

This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection that is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast, suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.
A normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.

From the deteriorated state of this undead horse's ghastly features--protruding ribs, off-white skull, and decayed, tattered muscles--it doesn't seem like it should put up much of a fight, but something deep inside gives it power.  Black, reeking ichor drips from its wounds.
This tiger stumbles and sways, its jaws slack, its eyes wide open and shining black.

This sheep's once pure white wool is now barely hanging by its rotten flesh, held together by dried mud and blood.  Its legs now buckle as the rotten muscles have a hard time sustaining the rest of the body.
The moving corpse of what once was a goat is now left stumbling around, with pitch black empty eyes, looking for anything alive to kill.

Once a placid cow, this leathery horror stumbles and shudders, its pulsing black eyes scanning for prey.  Dairy cows have no natural weapons, but a zombie as big, heavy, and murderous as this is still extremely dangerous.

death_drops.//: 25% chance of an item from group cow

data.description: This enormous, terrifyingly fast creature with oily black eyes and dreadful horns was once a domestic bull.  While live bulls can be temperamental, unbridled rage is now this one's only emotion.

This llama oozes a dark oil from a multitude of lesions and cuts.  Its wool has sloughed off with parts of its skin, revealing pulsating muscles and flesh.  Its mouth drips with a sickly green substance which it seems to be chewing on.

special_attacks.description: The vicious vicuña spits a glob of acid!

data.description: A pale, stumbling, white-tailed deer, rivulets of slime running down its neck.  Its limbs twist and bend in unnatural, haphazard directions, and yet it moves with uncanny strength and speed.  Thanks to the Cataclysm, it has now turned the tables; what was once prey, now itself preys on coyotes, wolves, and giant spider mutants.
Once a majestic caribou, this undead creature barely resembles Santa's helpful reindeer and seems to only be interested in human flesh.
A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.
A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.
A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of police gear.
This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.
Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.
A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.  Its protective mask prevents it from attempting to bite you.
data.//grab: Slightly stronger, but can't bite because of the gear.

data.description: This zombie is completely encased in a protective suit that apparently failed to protect it from whatever this infection is.  At least it can't bite you from inside that suit.

weakpoints.name: a tear in its hazmat suit

data.description: A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored, swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.

This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front.  The protective mask makes its head a difficult target, but also prevents it from biting you.
This was once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.
This zombie is rather sleek and scantily clothed.
This muscular zombie is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.
This shambling corpse is dressed like a medical professional.  It was either a doctor, or only played one on TV.
A former doctor of some sort, though its uniform has been torn apart.  You assume the oversized muscles that cover it to be the culprit.

The zombified remains of a practitioner of medicine, you aren't certain what field - your focus is instead drawn to the way that its pink flesh snakes all over it, weaving its way over wounds and injuries.
A malformed armor of misshapen bone has grown over this zombie, having pushed what remains of the skin out of the way.  The clothes of a medical worker are still draped over it.
This is the body of a doctor or nurse of some kind.  It's hard to tell now that most of its clothing has corroded away from whatever vile acid its secreting.
This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This muscular human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: The bloated torso of this gigantic corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s opens its mouth, and a gore-smeared winged beast flies out of it!

data.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and shadowy winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: it moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies, but can occasionally leap a significant distance.
data.//: In the future, it would be nice if these guys could be resistant to fall damage.

data.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, with thin, rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.
data.//: Slow at actual movement, made up for by its rapid leaps.  This should work to simulate its clumsy form.  When charge attacks are possible it should get one, and that will be its main damaging ability.

data.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it is made of human parts.
An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged, pointed object.

This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, and a bloated, fleshy belly hangs beneath.  A sharp smell of rotten eggs hangs around it.

This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow juts out from the point where the wings meet.
A sickly-looking zombie.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

This zombie has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated, leathery body.  It moves clumsily, but spits from a large reserve of acid with uncanny accuracy.
data.//grab: Basic zed grab strength but icky icky acid on the hands

special_attacks.description: The corrosive zombie spits a glob of acid!

data.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.
A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Various pieces of trash and waste materials have melded into the black goo leaking from its skin.
data.//: Higher weight from attached junks.

data.description: A deformed, sickly-looking animated corpse of a canine.  A dangerous-looking yellow saliva drips from its mouth.
A huge canine with multiple large, foul-looking blisters covering its body.  A corrosive liquid spills from its menacing-looking mouth.

data.//: 10 - 35 kg corpse
data.description: A small, wet sack of pink skin, with something dog-sized moving around underneath the surface.  Black roots anchor it to the ground.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

data.//: 36-100 kg corpse
data.description: A sack of pink flesh sitting in the middle of a net of black roots.  At irregular intervals it shudders as something (or multiple somethings?) inside changes position.  You're not sure you want to know what's inside.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

data.//flags: No REVIVE until monsters get smart enough to pulp/eat zombies

data.//: 101-300 kg corpse
data.description: A mass of pink flesh the size of a fridge squirming constantly, black veins anchoring it to the ground.  Occasionally a malformed limb pushes against the skin from the inside, before a churn of the cocoon pushes it back.  Not ready yet, it seems.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

data.description: A rigid, off-white lump of flesh the size of a small car constricted by bands of rope-sized pulsing black veins that tie it to the floor below.  The whole thing is shuddering constantly, and gives off an otherworldly stench.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

data.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.
A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.

data.//: TODO: When effects/spells can mess with path settings + flags move smartness to the effect of dedicated coordinatiors
Small, nasty glass cannon spawning in groups.  WP: mandible, leg
data.description: A small, flat creature dashing around erratically on seven short legs.  Its form is dominated by an oversized set of black mandibles on an almost comically small head, featureless apart from a single black eye.  The rest of the body is covered with sickly white skin crisscrossed by black veins.
An inflated white body carried by five dainty legs, waving its remaining two limbs constantly.  Each one is tipped by a head-sized compound eye, independently scanning the horizon for prey.

special_attacks.monster_message: The amalgamation screams!

data.description: A gangly creature running on six legs, its form made irregular by the green pustules at the limbs' base, each feeding into a large vein leading to two blackened claws.  What must have been a seventh leg fused with the creature's head forming a jagged proboscis emerging from below its eyes, dripping a caustic liquid.

A four-legged white creature about the size of a human, running with a decidedly feline gait, the three remaining limbs holding an almost-translucent skin membrane outstretched on its side and rear.  Much of its head is taken up by a beak like a raven's, which opens to reveal a set of jagged black teeth.

A short, crablike creature waddling around on six multi-jointed legs, its body dominated by a large glowing organ bulging from between the white armor plates.  A single raised appendage connects to the mass, its tip surrounded by brilliant white sparks.

special_attacks.monster_message: A cloud of electricity explodes from the %s
A bolt of electricity arcs from %s!

data.description: A large, thickly armored creature built not unlike a bear, if a bear had a long, clubbed tail and two short limbs ending in black talons framing a vertical mouth on an otherwise smooth, featureless head.  On second thought, not that much like a bear at all.

description.str: A hypothetical frog of the zombie variety.  You should not be seeing it without debug.

Its three appendages, resembling long tentacles or pseudopods, propel it across the ground at maddening speed.  It has no outward sensory organs or a mouth, and steam rises from its skin as if it is burning away its own lifeforce to catch you.

The wound covered skin of this large bullfrog appears to be peeling in places, revealing a black goop beneath the surface.  Its vacant stare passes by anything that isn't food, and it will leap to devour anything it can.

This gigantic zombified frog lets out an ear splitting unholy wail as it slowly takes notice of you.  Its mostly lethargic movements are offset by its ability to leap great distances using its gargantuan stout legs.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

data.description: The ambulatory, desiccated corpse of an enormous amphibian.  What papery skin remains hugs tightly to the bones and shrunken flesh beneath.  Each stuttering leap it makes leaves it looking worse off as it sheds clouds of ash and soot.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

data.description: Even without the haze of smoke that constantly fumes off of it, it would be difficult to tell what this once was.  The massive thing seems to have dried out and shriveled up, though unevenly.  Rind through core it has warped.  Its whole dry body crinkles and folds as it moves.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

data.description: A massive toad stumbling around while leaking acid from its skin.  Doesn't look friendly at all.

A diminutive humanoid figure, its body ravaged by fire into a blackened, charred shell.  Its leathery flesh has mended in patches, and the tattered clothing is still clinging to its emaciated frame making it clear it once was - and still is - the body of a child.
An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.
A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.
A heavily burned corpse with unnaturally long arms dragging behind it as it moves.  The burnt scar tissue covering it gives it a mildly armored appearance.

A monstrous burnt vaguely humanoid creature, walking around on its knuckles like a gorilla.  Tattered and blackened strands of muscle fibers dangle all around its body, with patches of fused melded skin and bone visible between.  Its forelimbs end in lengthy skeletal claws.

A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.

An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.
It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

data.description: This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.
data.//: no GUILT_CHILD because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.
What was once a child is now a mutant beast with blackened skin and massive eyes.  This abomination's vile form makes a mockery of its human origin.
data.//: no GUILT_CHILD because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful-looking spasms as it runs about.
This swollen, gooey-looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.
This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge black eyes, and its fingertips end in sharp claws.
data.//: no GUILT_CHILD because it no longer looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.
data.//: GUILT_CHILD because it still looks enough like a child to evoke pity

data.description: Lethargically resting on its back, this hideous mass of sagging flesh and writhing organs, which used to be a child, twitches feebly as its midsection churns.  Almost bursting from its skin, the child's ribcage has arched outward, forming a hive-like construct covered by severely stretched epidermis.  Through the wretched organism's taut abdominal flesh, you witness small forms swarming within its ribcage—its guts roiling as new beings are sculpted from pilfered flesh and bone.  The creature's limbs rest haphazardly on the ground, contorted in ways that suggest the absence of bones or any interior construct.

special_attacks.monster_message: Ripping and tearing, a small beast burrows free of the wretch's abdomen!

data.description: A strange zombie covered in bone plates from face to toe.  Despite the added weight on its body, its movements are coordinated, almost as if capable of analyzing your movements.

A twisted visage of the human body decked in bone from head to toe.  Its vague shape is reminiscent of some tabletop monster, and it walks and watches your actions with a cold and calculating demeanor.

description.str: You should not see this.  Kills pseudo zombie to turn it into a corpse for revival.
You should not see this.  Sets up trap for dormant zombies.
Fake zombie used for spawning dormant zombies.  If you see this, open an issue on GitHub.

data.//: This zombie 'corpse' looks eerily like it could get up and start walking at any moment.

data.trigger_message_npc: A zombie rises from the ground!

description.str: You should not see this.  Causes loud noise.

description.str: You should not see this.  Causes all dormant corpses in the tile to revive.

data.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from the lightning bolts that arc out of its body.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.
A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

This zombie is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.
data.//: slow walk speed - intimidating!
data.//2: melee damage is quite weak since the shockfield around it is its most dangerous function

data.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sparks of electricity frequently jump off it, lighting it up in the dark.  You might not want to touch it with your bare hands, or anything conductive.
A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid pink sludge dribbles from its mouth.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

data.description: This boomer, normally swollen and ready to burst, has strengthened and solidified.  The bile dribbling from its mouth also appears to have changed…

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

data.description: With its gray skin swollen to near-rupture with putrid gas, this cyst-covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.
A zombie swollen with a bluish, oddly sweet smelling gas.  It stumbles around even more than regular zombies, as if heavily intoxicated.
A bloated corpse, its ballooning skin blistered and rashy and its face caked in mucus.  The off-color orange gas that occasionally leaks from it makes your eyes water and smells faintly of pepper.

data.name: boomer glutton
data.description: A large, grotesque ball of flesh and fat.  Seemingly vestigial limbs flop around haphazardly as it rolls across the ground.  You occasionally catch a glimpse of bulging eyes and a distended gaping maw oozing some sort of black sludge.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

special_attacks.monster_message: The glutton vomits sludge!

data.name: bombardier boomer
data.description: This zombie's exposed ribcage is encircled by swollen lungs and other organs.  You would prefer to be far away when they burst.

special_attacks.monster_message: A bombardier boomer explodes!

data.description: A zombie impaled with a multitude of metal fragments, each covered with a thick layer of rust that seems to propagate to other parts of its body.  You can't remember the last time you got a tetanus shot, so it would be best not to let this thing touch you.
Jagged fragments of rust-bitten metal have fused into this zombie's flesh and displaced parts of its spine.
Ruptures in this zombie's skin expose fragments of metal arranged like armor underneath.  Black sludge can be seen in places where the rust has receded.
A spiked horror of a zombie covered in long, rusty spikes.  A walking tetanus infection waiting to happen.
This brute of a zombie is covered in rusted metal detritus.  Chunks of metal smashed through its arms have deformed them into hammers.
A conglomeration of human parts fused together in a horrible mishmash of function, slowly dragging its eldritch body across the ground.

Human bodies fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body.  The nature of the thing makes it difficult to estimate how close it is to dying, and its capabilities might change if it manages to assimilate more zombies into itself.
data.//grab: All these arms to grab you with

data.description: A tangle of security personnel fused with their gear and with each other, warped limbs and flesh-covered equipment moving in strange unison.  Every so often you glimpse a pitch-black figure at its center, limbs mirroring the movements of the larger mass.
data.//: 483 L and HARDTOSHOOT to prevent a frag autokilling them, adjust when grenades are a bit less deadly to large things.

special_attacks.monster_message: A handful of flesh wriggles loose from the mass and takes flight!

death_function.message: The creature grows sluggish before freezing in place for a moment.  Suddenly its flesh turns black and recedes to coat the central figure, which reaches out towards you before collapsing into a pinprick of shimmering air.  Torn uniforms and other gear tumble to the ground.

data.description: Zombified human bodies fused together into a colossus, with a multitude of heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body ready to break free.  Dozens of arms grab at anything nearby and pull it apart once within the grip of multiple hands.
data.//grab: All these arms to grab you with

data.description: This devourer type zombie is made from a mass of human and animal parts assembled by a katamari god or other thoughtless creator being.  When paused it seems as though small versions of this gigantic monstrous abomination strain to birth themselves from its bulk, while other limbs push the straining masses back inside.  Every so often you see one climb free and take a few steps away from the creature before getting snatched back inside.
