data.name: Vagabond
data.description: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.

data.//: This profession is meant to convey an average person who has not prepared for the Cataclysm at all. Starting out unprepared is fully intentional, and this scenario is not meant to aid new players.
data.name: Survivor
data.description: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

data.name: Obsolete Academic
data.description: Be it algebraic structures or the social lives of finches, you devoted your life to lecturing others on something that won't keep you warm, intact, or fed in the coming days.

data.name: Video Blogger
data.description: You made a career out of creating and commentating video content and posting it on various platforms.  Now most of your fans are dead, alongside your equipment.  Maybe you didn't cultivate the most practical skillset through your career, but you have learned a thing or two about troubleshooting software and getting people to listen to you.

data.name: Sheltered Survivor
data.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  You've spent the past months eating canned food, reading books, and tinkering.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

data.name: Sheltered Militia
data.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

data.name: Tailor
data.description: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.
data.//: Tailoring book and kit make an already decent class for careful folks much more powerful.

data.name: Chef
data.description: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.

data.name: Butcher
data.description: You spent most of your adult life in a butcher shop.  Your trusty knife has seen many different creatures and you know how to butcher them.

data.name: Churl
data.description: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.

data.name: Lab Technician
data.description: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?

data.name: Chemical Engineer
data.description: You know your way around the periodic table and can name ten different industrial processes that involve any given chemical, but that did not prevent the prospect of employment from looking bleak for you.  Fortunately, the Cataclysm might just be the thing to save you from a dead end job.

data.name: Home Mechanic
data.description: You've always loved cars, and there's nothing like getting under the hood and fixing it yourself.  You've kept ahold of some handy tools for the job, and at least now you'll never want for parts.

data.name: Mechanical Engineer
data.description: You've always loved machines, and have extensively incorporated them into your career.  Not long after receiving your degree, you seem to be the one being subjected to a stress test, and it remains unclear if you will retain your structural integrity.

data.name: Scoundrel
data.description: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold out?

data.name: Beekeeper
data.description: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.

data.name: Baseball Player
data.description: You played with the local team.  You're the only one left, but now you can use your trusty bat for another purpose.  Home run!

data.name: Basketball Player
data.description: Your first major game was abruptly canceled when zombies stormed the court.  Quick feet and good reflexes meant you were among the lucky few to escape the stadium alive.

data.name: Football Player
data.description: Your epic touchdown was ruined when your coach's guts were torn out by undead fans.  Now you're first pick in the apocalypse draft.

data.name: True Foodperson
data.description: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

data.name: Professional Cyclist
data.description: You were a promising cyclist with a bright career in front of you before this all happened.  Perhaps you'll never get to participate in the grand tours now, but as the saying goes, life is like riding a bicycle: you've got to keep moving.

data.name: Major General
data.description: You worked your way up through the ranks from a no-name private to a big shot major general, respected and decorated.  On the downside, years of desk duty have left your shooting skills rusty, and all the medals in the world won't protect you now.

You are one of the few and the proud: a member of the US Marine Corps.  Now that military command has collapsed in on itself as far as you can tell, you suppose that it falls to you to carry the memory of the Corps forward into the future.  Semper fi.

data.name: Navy Sailor
data.description: You're a sailor of the US Navy, and spent the last few years working shipside aboard an aircraft carrier.  Though you're trained in combat, maintenance of the vessel has been your primary duty.  After some event beyond your understanding, the carrier has become a floating graveyard in the middle of nowhere.  This is going to take more than a cup of coffee and a monkey wrench to fix.

data.name: Navy Diver
data.description: You were a member of a Naval Special Warfare diving group, a skilled soldier adept at underwater infiltration and marine combat.  You were suiting up for a practice dive when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on was somehow flung from the Yellow Sea to who knows where.  You seem to be the only one who survived with your sanity intact, but it's not safe to stay here.  At least you're already dressed to abandon ship.

data.name: Military Veteran
data.description: After being discharged from the armed forces, you were sent to a veterans' hospital for treatment.  Just when you thought you'd overcome your traumas and readjusted to civilian life, the world has come to an end and your worst nightmare has become a reality: life in an endless battlefield.

data.name: Military Recruit
data.description: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.

data.name: Combat Mechanic
data.description: Early in your military career, you were hand-picked for extra training in the mechanic's trade, keeping the armor running.  It's been years since you last touched a rifle, and the dead men are marching again…

data.name: Combat Engineer
data.description: Your job was simple: Keep the army moving.  You built bridges, you built roads, you destroyed fortifications, and you cleared mines.  It has been years since you last handled a rifle in basic training; now might be the time to dust off those skills.

data.name: Non-Commissioned Officer
data.description: You're a veteran of several peacekeeping missions.  You led your squad as a sort of parental figure, and they relied on you to give orders and keep them alive.  You failed them.  And now you're alone.

data.name: Rifleman
data.description: When you were young, you dreamed of being a soldier.  War is hell and hell is war, but you never thought it would be this bad.

data.name: Navy SEAL Marksman
data.description: Recruited into the ranks of the US Navy's Special Warfare forces as a designated sniper, your training in precision marksmanship and maritime operations was extensive.  As a proficient soldier and combative in all respects, you provided overwatch and long-range elimination services in the line of duty.  Now, with naval command imploding and your spotter MIA, your skills with a rifle and covert operations are the only things standing between you and the Cataclysm.

data.name: Navy SEAL
data.description: You were a member of the SEALs; a key component of the US Navy's special forces and a proficient combatant in both maritime and ground operations.  'The only easy day was yesterday', and with the chain of command in ruins, you may fulfill your final mission in any way you see fit.

data.name: Special Operator
data.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.

You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this strange place… are you even on Earth anymore?

You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.

data.name: Medical Resident
data.description: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.

data.name: Doctor
data.description: You were a patient-facing doctor practicing general or specialized medicine.  While your bedside manner might not get you far in this new world, your medical skills will certainly help.

data.name: Pharmacist
data.description: You were a pharmacist working in a community pharmacy.  No simple pill-pusher, you have a plethora of knowledge of drug preparation, biochemistry, and biology.  With your trusty mortar and pestle, you hope to grind the undead to a pulp.

data.name: Gangster
data.description: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.

data.name: Security Guard
data.description: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.

data.name: Landscaper
data.description: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.

data.name: Nursing Assistant
data.//: They don't have the doctor's passive bonus to surgery.  Nursing assistants aren't required to hold a doctorate.
data.description: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…

data.name: Survivalist
data.description: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!

data.name: Hobo
data.description: Society drove you to the fringes and left you with no home, no family, no friends.  But for all the crap thrown your way, you're still breathing.  For now.

data.name: Helicopter Pilot
data.description: You got your pilot's license and earned a living ferrying businessmen and tourists around.  The Cataclysm has grounded you for now, but the sky still calls to you…

data.name: Airship Captain
data.description: You once led a crew of skyfarers, traveling the skies for fame, bricks and sand.  Now you are on your own, and the ground is swarming with zombies.  At least this world has ground…

data.name: Airboat Commander
data.description: You were part of a squadron of skyfarers, plying the vastness to protect trade routes from nefarious air pirates.  Now you're adrift and alone, one vessel against an alien world swarming with the undead…

data.name: Aircanoe Pilot
data.description: You're a lone skyfarer, scouting the endless blue for new routes across the sky.  Now you've caught sight of more land than you've seen in a lifetime, an unfamiliar land of monsters…

data.name: K9 Officer
data.description: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.

data.name: Mounted Police Officer
data.description: You have spent many long years forging a bond with your equine companion, from running down common thugs, to entertaining kids when you ride on by.  The Cataclysm is upon you, but at least you have each other.

data.name: Dog Lover
data.description: You spent your days running around with your faithful dogs by your side.  When the world ended, you grabbed your companions along with some of their things to protect them.  The zombies could be nearby, but at least your canine friends won't have to worry about the rain.
Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!

data.name: Police Officer
data.description: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?

data.name: Police Detective
data.description: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.

data.name: SWAT Officer
data.description: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

data.name: SWAT CQC Specialist
data.description: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

data.name: Police Sniper
data.description: Your skill as a sharpshooter served you well in the line of duty, protecting the innocent with a single, well-placed bullet.  Now your own life is on the line, and you can't afford to miss if you don't want to end up as something's dinner.

data.name: Riot Control Officer
data.description: The riots were brutal, even before the dead rose and started to devour the living.  The line you were holding broke.  It was only through a bit of luck and a lot of head-bashing that you got away in one piece, and the worst is yet to come.

data.name: Motorized Police Officer
data.description: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to ride to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you had to abandon your motorcycle to escape.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents doesn't exist anymore?
They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!

data.name: Modern Archer
data.description: A great fan of the archers of old, but at the same time a follower of the latest trends in archery.  You always tried to keep up with the times, acquiring a takedown bow as well as several accessories to complement it.  You can only hope all the training you did with them can help you survive in this trying times.

data.name: Bow Hunter
data.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

data.name: Crossbow Hunter
data.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and crossbow hunting was always your favorite.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty crossbow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along, though most of your bolts were lost during the escape.

data.name: Shotgun Hunter
data.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

data.name: Rifle Hunter
data.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

data.name: Big-Bore Hunter
data.description: You always harbored a passion for hunting and a particular fondness for big-bore rifle calibers and affordable conversion kits.  Whether it was their cost-effective nature or the simple, testosterone-amplifying notion that you could retool your rifle to belt out .50-caliber bullets, you preferred them for your hunting trips.  Now, with your converted rifle in hand, you fancy that there isn't any game too large for you to take down.
You n' yer kin always figured shit would hit the fan some day, but never like this!  When they turned on you, you grabbed yer gun and a six pack, and hauled ass in the family truck.

You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?

data.name: Trucker
data.description: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.

data.name: Rideshare Driver
data.description: You love driving, and decided to start making some money doing it.  On your way to pick up a customer, a riot broke out around you.  You took a long detour to safety, only to find yourself somewhere unfamiliar.

data.name: Paramedic Firefighter
data.description: On your way to respond to an emergency call, you nearly drove straight into a riot in the city.  Turning off of the burning, debris-covered streets, you took a long detour only to find yourself lost.  That call will have to wait - you're in an emergency of your own now.

Employed by a large company, you performed installation and troubleshooting services at the homes of ungrateful luddites.  Driving back from your last call, you were suddenly swarmed by what you believed to be angry rioters.  You veered off onto an old, neglected side road to escape, only to find yourself lost and low on gas.

data.name: Bus Driver
data.description: You made a living driving kids to and from school, a career choice you regretted almost every day.  None of the brats were at their normal stops, and the noise of your bus quickly attracted hordes of zombies.  You escaped, but now you've gotten lost.  At least you're getting a break from the hellish screams of children, though you're starting to hear new ones…

data.name: Police Interceptor
data.description: An on-duty officer, you received the call and were ready to respond to the robbery.  It all went to shit, your backup got eaten, and you were lucky to escape with your life and patrol car.

data.name: Militia
data.description: You and a group of like-minded individuals built a hideout in the woods from which to launch looting raids in a jury-rigged pickup.  The last run went bad, and now all your comrades are dead.  Every breath you take now is an act of rebellion against the cruelty of this doomed world.  Do not let that flame of hope perish inside you.

data.name: Park Ranger
data.description: Your days of patrolling the park and protecting people and wildlife from each other have taught you many useful skills.  After finding a gruesome scene at a campsite and getting no response when you radioed for help, you stockpiled as many supplies as possible and set out in your pickup looking for answers.
You have your trusty wood axe, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, and you suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.

data.name: Fast Food Cook
data.description: The diners at the fancy burger joint where you worked were even more irritable and unreasonable than usual today.  You showed them the meaning of fast food… by running for your life!

data.name: Electrician
data.description: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.

data.name: Electrical Engineer
data.description: Fresh out of college, you were quite eager to get some practical engineering experience and leave your mark on the world, one solder joint at a time.  Now, you are not even sure if the complete failure of the power grid makes your field obsolete or all the more necessary.

data.name: Computer Hacker
data.description: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen made you an expert at writing and cracking code.  The power's gone out, and suddenly your elite skills seem significantly less useful.  At least there's no one stopping you from your dream of breaking into a military mainframe now.

data.name: Backpacker
data.description: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.

data.name: Student
data.description: Just an average student, you find yourself facing a test you never studied for, and the stakes are a bit higher than geometry.  Maybe there'll be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.

data.name: Shower Victim
data.description: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.

data.name: Biker
data.description: You spent most of your life on a motorcycle, out on the open road with your club.  Now they're all dead.  Time to ride or die.

data.name: Ballroom Dancer
data.description: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.

data.name: Patient
data.description: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.

data.name: Unwilling Mutant
data.description: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.

data.name: Volunteer Mutant
data.description: Your dreams of becoming a mutant superhero through genetic alteration may have fallen a bit short, but the scientists say you're ready.  It's time for a field test.

data.name: Hitchhiker
data.description: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.

data.name: Trapper
data.description: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.

data.name: Blacksmith
data.description: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.

data.name: Jeweler
data.description: You were an independent artisan, who made gorgeous rings and pendants for the people who afforded your services.  You doubt the market for your work has fared well after the end of the world, but perhaps your proficiency with fine tools and metals will come in handy somehow.

All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.

data.name: Lost Submissive
data.description: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.

data.name: Senior Citizen
data.description: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.

data.name: Otaku
data.description: After many late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks, you decided to make the trip to the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  Now zombies are eating everyone, and even worse, the convention is canceled!  At least you were ready in case your costume tore.
The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!
All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!

data.name: Firefighter
data.description: As a first responder, you were a direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  Separated from most of your equipment and your unit while on call, you were forced to fight your way to safety with little more than your trusty iron and your bunker gear to protect you.
Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.

data.name: Mail Carrier
data.description: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays you from the swift completion of your appointed rounds, but nobody said anything about zombies.

data.name: Convict
data.description: Your trial was contentious, but ultimately you found yourself behind bars.  The Cataclysm has offered you a chance to escape, but freedom may come with a steep price.

data.name: Hardened Convict
data.description: Most of your adult life has been spent in prison doing hard time.  It's been rough but you've learned a few tricks to keep them on their toes.  Time to see how tough these zombies are.

data.name: Death Row Convict
data.description: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.

data.name: Undercover Assassin Convict
data.description: You were given a target, a mission, but killing your mark seems to have become much more difficult now.  Your employer cut contact with you and now you have to make do with what you have.

data.name: Embezzler
data.description: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.

data.name: Meth Cook
data.description: You clawed your way out of poverty by selling products everyone wanted, and they had the nerve to put you in jail for it.  Too bad you can't sell drugs to zombies.

data.name: Political Prisoner
data.description: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.
You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.

data.name: Burglar
data.description: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?

data.name: Lawyer
data.description: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.

data.name: Pastor
data.description: Armageddon has come!  You did everything you could to protect your community, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.

For your entire time as a servant of God, you helped, protected and listened to your parish faithful.  But these days, the Book of Revelation is starting to feel less metaphorical, and your parish turned against you.  Now all you can do is pray for the intercession of the saints.  Mary, Mother of God, pray for us!

data.name: Kannushi
data.description: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.
Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.

You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.
data.//: No knife, fire, or decent storage/armor.  Skill points are countered.

data.name: Rabbi
data.description: You were davening Shacharit in shul when the Cataclysm struck.  You had always taught that God will restore life to the dead after Moshiach has come, but not like this!

data.name: Guru
data.description: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

data.name: Traveling Preacher
data.description: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.

data.name: Novice Martial Artist
data.description: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.

data.name: Martial Artist
data.description: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!

data.name: Black Belt
data.description: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.

You were delivering the last pizza of the night to one of your common patrons when hungry zombies attempted to make a meal out of you.  Fleeing for safety, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!
You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.

data.name: Farmer
data.description: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.

data.name: National Guardsman
data.description: The government activated your National Guard unit to deal with the growing epidemics.  Despite your best efforts, you were unable to form up before all communications ceased and you found yourself alone among the dead.

data.name: Hardened Scavenger
data.description: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.

data.name: Military Holdout
data.description: You must have paid attention to your survival training in boot camp; otherwise, you would never have lived long enough to outlast the chain of command and find yourself in this predicament.  The only mission now is to survive.

data.name: Mall Security
data.description: You spent dull nights guarding the local mall against teen hooligans and petty thieves.  Your job training didn't provide any terribly useful skills, but you do have your trusty stun gun, baton, and pocket knife.

data.name: Naturalist
data.description: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.

data.name: Fisher
data.description: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.

description.male: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
description.female: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.

description.male: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
description.female: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.

data.description: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

data.name: Juvenile Delinquent
data.description: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.

data.name: Survivalist Jr.
data.description: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.

data.name: Dodgeball Player
data.description: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.

data.name: Science Club Member
data.description: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.

data.name: A/V Club Member
data.description: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.

data.name: Teacher
data.description: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.

data.name: Photojournalist
data.description: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.

data.name: Gym Teacher
data.description: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.

data.name: Miner
data.description: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…

data.name: Demolition Expert
data.description: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.

You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running FOR your life.

data.name: Tourist
data.description: This seemed like a great place for a vacation, but you're starting to regret ever leaving home.  You came here to get a taste of New England, but New England keeps trying to get a taste of you!

data.name: Naked and Afraid
data.description: The apocalypse has caught you completely naked!  Maybe you were robbed, maybe you were at a nudist beach, or maybe you just enjoy the feeling of liberation brought by the wind touching your skin.  Whatever the reason, you lack clothes in a time when everyone wants a piece of you.

data.name: Zoo Keeper
data.description: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.

data.name: Urban Samurai
data.description: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, with your funny hair and odd Japanese clothes.  Little of this concerned you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.

data.name: Competitive Fencer
data.description: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.

data.name: Career Politician
data.description: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.

data.name: Rancher
data.description: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.

data.name: Roadie
data.description: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.

data.name: Musician
data.description: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.

data.name: Kitted Survivor
data.description: You saw a sign at the local mall advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now it's all you have.

data.name: Wild West Gunslinger
data.description: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.

You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.

data.name: Military Marksman
data.description: You like to think of yourself as a sniper, but really you're just infantry with a bigger gun.  That said, a big gun is a definite advantage now.

data.name: Military Automatic Rifleman
data.description: You were trusted with a big-ass, belt-fed machine gun and plenty of ammo to lay down suppressing fire for your team.  Now that it's going to be much harder to resupply, you should probably be more selective with the ol' spray-and-pray.

data.name: Military Grenadier
data.description: There's no kill like overkill, and not many people in this world can boast that they have a grenade launcher and know how to use it.  Just try not to blow yourself up, that would be really embarrassing.

data.name: Military Breacher
data.description: Doors and windows everywhere dare not speak your name.  You're going to be breaking into buildings for supplies rather than combat operations now, but the principle is about the same.

data.name: Military Sniper
data.description: You're a crack shot with a rifle, and the farther you can stay away from zombies, the better.  The only thing stopping you is limited ammo, so you should try to find a place to restock sooner or later.

data.name: Military Hacker
data.description: 'Hacker' is a silly pop-culture name, popularized by Hollywood and people with little to no knowledge of what your job entails.  You prefer 'Electronic Warfare Specialist,' though nobody's really left to make the distinction.

data.name: Undercover Operative
data.description: You've been tailing your target for months, and now he's a zombie.  So much for that lead.  Command isn't responding to your calls for an evac, so you'll have to make do with what you have on you.

data.name: Military Pilot
data.description: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.

data.name: EMT
data.description: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.

data.name: Paramedic
data.description: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.

data.name: Combat Medic
data.description: You were on the front lines when everything happened, patching up the wounded and providing support.  But they wouldn't stop coming.  Now you're on your own.

data.name: Relief Volunteer
data.description: You were a member of a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping out where help was needed.  When the riots happened, you were eager to lend a hand.  But you had to cut your plans short when everyone was less interested in handouts, and more interested in eating you.
You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!

data.name: Hazmat Unit
data.description: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.

data.name: Drug Dealer
data.description: You were about to make your biggest sale yet, but when you met the buyer he tried to bite you.  To top it off, it seems that this wasn't some sort of bad trip, as the whole town tried going for your throat too.

data.name: Mafia Boss
data.description: Born into poverty, you joined one of the organized crime families to make a living.  There, you quickly made it to the top and became the boss.  The government was building a RICO case against you, but doomsday arrived first.  Your crew is gone, but your past life has prepared you for a world where violence is common currency.

data.name: Paranormal Investigator
data.description: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.

data.name: Bird Watcher
data.description: You were at your favorite park looking at the robins when the Cataclysm struck.  Now all you have are your binoculars and a lot of trivia about local birds to share with any survivors you may find.

data.name: Portal Traveler
data.description: You were abducted from your home, taken hostage, and used as a test subject in a lab.  For the last test, you were dressed in strange clothes and put in a room where you started to feel… different.  You lost consciousness and woke up somewhere unfamiliar.

You are obsessed with the techniques and aesthetics of the ninja, so you practiced your movements, dressed all in black, and spent big bucks to acquire some tools of the trade.  Some may question your historical authenticity, but you're perfectly happy living out your fantasy regardless.

data.name: Cheerleader
data.description: Your last cheerleader routine ended abruptly after your partners switched sides to the undead team.  Let's hope your quick reflexes and flexibility help you to find new members for the squad.

data.name: Patriot
data.description: You are a true American patriot, dressed with star-spangled clothing from head to toe.  The government has fallen, but the nation lives on with its people.

data.name: Prepped Patriot
data.description: Does the American dream still exist?  Well, recent events have put that to the test.  Does it still proudly live in your beating heart?  Yes.  Yes, it does.  A patriot to the bitter end, you've readied yourself to go toe to toe with the Cataclysm that would seek to do harm to your darling USA.  That is to say, you grabbed your gun… and nothing more.  God bless America, soldier.

data.name: Cowboy
data.description: You liked to spend your days taking care of the horses and cows, searching the perimeter of the ranch on your steed and looking out for anything suspicious, that's why you managed to escape in time when shit hit the fan.

data.name: Tourist Swimmer
data.description: You were looking forward to a nice, relaxing day at the beach.  You had to run when some lunatics tried to rip your head off and play beach volleyball with it, but at least you managed to grab your bag on the way out.

data.name: Professional Swimmer
data.description: After much practice you were sure the next competition would be your big break, but your rivals started killing each other and you had to escape with only your competition gear on you.  Will your athleticism alone be enough to keep you alive?

data.name: Surfer
data.description: You went to ride the waves, but the waves ended up riding you instead when a putrid hand appeared from underwater and grabbed you by the ankle.  You had to ditch your surfboard in favor of a kickboard, and now you'll fight every day to stay ahead of the wave of the undead.

data.name: Lifeguard
data.description: Your job was to safeguard the lives of everyone at the beach, but when the swimmers started drowning each other, you knew the situation was out of your hands.

data.name: Diver
data.description: You were exploring below the waves close to shore when you noticed something weird on the nearby beach, you decided to swim away when you heard the screams.

data.name: Ship Captain
data.description: You were the captain of your small ship, making a living by ferrying divers and tourists across the waves.  The last excursion went bad after your passengers tried to mutiny, but you managed to escape.  Will you ever sail the open ocean again?
You did the wet work for a gang, mafia, or whatever person had enough money.  You were no trained assassin, but you know how to shoot a gun and get out of dodge quickly.

data.name: Assassin
data.description: You were the best undercover agent they had, with a mission so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  Your target seems to have turned feral as well as your contact, you are all alone now.

data.name: Old Veteran
data.description: You've been through hell once before.  Hopefully those weekend range trips have kept your skills sharp.

data.name: Urban Explorer
data.description: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next excursion when the end of the world hit.  You suppose that pretty much every building could be considered abandoned now.

data.name: Office Worker
data.description: You felt years of your life being sapped away, slaving at your computer as you subsisted on a daily pot of coffee, microwave burritos and an endless supply of crumpled paper to toss.  Perhaps the Cataclysm is a refreshing change of pace…

data.name: RV Hunter
data.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting and traveling; so when you scraped enough money, you bought yourself an old RV, a gun, and hit the road.  You've been all over the country, hunting for good game.  Unfortunately the country is all over this time, and even more unfortunately you've lost your ol' reliable in the chaos.  Now you gotta find a new reliable.

data.name: Heist Driver
data.description: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now there are no cops and no law, but even after the Cataclysm, you drive.

data.name: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician
data.description: Ever since you were a child you were fascinated with explosives and all things that go boom.  As soon as you turned 18 you joined the army to become an EOD technician.  While out on a call about a potential explosive in the neighboring county, your team was overrun by hordes of the undead.  You are alone, with nothing but your precious training, gear and love of explosives.

data.name: Mixed Martial Artist
data.description: You've spent plenty of time training to become the next big thing.  But now it looks like you will be fighting your life from now on.  At least that training won't go to waste!

data.name: FBI Special Agent
data.description: As a member of the FBI, you dealt with crime that crossed state lines.  You had gotten the go-ahead to make the biggest bust of your career; before you kicked down the door, you yelled "FBI, open up!" and then the sky broke open.

data.name: Futile Fighter
data.description: The cataclysm may have caught you off guard, but you're not going down without a fight!

data.name: Human Mutant
data.description: You were the control case in the scientists' experiments - after they were done playing God with you, they injected some kind of drug that made you normal again.  Unfortunately, you know this world is no longer a place for normality.  Will you embrace the changes once again?

data.name: Fish Mutant
data.description: You have become a creature from the deep, like a monster from a cheap horror flick.  Only, it is far too real.

data.name: Spider Mutant
data.description: Forget about great responsibility - after everything that's been done to you, it's a miracle you don't have eight eyes.

data.name: Wolf Mutant
data.description: Being cooped up in here has been awful.  You need friends, and your fellow mutants aren't good company.  Hopefully once you escape, you'll find a pack to take you in.

data.name: Beast Mutant
data.description: It's not clear exactly what kind of beast you became, but that's not important anymore.  All that matters is the hunt.

data.name: Insect Mutant
data.description: Alike to The Fly, you are now a disturbing mix of human and bug.  But, bugs are nothing if not tenacious - and so shall you be.

data.name: Feline Mutant
data.description: Considering that you always complained about Mondays, this was probably inevitable.  Too bad you can't eat lasagna to complete the fit.

data.name: Subterranean Mutant
data.description: Your large, glowing eyes and starkly pallid skin suggest you have become some kind of cave creature.  The thought of the surface terrifies you, but anything is better than here.

data.name: Medical Mutant
data.description: Initially, the changes didn't seem obvious.  But then the psychological disorders began to manifest.  No matter; your body will survive anything.

data.name: Avian Mutant
data.description: The free skies of the surface seem so far away now.  Will you ever spread your wings again?

data.name: Ursine Mutant
data.description: The experiments turned you into a hulking beast of fur and muscle.  It took a while to stop bonking your head on doorways, but that's the least of your problems now.

data.name: Mouse Mutant
data.description: One might think being shrunk down to the size of a child might be an issue in this world of violence.  Well, you'll prove them wrong!  You just have to be… craftier.

data.name: Rabbit Mutant
data.description: All the world will be your enemy, and when they catch you, they will kill you.  But first, they must catch you…  Be cunning, and full of tricks, and you shall never be destroyed.

data.name: Sylvan Mutant
data.description: At first it seemed like you were turning into a plant.  But now, your form calls to mind an elf, or perhaps a dryad.  Hopefully there are still pristine forests out there.

data.name: Plant Mutant
data.description: Mutation has turned you into a bizarre mix of tree and human.  While you're slower than you used to be, you're sturdy as an oak.

data.name: Lizard Mutant
data.description: It's a good thing you always thought dinosaurs were cool, considering you've practically become one.  Hopefully you don't also go extinct.

data.name: Bovine Mutant
data.description: You've mutated into a minotaur, though unlike Asterios you've no hunger for human flesh, or any meat for that matter.  Still, you'll plow through anyone who gets in your way.

data.name: Rat Mutant
data.description: Once you're free of this place, you'll be able to make all the rules.  Have all the cheese you want.  Hopefully the normal humans will tolerate your rather unsightly appearance…

data.name: Cephalopod Mutant
data.description: It was hard enough to adjust to having tentacles instead of arms and legs; now the world's coming to an end, too.  At least your annoying neighbors won't bother you anymore.

data.name: Chiropteran Mutant
data.description: When power flickered, you didn't mind the dark.  But mutants down here don't make for a great community, and you yearn to see the night-sky.
You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.
You've spent some time developing your general fitness.  When operating muscle-powered vehicles, you know how to get more power out of each stroke.
With considerable practice, you've honed your athletic fitness and form.  You know how to get the most out of your effort, when manually powering a muscle-driven vehicle.
You've honed your athletics to at least a professional level.  When it comes to making vehicles move under your own power, your body is a well-oiled machine.
You know how to pick up most of the meat from the animal body.
There is very little meat left after your skillful knife movements.
You stopped making holes in the skin of animals you butcher.
You really know how to skin the animal.
You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how elements and compounds react with each other.
You've identified the key organs within several creatures and their locations with the goal of attacking them in combat.
You are beginning to gain a general idea of how various living beings function.
Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses carbon-containing compounds.
Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses compounds not containing carbon.
Knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi.
Extensive and detailed knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi, to an extremely nerdy degree.
The understanding of the chemistry of living things.
An in-depth understanding of how humans and animals operate.
You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how alien and post-Cataclysm mutated creatures function and operate.
You're beginning to grasp the basics of chemical production.
The proper understanding of safe chemical synthesization and how to clean your tools used for the next batch.
The process of separating two mixed liquids by their different boiling points.
An understanding of the chemistry of metalworking and alloys.
An understanding of how to produce various natural and chemical substances pure enough for human consumption.
You've done enough cooking to know the basics about how to quickly and efficiently sort your ingredients.
You're quite skilled at culinary knife work, making you noticeably faster at preparing meals that involve a lot of chopping.
You know the basics of baking - proportions, leavening, and things - and are less likely to make a dramatic mistake when working from memory.
You've baked enough bread to consider yourself an expert.  May your yeast be ever frothy.
Anyone can make a cookie, but you can make it look amazing.  Cakes and other fluffies are also no longer a barrier.
You could have been a professional baker before the Cataclysm.  Your profiteroles are the envy of the wastelands.
Anyone can toss stuff into deep fryer oil.  You know more about selecting oil, keeping the food from burning, and the like.
You know enough about deep frying breads and batters to do it easily without thinking about it.
You know the vaunted secrets of creating delicious deep fried sweets.
The basics of fermenting for human consumption, including sanitary technique, avoiding harmful molds, and identifying common problems.
Applying the science of distillation to alcoholic beverages to get something tasty.
The fine art of brewing grains into beers.
The knowledge of how to turn sugary fruits, and occasionally vegetables, into fermented beverages.
The microbiology of most non-alcoholic fermented edibles, from sauerkraut to sourdough.
The basics of curdling and coagulating milk and similar things without the wrong kinds of bacteria and mold winning out.
Taking the basics of curdled milk and making it delicious.
The basic knowledge of ways to keep food safe for long periods of time in a post-refrigeration world.
Using salt, smoke, and similar agents to cure or dehydrate food.
Using pressure canning or tinning to safely store food in sealed containers.

data.description: A basic understanding of the properties of metal as a material, and the concepts behind smithing, die casting, and other metalworking techniques.

The craft of working metal into tools and other items of use.

How to turn raw ingots and metals into usable wire.  Includes both drawing and extruding.

Heating steel to critical temperature, and using a variety of techniques including differential hardening techniques like slack quenching, and case hardening techniques for armor, to achieve a hardening of the steel while minimizing the brittleness.
Tempering involves thorough-hardening the steel then holding it at a constant temperature to increase metal durability.
A basic understanding of the operation of various metalworking machinery, such as lathes and mills.

data.description: Familiarity with the comparative anatomy of mutant Hymenopterans - ants, bees, and wasps of all kinds.  You find it easier to exploit their weak points, and possibly disable their natural weaponry.
You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated spiders of all shapes and sizes.

You have extensive experience with netherium abominations which provides you with a vague sense of where more vulnerable spots might be.
You have studied mi-go sufficiently to get a sense for where some sensitive points might be.  However, its biology remains too different from life originating on Earth to be understood to any extent.

Your understanding of the mi-go body is advanced enough to have a decent idea of where it is more sensitive to harm.  This does not mean you have any significant understanding of how it works internally; if anything, your dissections have just left you more confused.

You have studied fungaloids sufficiently to get an idea of which parts are the more sensitive ones.  While seeming to be a weird mixture of fungus and animal, it at least has a structure with commonalities between different types of fungaloids.

You have advanced your understanding of the fungaloid body sufficiently to have a pretty good idea of where you can harm it and where it's better protected.  You don't really understand it's biological functions, although it seems it would be possible for someone with much more time than you have to glean some insight into it, but you've gotten an understanding of how to hurt it, and that's what's important here.

Your observations of the power leech anatomy is starting to pay off.  You now have a basic idea of where their more sensitive structures are located.  These creatures exhibit traits that seem to be a mix between animal and plant ones.

The extensive experience with power leeches have given you a good understanding of their weaknesses and strengths.  A rather different set of skills would be needed to actually understand their biology, though, and you probably don't have the time to study that anyway.
Study of triffids has given you insights into their anatomy that allows you to aim for some weak spots.

Extensive study of triffids has provided you with a good understanding of their strengths and weaknesses when it comes to combat.  A scientific study of them might yield further biological insights, but you don't have the time to spend years cooped up in a lab.

data.//1: Average ichcahuipilli was around 1 inch (~2.5 cm) thick. As cotton padding constituted the majority of its protective qualities, I'll consider the quilted part 0.5 cm thick.
data.//2: This leaves us with 20 layers of cotton sheets, taking the thickness of a cotton sheet as 0.25 mm.
data.//3: Average length of a human male is around 170 cm. Average weight of a human (in North America) is 80 kg. BSA calculation and rule of the nines gives us about 0,68 m^2 or 7,3 sq feet.
data.//3.5: I'll round that down to 7 for ease, as well as compensating for average woman being shorter and thinner and Americans being exceptionally fat.
data.//4: Our cotton sheets are 1x2 feet. 20 layers x 7 sq ft / 2 sq ft of the sheets = 70 sheets. I know the outer layer of quilting would require more sheets because of the padding inbetween but I won't bother doing the maths for it
data.//5: Cotton padding inbetween would make 0.065 ft (2 cm of cotton) x 7 sq ft of torso = 0,455 cube ft which is about 12,88 liters of cotton. Once again this calculation is off but again, I can't do the maths.
data.//5.5: That's about… a lot of cotton, 1288 patches or 429 balls or 257 sheets to be precise. Byproducts I made up.
data.//6: That's 70x0,04 + 1288x0,01 = 15,6 kgs and some more for leather and salt wtf

data.description: Survey land for a workshop area.
Let's install a metal working forge in the smithy.  We'll need a few tools too, so we'll include some storage space.  This will provide us with a first couple of primitive crafting recipes.
Let's install a couple of charcoal kilns outside of the smithy.  We'll add a crucible as well.  This will allow us to produce a few additional things.
Let's install an anvil in the smithy, some quenching containers and a workbench.  This will allow us to produce a few additional things.
Let's add furniture and some more tools to the smithy.  This will allow us to produce a few additional things.
Let's install a bellows for our forge and add some more tools.  This will extend our recipe repertoire.
Let's add a drop hammer to the smithy for productivity and add some more tools.  This will allow us to reach our smithing potential.
Let's build a kiln in the pottery to allow us to make a clay crucible.
Let's furnish the pottery.
Let's furnish the glassblower's cottage.
Let's furnish the tannery.
Let's add a bench and a fire barrel outside the pottery for recreation.
We can use a smithy.  Let's start by building a spot to protect the workers from the rain.

data.//CCB: 撤销 PR #86581 — 恢复僵尸尸体的实用性

data.//-1: byproduct yield is measured in multiples of 250 (~200 grams)
data.//: Figures based primarily on Performance of Thermochemical Conversion of Fat, Oils, and Grease into Kerosene-like Fuel in Different Production Scales.
data.//1: cracking done at ~550 degrees c with 10kg of water, 10kg of fat, and 1kg of washing soda.
data.//2: about 60-65% of the fatty mass is turned into OLP (organic liquid product). 5-10% is coke, and 20-30% of the result is non condensible vapor (lost)
data.//3: about 15% of the total reaction becomes kerosene-like hydrocarbons and about 50% becomes diesel-like hydrocarbons. So it is intentional that this produces 3x the diesel as kerosene.
data.//4: Thus the whole recipe produces about 5 kg of diesel (6000 ml) and 1.5 liters of kerosene (1800 ml)
data.//5: These reactors operate at 10-15 KW power levels for long periods of time and each batch is processing a pretty large amount of material. Specific heats give us about 40 MJ just to get to temp (550c)

data.//: primitive recipe used for thousands of years before modern era.  Folk craft teachers refer to this as the clumping method that is not appropriate for beginners.
Primitive cementation: pack low-carbon steel in charcoal in a sealed clay vessel and heat it over a fire to diffuse carbon into medium-carbon steel.
Primitive case hardening: pack low-carbon steel in charcoal in a sealed clay vessel and heat it longer than plain carburizing so only the surface layer is enriched with carbon.
Primitive quench and temper: heat medium-carbon steel over a fire, quench it in a tank of water, then temper it over low heat to make tempered steel.
Primitive finery process: heat high-carbon steel or cast iron in an oxidizing fire and hammer it to burn off excess carbon, yielding standard steel.
Primitive bloomery-style refining: heat and hammer budget steel chunks to drive out slag and impurities, yielding standard steel.

data.name: Heat source
data.//: Heat usable for heating a surface - for example a pot, pan, dutch oven, etc.
data.//1: Roughly 80% efficiency for a microwave or induction hotplate, 30-40% for gas/kerosene/alcohol/propane/acetylene, 20-25% for hexamine, 15-20% for an oven/charcoal, 50-60% for a regular electric cooker.  18% efficiency for improvised options like the toolkit or an arc welder.
data.//2: esbit has 40kJ/u, kerosene/gasoline 34 kJ/u, biogas 5kJ/u, propane 25kJ/u, acetylene 50kJ/u, alcohol 20kJ/u. needs 2x total energy of induction.
data.//3: charcoal/coal 31/u, but it is less efficient than other fossil fuels and is closer to an oven.  I'm treating the smoker as a big charcoal grill as far as efficiency is concerned.
data.//4: Standards: 1 surface_heat - bake one unit of standard flour, process 2u of butter/oil, 1u of sugar_standard, cook a corn tortilla, process 100g of fruit.  2 surface_heats - cook a scrap of raw meat (30g), process milk in a recipe, apply a unit of 'batter' to a recipe, process 100g of veggy (treat very starchy stuff like potatoes, roots, cattails, as flour).
data.//5: More Standards: 3 surface_heats: cook oatmeal. 4 surface_heats: cook beans, rice, or lentils, use cooked meat in a recipe, cook one unit of raw organs.  5 surface_heats: cook 1 unit of cornmeal or bread flour. 6u surface_heats: roast nuts, cook a chunk of tofu. 15u surface heat: process a chunk of fat or a unit of blood. 20u: cook a chunk of raw meat (300g)
data.//6: Note that a lot of food is not cooked to boiling temperature.  As a result most comestibles that used surface_heat have been made clean water only because it is not sufficient to guarantee potability.
data.//7: Ovens are terrible, this is intentional.  Typical oven uses 3x the wattage of a microwave, and bakes for often over 10x as long as the microwave does.  We cannot account for batch energy savings (multiple things in same oven) nor keeping the oven at temp (many kJ are wasted bringing it up to temp, unlike with a microwave) so efficiency is generously 0.2x that of microwave.
data.//8: A good way to judge input needed is how many seconds it takes to microwave.  1kW is a good estimate for microwave power usage, and the ratios are relatively consistent between different foodstuffs.

data.name: Smoking heat
data.//: Power requirement to smoke 10g of food. Half the power cost of dehydrating, assuming smoking means halfway dehydrated. Can't be done electrically, obviously.
data.//1: https://www.masterclass.com/articles/how-to-smoke-meat-with-a-charcoal-smoker - roughly 1 pound charcoal per 1 pound meat (and 1 hour).
data.//1.5: https://firebrandbbq.com.au/2018/03/05/lighting-charcoal-bbq-heres-much-fuel-really-need/ also says 1:1 but that it can go as low as 1:2.
data.//2: Survivor doesn't care too much about quality, the important part is that it gets preserved. It is 6.24 grams of charcoal per 10 grams of food presently.
data.//3: 300g of meat would be 30u of this, which is about 187g of charcoal total (or 168g of coal) as an example.

data.name: Dehydrating heat
data.//: Power requirement to dehydrate 10g of food. Electric food dehydrators are about 30-35% efficient, which is by itself irrelevant but may eventually matter to compare other means of dehydrating.
data.//1: Like above with smoking_heat, charcoal expenditure is much less efficient than just cooking something.  Since you are fully dehydrating rather than just smoking, double the cost of smoking_heat in charcoal.
data.//2: Estimate given by dehydrating 3 lbs of bananas for 6 hours (https://www.freshoffthegrid.com/dehydrating-bananas/), 500w is about normal for a dehydrator. This might be different for meat, but I'm using the same values for any food at the moment.
data.//3: 3lbs = 1634g, time = 0.5x60x60x6 = 10800kJ. 10800kJ/163.5(10s of grams) = ~66 kJ per 10-gram

data.name: Vacuum sealer
data.//: Power requirement to seal one bag, 400w for 10 seconds.  Includes the bag.
data.//1: Yes, they really are that cheap, vacuum sealers are trivial to operate.
data.//2: Vacuum sealed bags are an ideal environment for botulinum growth, and they cannot be heated to 125c due to bag meltage.
data.//3: Therefore, indefinite storage is impossible through this method, and as such vac bags are now only 50% instead of 0% spoilage.
data.//4: It's likely doable to reseal an MRE bag using a sealer and the sterilize it and its contents with heat instead of radiation, though this is speculative.

data.name: Frying oil
data.//: Oil usable for frying. Note: the oil is reusable.

data.name: Boiling heat
data.//: Tools usable for providing heat usable for boiling water, but not necessarily for anything else. This can use unclean water even for food recipes like boiled vegetables since it sterlizes the water.
data.//1: Hypothetical maximum efficiency to clean 0.25L of water (one unit) is around 100kJ, to heat in a basement and boil for 1 minute. In theory boiling water in the middle of a summer afternoon should use less power, but we cannot model that (yet)
data.//2: Roughly 75-80% efficiency for induction, 25-30% for gas/kerosene/alcohol/propane/acetylene, ~20% for hexamine, 50% for a regular electric cooker, 40% for microwave, 10% for oven/charcoal.
data.//3: kerosene/gasoline 34 kJ/u, biogas 5kJ/u, propane 25kJ/u, acetylene 50kJ/u alcohol 20kJ/u. needs 400kJ total - 100kJ/0.25.
data.//4: esbit has 40kJ/u, @ ~20% efficiency that's aboout 13u
data.//5: charcoal/coal 50/u, it is less efficient than other fossil fuels  at ~15%.
data.//6: note that while microwaves are great for cooking food they're not great for boiling water.  Convection in general is inefficient for this process, however induction (heats the pan itself through magnetic coils) excels.
data.//7: for each unit of water add an additional count of this per 15 minutes the water is kept boiling.

data.//: acidic additives to lower PH and prevent the growth of botulinum, for a 3L jar.
data.//1: lemon is about 20-25% juice by weight. Formic acid is non toxic and can be safely ingested in dilute amounts.
data.//2: Even many pressure canning recipes should require this for safety.

data.//: acidic additives to lower PH and prevent the growth of botulinum.
data.//1: Even many pressure canning recipes should require this for safety.

data.//: This is sealing glass jars using the water bath method, using acid to neutralize botulinum instead of extreme heat.
data.//1: For high-acid foods, such as many fruits, extreme heat is not necessary, since botulinum can't grow if PH is 4.6. immersing low acid foods in an acidic solution is typically also sufficient
data.//2: Per its longest_side (13.2cm) a 0.5L jar is about 7cm wide.  Per its longest_side (29.8cm) a 3L jar is about 11cm wide.
data.//3: water needs to fill above the jar about 3-6cm.  I'm assuming half this for the radius.  Therefore 0.5L jar is immersed in an 10x18cm cylinder, and 3L jar is immersed in a 15x35cm cylinder.
data.//4: accounting for displacement that means about 2u water per 0.5L jar and 12u water per 3L jar.
data.//5: using water_boiling_heat as a base, a minimum cost of 2u for the temp needed to heat the water, another 2u for the jar (specific heat is lower than water but jar will contain an aqueous solution so this is an estimate, though it takes about 15 minutes for water to come to temp again after adding jars so it should be accurate) as well as another 2u for the roughly 15 minutes to seal the jar, and another 2u to represent time lost due to inefficiency and heat bleed.

data.//: This is sealing glass jars using the water bath method, using extreme heat (125c) to neutralize botulinum, requires a pressure cooker to achieve such temperatures.
data.//1: Needed for low-acid foods, such as meat and many veggies, which present suitable anerobic conditions for botulinum to grow in absence of low PH.
data.//2: Per its longest_side (13.2cm) a 0.5L jar is about 7cm wide.  Per its longest_side (29.8cm) a 3L jar is about 11cm wide.
data.//3: water needs to fill above the jar about 3-6cm.  I'm assuming half this for the radius.  Therefore 0.5L jar is immersed in an 10x18cm cylinder, and 3L jar is immersed in a 15x35cm cylinder.
data.//4: accounting for displacement that means about 2u water per 0.5L jar and 12u water per 3L jar.
data.//5: 50% more energy used compared to low_heat canning. A 0.5L jar of meat would take about 1875kJ to can in ideal circumstances, compare to 1000kJ to cook normally or 4800kJ to dehydrate.

data.//: this is being left as a fallback for any canning recipe which hasn't yet been converted to low or high heat.
Toolset required to seal a tin can.  Power costs of contents will need to reach 125c in order to kill botulinum, as usual.
data.//1: The ingredients are packed into the tin can with water to ensure no air is left, then sealed, then pressure cooked. The steam pressure helps prevent the lid from bursting off, which might happen if you heated the can over a stove.
data.//2: similar to pressure canning, although this is measured in 0.25L rather than 0.5L, and uses a bit less power because metal cans are more compact, more thermally conductive, and are already sealed.
data.//3: treating a small tin can (0.25L) of water heated inside the bare minimum amount of water to encapsulate it, heated to 33% above boiling, for roughly 12u boiling per half_liter, lower than glass jar pressure canning.
