speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "So, what is this thing supposed to be, exactly?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We found it in a wreckage, barely alive.  Not the first one, either."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Area nineteen has a few in cold storage."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We're still trying to figure out what makes it tick."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We're not even sure what it is."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_surgeon
data.sound: "The cell structure is unlike any we've ever seen."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "It does seem to have some form of higher level brain functioning."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Problem solving, memory retention, that sort of thing."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "There appear to be some anomalous aspects to the mimicry."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Members of the species have some kind of neurocognitive link."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "This one's repeating phrases that the previous specimen was exposed to."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "You mean it's not just parroting us?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "It's parroting us, but we're uncertain as to how or why."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "It may be a mechanism for attracting prey."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "It could even be a way of trying to scare us off."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You're gonna rot in hell for this!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You're gonna rot in hell, you pieces of shit!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_surgeon
data.sound: "Like we said, we have no idea what it's thinking."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Why don't you touch it and find out?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "What'll happen if the power goes out?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "And what if all the backups fail?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "The glass alone won't keep us safe for very long."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "That fuckin' thing is horrible, man, it gives me the creeps."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "It's probably more scared of us than we are of it."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Hey, we got other specimens that could withstand a grenade."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "At least we know they can die."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "To be kept in a standard biohazardous containment chamber."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Until such time as more permanent arrangements are made."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Shows a noted preference for human brain tissue."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Destroy the specimen if it begins to interact with the lock."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Kill them all and let God sort them out!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I watched a snail crawl along the edge of a straight razor."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I've seen horrors, horrors that you've seen."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I love the smell of napalm in the morning."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "This is the way the fuckin' world ends."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Look at this fuckin' shit we're in, man."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Every man has got a breaking point."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I'ma cut those fuckin' tentacles off, bitch!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "That's the first time it moved all morning."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I'm certain it's trying to understand us."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I'm not convinced it can actually comprehend us."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Just being an alien creature doesn't mean it's intelligent."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Just because it doesn't look like you doesn't mean that it isn't."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Please open the door and enter the cell."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Would it react differently with a child?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Experiments to determine extent of cognitive abilities still underway."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Subject has so far displayed a total lack of empathy toward human suffering."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Only a few more days 'til the weekend."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "You got a dollar I can borrow?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Are you going to the party tonight?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I think I need to see a doctor."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We should hit up the shooting range later."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I'm heading to the pool after work."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I got this weird rash a few days ago."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Let me have a look at it."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We should split into groups of two each."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "I've been looking all over for you."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Take his gun, we're going to need it."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "How do we get out of here?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Oh God, I'm the only one left."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "That creepy abandoned post-apocalyptic lab complex looks safe…"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Don't worry, it isn't like anything could teleport out of the containment cells."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "Hold on, I want to pulp that zombie corpse."

speaker: mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_myrmidon
data.sound: "What did that thing just hit me with?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I can barely move.  Run!  Save yourself!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Oh you motherfucking shellfish, you're going down."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi-go_surgeon
data.sound: "Oi, dingus, you can't keep me in 'ere."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "We got a treaty w'yer people, don'we?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "This'll get back t'my bosses, right and so!"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Hey look, that one's carrying something.  Let's crack it open and steal it."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi-go_surgeon
data.sound: "Did you see what they did to him?"

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi-go_surgeon
data.sound: "Yeah.  I can't believe he stayed alive that long."

speaker: mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi-go_surgeon
data.sound: "I think there's something in the air that's keeping us alive."

speaker: mon_mutant_experimental
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "WHY THE FUCK are you doing this to me?"

speaker: mon_mutant_experimental
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I TOLD YOU TO GET OUT OF HERE!"

speaker: mon_mutant_experimental
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "WHAT THE FUCK DO YOU WANT FROM ME?!"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Have you seen my friend?  He went into surgery yesterday… or maybe the day before…"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "Is it done?  Am I perfect now?"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I have done what you asked.  Please let me go!"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "I cannot… yet I must.  How do you calculate that?"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
mon_mi_go_surgeon
data.sound: "This is a dream.  This has to be a dream."

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "This is my life now… this is my life now… this is my life now…"

speaker: mon_prototype_cyborg
mon_mi_go
mon_mi_go_slaver
data.sound: "You lied to me!  Look at what you've done!", followed by an electronic voice saying "YOU'LL PAY FOR THIS!"

data.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding.  Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.
Live your life to the fullest, prove to yourself that you can survive this new obstacle in the same way that you have survived the last.
Become the best clown, make sure that your next show will make everyone laugh by training your social skills to perfection.

name.str: Find a memory of your master

data.description: Find and wield a whip to remember your master even when separated.

You could have become a master in martial arts if you had the chance, so train until you achieve the level of a master in the old world, and find yourself a nice black belt to commemorate the occasion.
The world has ended, but as an authentic samurai you lack a katana, you must find one, quickly.
When you were escaping an evacuation point that was overrun, you had to leave your rifle behind.  Shame on you, what's a hunter without their hunting rifle?  You have to find one immediately.

You have saved your dogs from the fall of the world, but they could still suffer from danger everywhere.  Police dogs used some Kevlar harnesses for protection…  Maybe your friends could use some too?
The end of the world could have arrived, but you still crave for that one big hunt.  Search and kill a black bear to remember the old days.

The world has become like an anime!  Zombies, mutants, the end of civilization as we know it…  You must become the protagonist if you want to survive, the plot armor will help you.  Go and kill 50 zombies to show your protagonist potential.
They wanted to put you behind bars, but are now dead, make them pay with blood, unliving blood.
Your evolution to a more perfect form was interrupted by the Cataclysm.  Restart your transformation process whatever it costs.
They took away something from you, something important.  You feel a connection with this weather, maybe you can recover some portion of what you lost in one of these storms.

You have always had good social abilities.  Go and recruit 2 followers and establish your leadership among them.  Don't forget to order them to build a base of operations for you in the form of a survivor camp.
As a real ninja, you can't allow competitors for the night.  Kill 10 shady zombies and demonstrate who is the real ninja here.
The world could have ended, but there are still some fantastic costumes out there, just waiting for you to wear them.  Search them until you find them.
You are a skater at heart, and as such you need some skates to drive by, any kind will suffice.
You need to always dress in style and fashion.  Find a dress or tuxedo for your personal use.
As a Game Master, it's just unacceptable that you now lack your means to play.  Find any tabletop game to play with any survivors you could find, even a cards game will suffice.
Survive all day from the crazy inhabitants of the mansion.
You were flying towards a nearby private airport before your forced landing.  You could still reach it by ground, and scavenge it for fuel.
Your helicopter was crashed to the ground, communications were lost with ground base, and the rest of your team died while landing, at least you still know the way back to the base.
Your bird is now on the ground, never again able to fly, you could search for a new one in the closest refueling stop requisitioned by the military.

You're not sure who orders takeout when the world's ending, but that doesn't matter.  Evacuation doesn't matter.  Nothing, indeed, matters, save for safely delivering your precious cargo to its destination: a remote mansion.
Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it but never truly escape it.  It won't end until one of you dies.
data.//: monster_kill_goal MUST be 1 or else the mission will spawn a new nemesis on its death.

data.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can fight it but never truly kill it.  It won't end until you die.
You don't know where you are, but in the distance you see a jagged spire, with a green light atop it.  Perhaps you should climb this spire and investigate?  What else do you have to lose?
